1ff342b97e34054f045eb8cad2f1a2e061779c89.data:
name: SonarCloud

# CI-based SonarQube Cloud analysis. Turn Automatic Analysis off in the project's
# Administration > Analysis Method first, or the scan is refused. Needs the repository secret
# SONAR_TOKEN.
on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["main"]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  analyze:
    name: Analyze
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    # Pull requests from forks get no secrets, so they can't be analyzed here.
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # Full history for blame and new-code detection.
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-java@b843ebf9b913146b38da2eaa7aeddf76074ae1ad # v6.1.0
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Android SDK 36 and 37
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sdkmanager="$(find "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools" -type f -name sdkmanager -print -quit)"
          test -n "$sdkmanager"
          yes | "$sdkmanager" --licenses > /dev/null || true
          "$sdkmanager" 'platforms;android-36' 'platforms;android-37.0' 'build-tools;36.0.0'

      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@3f5f9adaf7d9fecd50b5935e54106014257a94e6 # v6.4.0

      # Sonar reads the Kover coverage (JaCoCo-format XML) and the Android Lint report, so build them first.
      # Lint reports without failing here (TENSEVEN_STRICT_QUALITY is not passed); the Android workflow owns that gate.
      - name: Build coverage and lint reports
        run: >-
          ./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain --continue
          :design:koverXmlReportDebug :app:koverXmlReportDebug
          :phone:koverXmlReportDebug :calendar:koverXmlReportDebug
          :design:lintDebug :app:lintDebug :phone:lintDebug :calendar:lintDebug

      - name: Run SonarQube Cloud analysis
        uses: SonarSource/sonarqube-scan-action@e805d875275f728fac1885b413934be6d7c63f65 # v8.4.1
        env:
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
        with:
          # The job waits for the SonarCloud quality gate and fails when the gate fails. This is independent of
          # TENSEVEN_STRICT_QUALITY (which only governs detekt, ktlint and Lint).
          args: >
            -Dsonar.qualitygate.wait=true
            -Dsonar.qualitygate.timeout=300
            -Dsonar.coverage.jacoco.xmlReportPaths=app/build/reports/kover/reportDebug.xml,design/build/reports/kover/reportDebug.xml,phone/build/reports/kover/reportDebug.xml,calendar/build/reports/kover/reportDebug.xml
            -Dsonar.androidLint.reportPaths=app/build/reports/lint-results-debug.xml,design/build/reports/lint-results-debug.xml,phone/build/reports/lint-results-debug.xml,calendar/build/reports/lint-results-debug.xml

      - name: Report quality gate findings
        if: always()
        env:
          SONAR_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SONAR_TOKEN }}
          SONAR_PULL_REQUEST: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          SONAR_BRANCH: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: python3 tools/sonar_gate_report.py

      - name: Upload reports on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: sonar-reports
          path: |
            **/build/reports/
            **/build/test-results/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

name: P2 quality ratchet
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths: ['app/**', 'design/**', 'phone/**', 'calendar/**', 'tools/quality_ratchet.py', 'tests/test_quality_ratchet.py', '.github/workflows/p2-quality.yml']
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: p2-quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  ratchet:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-java@b843ebf9b913146b38da2eaa7aeddf76074ae1ad
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@3f5f9adaf7d9fecd50b5935e54106014257a94e6
      - name: Android SDK 36 and 37
        run: |
          sdkmanager="$(find "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools" -type f -name sdkmanager -print -quit)"
          yes | "$sdkmanager" --licenses > /dev/null || true
          "$sdkmanager" 'platforms;android-36' 'platforms;android-37.0' 'build-tools;36.0.0'
      - name: Formatting evidence for changed Kotlin sources
        run: |
          git diff --name-only 6036d24e2ceafc1af0b780e657a6b068d49b91f4 HEAD -- '*.kt' '*.kts' > /tmp/p2-format-paths
          ./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain -Ptenseven.strictQuality=false --rerun-tasks --no-build-cache ktlintFormat
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import base64, pathlib, subprocess
          paths = pathlib.Path('/tmp/p2-format-paths').read_text().splitlines()
          patch = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--binary', '--', *paths])
          if patch:
              pathlib.Path('/tmp/p2-format.patch').write_bytes(patch)
              encoded = base64.b64encode(patch).decode()
              for index in range(0, len(encoded), 16000):
                  print('P2_FORMAT_PATCH:' + encoded[index:index+16000])
          subprocess.run(['git', 'restore', '--worktree', '.'], check=True)
          if patch:
              raise SystemExit('Formatting changes required; apply the reported source-only patch.')
          PY
      - name: Baseline accepted version 15 reports
        run: |
          git worktree add --detach /tmp/tenseven-quality-base 6036d24e2ceafc1af0b780e657a6b068d49b91f4
          cd /tmp/tenseven-quality-base
          ./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain -Ptenseven.strictQuality=false --rerun-tasks --no-build-cache ktlintFormat
          python3 - <<'PYBASE'
          from pathlib import Path
          import subprocess
          selected = set(Path('/tmp/p2-format-paths').read_text().splitlines())
          for path in subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only'], text=True).splitlines():
              if path not in selected:
                  subprocess.run(['git', 'restore', '--worktree', '--', path], check=True)
          PYBASE
          ./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain -Ptenseven.strictQuality=false :app:lintDebug :design:lintDebug detekt ktlintCheck
      - name: Current reports and enforcement
        run: |
          ./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain -Ptenseven.strictQuality=false :app:lintDebug :design:lintDebug :phone:lintDebug :calendar:lintDebug detekt ktlintCheck
          python3 tools/quality_ratchet.py /tmp/tenseven-quality-base "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          python3 tests/test_quality_ratchet.py

name: Android

# Builds the Tenseven launcher and runs the quality gates SableOS runs for its own apps: unit tests,
# Android Lint, detekt, ktlint and Kover. detekt, ktlint and Lint only report until the repository
# variable TENSEVEN_STRICT_QUALITY is set to true (Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions >
# Variables); compile errors and failing unit tests always fail the job.
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'app/**'
      - 'design/**'
      - 'phone/**'
      - 'calendar/**'
      - 'config/**'
      - 'gradle/**'
      - 'build.gradle.kts'
      - 'settings.gradle.kts'
      - 'gradle.properties'
      - '.editorconfig'
      - '.github/workflows/android.yml'
      - 'tools/verify-release-apks.sh'
      - 'tools/deliverable_quality_gate.py'
      - 'tools/tests/**'
      - 'tools/quality_gate_*.py'
      - '!**/*.md'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'app/**'
      - 'design/**'
      - 'phone/**'
      - 'calendar/**'
      - 'config/**'
      - 'gradle/**'
      - 'build.gradle.kts'
      - 'settings.gradle.kts'
      - 'gradle.properties'
      - '.editorconfig'
      - '.github/workflows/android.yml'
      - 'tools/verify-release-apks.sh'
      - 'tools/deliverable_quality_gate.py'
      - 'tools/tests/**'
      - 'tools/quality_gate_*.py'
      - '!**/*.md'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: android-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    name: build, test and check
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-java@b843ebf9b913146b38da2eaa7aeddf76074ae1ad # v6.1.0
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
      - name: Android SDK 36 and 37
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sdkmanager="$(find "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools" -type f -name sdkmanager -print -quit)"
          test -n "$sdkmanager"
          yes | "$sdkmanager" --licenses > /dev/null || true
          "$sdkmanager" 'platforms;android-36' 'platforms;android-37.0' 'build-tools;36.0.0'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@3f5f9adaf7d9fecd50b5935e54106014257a94e6 # v6.4.0
      - name: Build, test and check
        env:
          STRICT: ${{ vars.TENSEVEN_STRICT_QUALITY || 'false' }}
        # --continue reports every failing gate in one run.
        run: >-
          ./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain --continue "-Ptenseven.strictQuality=$STRICT"
          :design:testDebugUnitTest :app:testDebugUnitTest :phone:testDebugUnitTest :calendar:testDebugUnitTest
          :app:assembleDebug :phone:assembleDebug :calendar:assembleDebug
          :app:assembleRelease :phone:assembleRelease :calendar:assembleRelease
          :app:assembleDebugAndroidTest :phone:compileDebugAndroidTestKotlin :calendar:compileDebugAndroidTestKotlin
          :design:lintDebug :app:lintDebug :phone:lintDebug :calendar:lintDebug
          detekt ktlintCheck
          :design:koverXmlReportDebug :app:koverXmlReportDebug
          :phone:koverXmlReportDebug :calendar:koverXmlReportDebug
      - name: Qualify checker against genuine exact-parent reports
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          QUALITY_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          python3 -B - <<'PYCHECKER'
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import subprocess
          import sys
          workspace = Path(os.environ["GITHUB_WORKSPACE"])
          sys.path.insert(0, str(workspace / "tools"))
          from quality_gate_runtime import GitRepository
          repo = GitRepository(workspace)
          head = repo.resolve(os.environ["QUALITY_HEAD"])
          if not repo.ancestor(head, repo.head()):
              raise SystemExit("PR source is not in checkout ancestry")
          parent = repo.parent(head)
          if parent is None:
              raise SystemExit("Source requires an exact parent")
          root = Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"])
          candidate = root / "tenseven-checker-source"
          evidence = root / "tenseven-checker-exact-parent"
          subprocess.run(["git", "worktree", "add", "--detach", str(candidate), head], check=True)
          subprocess.run([
              sys.executable, "-B", str(workspace / "tools/deliverable_quality_gate.py"),
              "--repo", str(candidate), "--base-ref", parent, "--out", str(evidence),
              "--approved-compose-policy",
          ], check=True)
          environment = dict(os.environ,
              TENSEVEN_REAL_BASE=str(evidence / "baseline-source"),
              TENSEVEN_REAL_CANDIDATE=str(candidate),
              TENSEVEN_POLICY_REPO=str(workspace),
          )
          subprocess.run([
              sys.executable, "-B", "-m", "unittest", "discover",
              "-s", str(workspace / "tools/tests"), "-p", "test_deliverable_quality_gate.py", "-v",
          ], cwd=workspace, env=environment, check=True)
          exported = {name: environment[name] for name in (
              "TENSEVEN_REAL_BASE", "TENSEVEN_REAL_CANDIDATE", "TENSEVEN_POLICY_REPO",
          )}
          if any("\n" in value or "\r" in value for value in exported.values()):
              raise SystemExit("Invalid checker report/history environment path")
          with open(os.environ["GITHUB_ENV"], "a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
              for name, value in exported.items():
                  stream.write(name + "=" + value + "\n")
          PYCHECKER
      - name: Enforce changed-file quality
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          BASE_BRANCH: ${{ github.base_ref }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          BASE="$(git merge-base "origin/$BASE_BRANCH" HEAD)"
          python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tools/tests -p 'test_deliverable_quality_gate.py' -v
          python3 -B tools/deliverable_quality_gate.py \
            --repo "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --base-ref "$BASE" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/tenseven-deliverable-quality" --approved-compose-policy
      - name: Verify compiled Full APK manifest
        run: |
          bash tools/verify-release-apks.sh --ci-unsigned \
            app/build/outputs/apk/release/Tenseven-Launcher-release-unsigned.apk
      - name: Kover line coverage (baseline, no threshold)
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import os, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
          lines = []
          for module in ("design", "app", "phone", "calendar"):
              r = ET.parse(f"{module}/build/reports/kover/reportDebug.xml").getroot()
              c = next(x for x in r.findall("counter") if x.attrib.get("type") == "LINE")
              cov, mis = int(c.attrib["covered"]), int(c.attrib["missed"])
              pct = cov * 100.0 / (cov + mis) if cov + mis else 0.0
              print(f"KOVER_LINE_PERCENT_{module.upper()}={pct:.2f}")
              lines.append(f"Kover line coverage ({module}): **{pct:.2f}%** ({cov}/{cov + mis}), baseline only")
          with open(os.environ["GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"], "a") as f:
              f.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
          PY
      - name: Upload APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: tenseven-debug-apk
          path: |
            app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk
            phone/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk
            calendar/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Upload reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: reports
          path: |
            **/build/reports/
            **/build/test-results/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Optionally retain existing debug outputs; never builds, signs or installs."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
PACKAGES = {
    "app": ("Launcher", "io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.debug.l0"),
    "phone": ("Phone", "io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.phone.debug"),
    "calendar": ("Calendar", "io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.calendar.debug"),
}
PRODUCTION_CERT = "9b2047390e5aa77537b8e8875cdfd3c2c72d0a0715e172a7f77457fc4300f292"


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def git(*arguments):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(ROOT), *arguments])


def source_identity():
    names = sorted(set(git("ls-files", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z").decode().split("\0")) - {""})
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for name in names:
        path = ROOT / name
        raw = path.read_bytes() if path.is_file() else b"<deleted>"
        digest.update(name.encode() + b"\0" + raw)
    return {
        "commit": git("rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip(),
        "commit_tree": git("rev-parse", "HEAD^{tree}").decode().strip(),
        "worktree_sha256": digest.hexdigest(),
        "status": git("status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all").decode(),
    }


def inspect(module, sdk):
    directory = ROOT / module / "build/outputs/apk/debug"
    metadata = json.loads((directory / "output-metadata.json").read_text())
    element, = metadata["elements"]
    filename = element["outputFile"]
    if Path(filename).name != filename:
        raise ValueError("Output metadata must name a direct APK child")
    apk = directory / filename
    if apk.is_symlink() or not apk.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Expected an ordinary existing APK")
    badging = subprocess.check_output([str(sdk / "aapt2"), "dump", "badging", str(apk)], text=True)
    package = re.search(r"^package: name='([^']+)' versionCode='([^']+)' versionName='([^']+)'", badging)
    if not package or package[1] != PACKAGES[module][1] or "application-debuggable" not in badging:
        raise ValueError("Only isolated debuggable L0 packages may be retained here")
    signature = subprocess.check_output([str(sdk / "apksigner"), "verify", "--verbose", "--print-certs", str(apk)], text=True)
    certificates = re.findall(r"certificate SHA-256 digest: ([0-9a-f]+)", signature)
    if len(certificates) != 1 or certificates[0] == PRODUCTION_CERT:
        raise ValueError("Expected one development certificate, never the production signer")
    return apk, {
        "module": module, "application_id": package[1], "version_code": int(package[2]),
        "version_name": package[3], "variant": metadata["variantName"],
        "signing_certificate_sha256": certificates[0], "apk_sha256": sha(apk),
        "bytes": apk.stat().st_size,
        "output_modified_utc": datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(apk.stat().st_mtime, datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "gradle_output": str(apk.relative_to(ROOT)), "badging": badging, "signature_verification": signature,
    }


def main():
    before = source_identity()
    sdk_root = os.environ.get("ANDROID_HOME") or os.environ.get("ANDROID_SDK_ROOT")
    if not sdk_root:
        raise ValueError("Set ANDROID_HOME; this command does not install SDK tools")
    sdk = Path(sdk_root) / "build-tools/36.0.0"
    outputs = [inspect(module, sdk) for module in PACKAGES]
    parent = ROOT / "builds/development" / before["commit"]
    parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    # A new exclusive directory preserves previous retained builds, including dirty-source builds.
    stage = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=".staging-", dir=parent))
    timestamp = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S.%fZ")
    final = parent / (timestamp + "-" + before["worktree_sha256"][:12])
    manifest = {
        "source": before, "retained_at_utc": timestamp,
        "qualification": "UNQUALIFIED_DEVELOPMENT_COPY; consult validation receipts",
        "build_command": "existing Gradle :app:assembleDebug :phone:assembleDebug :calendar:assembleDebug",
        "production_release": False, "artifacts": [],
    }
    for apk, record in outputs:
        filename = "TenSeven-" + PACKAGES[record["module"]][0] + "-L0-debug.apk"
        destination = stage / filename
        shutil.copyfile(apk, destination)
        if sha(destination) != record["apk_sha256"] or sha(apk) != record["apk_sha256"]:
            raise ValueError("APK changed during retention")
        record["retained_filename"] = filename
        manifest["artifacts"].append(record)
    if source_identity() != before:
        raise ValueError("Source changed during retention")
    (stage / "BUILD_MANIFEST.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n")
    sums = [sha(path) + "  " + path.name for path in sorted(stage.iterdir())]
    (stage / "SHA256SUMS.txt").write_text("\n".join(sums) + "\n")
    if final.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(final)
    stage.rename(final)
    print(final)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Tabler Icons for Tenseven: import, generate, check.

Tenseven draws its glyphs from the Tabler Icons outline set (MIT), pinned in
third_party/tabler-icons. This script has three jobs:

  import --from DIR    Copy the SVGs Tenseven uses, byte for byte, from an extracted
                       @tabler/icons npm package (DIR contains icons/outline/*.svg) into
                       third_party/tabler-icons/icons/outline and rewrite ICON_MANIFEST.tsv.
  generate             Write the Kotlin glyph table (TablerGlyphPaths.kt) and the launcher
                       icon vectors from the verbatim SVGs.
  check                Write nothing; exit 1 if the manifest, the SVGs or the generated
                       files are out of date. CI runs this (tests/run.sh).

Which icons are used is read from the code: every AppGlyph("tabler-name", ...) entry in
AppGlyphs.kt, plus EXTRA_ICONS below (the launcher icon). Adding a glyph is: add the name
to AppGlyphs.kt, run `import --from <package dir>`, then `generate`.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import os
import re
import shutil
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
TABLER = os.path.join(ROOT, "third_party", "tabler-icons")
SVG_DIR = os.path.join(TABLER, "icons", "outline")
MANIFEST = os.path.join(TABLER, "ICON_MANIFEST.tsv")
APP_GLYPHS = os.path.join(ROOT, "app", "src", "main", "java", "io", "github", "aimindseye", "tenseven", "model", "AppGlyphs.kt")
KOTLIN_OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "app", "src", "main", "java", "io", "github", "aimindseye", "tenseven", "model", "TablerGlyphPaths.kt")
RES = os.path.join(ROOT, "app", "src", "main", "res")

# Icons used outside AppGlyph: name -> why.
EXTRA_ICONS = {"keyboard": "launcher icon (adaptive icon foreground)"}

# Launcher icon (Tenseven's own look, not SableOS's): deep navy, white Tabler glyph, amber dot.
ICON_NAME = "ic_tenseven"
ICON_GLYPH = "keyboard"
ICON_BG = "#0E1726"
ICON_FG = "#F4F6FA"
ICON_ACCENT = "#F2A93B"
CANVAS = 108.0
GLYPH_BOX = 40.0  # dp the 24-unit Tabler box is scaled to; the 66 dp safe zone holds it
GLYPH_SCALE = GLYPH_BOX / 24.0
GLYPH_OFFSET = (CANVAS - GLYPH_BOX) / 2.0

SVG_NS = "{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}"
NAME_RE = re.compile(
    r'^\s+[A-Z_0-9]+\("([a-z0-9-]+)",\s*(?:0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+|GLYPH_ACCENT_[A-Z0-9_]+)\s*\)',
    re.M,
)


def sha256(path):
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        return hashlib.sha256(f.read()).hexdigest()


def used_icons():
    with open(APP_GLYPHS, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        names = set(NAME_RE.findall(f.read()))
    if not names:
        sys.exit("no AppGlyph entries found in " + APP_GLYPHS)
    return sorted(names | set(EXTRA_ICONS))


def manifest_rows(names):
    rows = ["icon\tsvg_sha256\tused_for"]
    glyph_names = set(NAME_RE.findall(open(APP_GLYPHS, encoding="utf-8").read()))
    for n in names:
        svg = os.path.join(SVG_DIR, n + ".svg")
        digest = sha256(svg) if os.path.exists(svg) else "MISSING"
        why = EXTRA_ICONS.get(n, "AppGlyph")
        if n in glyph_names and n in EXTRA_ICONS:
            why = "AppGlyph; " + why
        rows.append("%s\t%s\t%s" % (n, digest, why))
    return "\n".join(rows) + "\n"


def shape_to_path(el):
    """Tabler 3.x draws everything as <path>; the other shapes are converted for safety."""
    tag = el.tag.replace(SVG_NS, "")
    a = el.attrib
    if tag == "path":
        return a["d"]
    if tag == "circle":
        cx, cy, r = float(a["cx"]), float(a["cy"]), float(a["r"])
        return "M%g %ga%g %g 0 1 0 %g 0a%g %g 0 1 0 %g 0" % (cx - r, cy, r, r, 2 * r, r, r, -2 * r)
    if tag == "line":
        return "M%s %sL%s %s" % (a["x1"], a["y1"], a["x2"], a["y2"])
    if tag == "polyline":
        pts = a["points"].replace(",", " ").split()
        return "M" + " ".join(pts[:2]) + "L" + " ".join(pts[2:])
    if tag == "rect":
        x, y, w, h = (float(a.get(k, 0)) for k in ("x", "y", "width", "height"))
        return "M%g %gh%gv%gh%gz" % (x, y, w, h, -w)
    raise SystemExit("unsupported SVG element <%s> in a Tabler icon" % tag)


def icon_paths(name):
    """The drawable path data of one icon, one string per element (the 24x24 bounding box is skipped)."""
    svg = os.path.join(SVG_DIR, name + ".svg")
    if not os.path.exists(svg):
        raise SystemExit("missing SVG: %s (run: tools/tabler_icons.py import --from <package dir>)" % svg)
    root = ET.parse(svg).getroot()
    out = []
    for el in root:
        if el.attrib.get("stroke") == "none":
            continue
        out.append(shape_to_path(el))
    if not out:
        raise SystemExit("no drawable elements in " + svg)
    return out


def kotlin_table():
    glyph_names = sorted(set(NAME_RE.findall(open(APP_GLYPHS, encoding="utf-8").read())) | set(EXTRA_ICONS))
    lines = [
        "// GENERATED by tools/tabler_icons.py from third_party/tabler-icons. Do not edit; run the tool.",
        "// Tabler Icons: MIT, Copyright (c) 2020-2026 Pawel Kuna. See third_party/tabler-icons/LICENSE.",
        "package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model",
        "",
        "/**",
        " * Tabler outline icon geometry: 24 x 24 box, drawn with a 2 unit round-capped stroke. One string per",
        " * SVG element (never joined, because a relative moveto starts from the previous element's last point).",
        " */",
        "internal object TablerGlyphPaths {",
        "    const val VIEWPORT = 24f",
        "    const val STROKE = 2f",
        "",
        "    val BY_NAME: Map<String, List<String>> =",
        "        mapOf(",
    ]
    for n in glyph_names:
        elems = ",\n".join('                "%s"' % d.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"') for d in icon_paths(n))
        lines.append('            "%s" to\n            listOf(\n%s,\n            ),' % (n, elems))
    lines += ["        )", "}", ""]
    return "\n".join(lines)


def vector(width_dp, body):
    return (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n'
        '<!-- GENERATED by tools/tabler_icons.py. Do not edit. -->\n'
        '<vector xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"\n'
        '    android:width="%gdp"\n    android:height="%gdp"\n'
        '    android:viewportWidth="%g"\n    android:viewportHeight="%g">\n%s</vector>\n'
    ) % (width_dp, width_dp, CANVAS, CANVAS, body)


def glyph_group(color, glyph=ICON_GLYPH):
    paths = "".join(
        '        <path\n            android:pathData="%s"\n            android:strokeColor="%s"\n'
        '            android:strokeWidth="2"\n            android:strokeLineCap="round"\n'
        '            android:strokeLineJoin="round" />\n' % (d, color)
        for d in icon_paths(glyph)
    )
    return (
        '    <group\n        android:scaleX="%g"\n        android:scaleY="%g"\n'
        '        android:translateX="%g"\n        android:translateY="%g">\n%s    </group>\n'
        % (GLYPH_SCALE, GLYPH_SCALE, GLYPH_OFFSET, GLYPH_OFFSET, paths)
    )


def launcher_files(icon_name=ICON_NAME, glyph=ICON_GLYPH):
    accent = (
        '    <path\n        android:fillColor="%s"\n'
        '        android:pathData="M54,76m-2.5,0a2.5,2.5 0 1,1 5,0a2.5,2.5 0 1,1 -5,0" />\n' % ICON_ACCENT
    )
    adaptive = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n'
        '<!-- GENERATED by tools/tabler_icons.py. Do not edit. -->\n'
        '<adaptive-icon xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">\n'
        '    <background android:drawable="@drawable/%(n)s_background" />\n'
        '    <foreground android:drawable="@drawable/%(n)s_foreground" />\n'
        '    <monochrome android:drawable="@drawable/%(n)s_monochrome" />\n'
        '</adaptive-icon>\n' % {"n": icon_name}
    )
    background = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>\n'
        '<!-- GENERATED by tools/tabler_icons.py. Do not edit. -->\n'
        '<vector xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"\n'
        '    android:width="108dp"\n    android:height="108dp"\n'
        '    android:viewportWidth="108"\n    android:viewportHeight="108">\n'
        '    <path\n        android:fillColor="%s"\n        android:pathData="M0,0h108v108h-108z" />\n</vector>\n' % ICON_BG
    )
    return {
        "drawable/%s_background.xml" % icon_name: background,
        "drawable/%s_foreground.xml" % icon_name: vector(108, glyph_group(ICON_FG, glyph) + accent),
        "drawable/%s_monochrome.xml" % icon_name: vector(108, glyph_group("#FF000000", glyph)),
        "mipmap-anydpi/%s.xml" % icon_name: adaptive,
        "mipmap-anydpi/%s_round.xml" % icon_name: adaptive,
    }


def generated():
    names = used_icons()
    files = {os.path.relpath(KOTLIN_OUT, ROOT): kotlin_table()}
    for rel, text in launcher_files().items():
        files[os.path.relpath(os.path.join(RES, rel), ROOT)] = text
    files[os.path.relpath(MANIFEST, ROOT)] = manifest_rows(names)
    return files


def cmd_import(args):
    src = os.path.join(args.source, "icons", "outline")
    if not os.path.isdir(src):
        sys.exit("not an extracted @tabler/icons package: " + src)
    os.makedirs(SVG_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    for old in os.listdir(SVG_DIR):
        if old.endswith(".svg"):
            os.remove(os.path.join(SVG_DIR, old))
    for n in used_icons():
        f = os.path.join(src, n + ".svg")
        if not os.path.exists(f):
            sys.exit("Tabler has no outline icon named '%s' (see AppGlyphs.kt)" % n)
        shutil.copyfile(f, os.path.join(SVG_DIR, n + ".svg"))
    print("imported %d icons" % len(used_icons()))
    cmd_generate(args)


def cmd_generate(_args):
    for rel, text in generated().items():
        path = os.path.join(ROOT, rel)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
            f.write(text)
        print("wrote", rel)


def cmd_check(_args):
    bad = 0
    names = used_icons()
    present = {f[:-4] for f in os.listdir(SVG_DIR)} if os.path.isdir(SVG_DIR) else set()
    for n in sorted(set(names) - present):
        print("FAIL missing SVG:", n)
        bad += 1
    for n in sorted(present - set(names)):
        print("FAIL unused SVG (remove it or use it):", n)
        bad += 1
    if bad:
        return 1
    for rel, text in generated().items():
        path = os.path.join(ROOT, rel)
        if not os.path.exists(path):
            print("FAIL missing generated file:", rel)
            bad += 1
        elif open(path, encoding="utf-8").read() != text:
            print("FAIL out of date (run tools/tabler_icons.py generate):", rel)
            bad += 1
    if not bad:
        print("PASS tabler icons: %d icons, manifest and generated files current" % len(names))
    return 1 if bad else 0


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    i = sub.add_parser("import")
    i.add_argument("--from", dest="source", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("generate")
    sub.add_parser("check")
    args = p.parse_args()
    rc = {"import": cmd_import, "generate": cmd_generate, "check": cmd_check}[args.cmd](args)
    sys.exit(rc or 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model

import kotlin.math.abs

/** Only an inward horizontal drag at Home's left edge belongs to Peek. */
internal object HubPeekGesture {
    const val EDGE_DP = 32
    const val EXCLUSION_DP = 200

    fun startsAtEdge(
        x: Float,
        edge: Float,
    ): Boolean = x >= 0f && x <= edge

    fun opens(
        dx: Float,
        dy: Float,
        slop: Float,
    ): Boolean = slop > 0f && dx > slop && dx > abs(dy)

    fun cancels(
        dx: Float,
        dy: Float,
        slop: Float,
    ): Boolean = abs(dy) > slop && abs(dy) > abs(dx)
}

"""Offline regressions plus opt-in qualification against actual Gradle reports."""

import importlib.util
from collections import Counter
from contextlib import ExitStack, redirect_stdout
from dataclasses import replace
import io
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import stat
import time
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
from xml.sax.saxutils import escape

SOURCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "deliverable_quality_gate.py"
sys.path.insert(0, str(SOURCE.parent))
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("tenseven_quality_gate", SOURCE)
GATE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
SPEC.loader.exec_module(GATE)
import quality_gate_runtime as RUNTIME
import quality_gate_policy as POLICY


class RepositoryFixture(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.repo = Path(self.tmp.name) / "repo"
        self.base_repo = Path(self.tmp.name) / "base"
        for root in (self.repo, self.base_repo):
            for module in ("app", "design"):
                (root / module / "src/main/java").mkdir(parents=True)
                (root / module / "src/main/java/Example.kt").write_text("fun BadName() = Unit\n")
                (root / module / "build.gradle.kts").write_text("plugins {}\n")
        for args in (("init", "-q"), ("config", "user.email", "test@example.invalid"),
                     ("config", "user.name", "Fixture"), ("add", "."), ("commit", "-qm", "base")):
            subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(self.repo), *args], check=True)
        self.base = GATE.GitRepository(self.repo).head()
        self.source = "app/src/main/java/Example.kt"


class DeliveryQualityTests(RepositoryFixture):
    def finding(self, **changes):
        item = {"family": "detekt", "file": self.source, "line": 1, "column": 5,
                "rule": "detekt.FunctionNaming", "message": "bad name", "severity": "warning",
                "report": "app/build/reports/detekt/detekt.xml"}
        return {**item, **changes}

    def compare(self, old, new):
        return GATE.compare_findings(old, new, self.base_repo, self.repo)

    def make_reports(self):
        for family, paths in GATE.report_paths(self.repo).items():
            for path in paths:
                path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                path.write_text('<issues />' if family == 'lint' else '<checkstyle />')

    def test_unchanged_compose_naming_finding_is_baseline(self):
        # The comparator does not exempt the naming rule, even for Compose.
        old = [self.finding()]
        added, existing = self.compare(old, old)
        self.assertEqual([], added)
        self.assertEqual(1, len(existing))

    def test_inserted_lines_do_not_manufacture_new_findings(self):
        (self.repo / self.source).write_text("// added\nfun BadName() = Unit\n")
        added, existing = self.compare([self.finding()], [self.finding(line=2)])
        self.assertEqual([], added)
        self.assertEqual(1, existing[0]['baseline_line'])

    def test_manifest_finding_survives_unrelated_activity_addition(self):
        filename = 'app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml'
        old = '<manifest>\n<uses-permission android:name="READ_MEDIA_IMAGES" />\n</manifest>\n'
        (self.base_repo / filename).write_text(old)
        (self.repo / filename).write_text(old.replace('</manifest>', '<activity />\n</manifest>'))
        item = self.finding(family='lint', file=filename, line=2, rule='SelectedPhotoAccess')
        self.assertEqual([], self.compare([item], [item])[0])

    def test_new_file_cannot_borrow_identical_baseline_debt(self):
        (self.repo / 'app/src/main/java/New.kt').write_text('fun BadName() = Unit\n')
        item = self.finding(file='app/src/main/java/New.kt')
        self.assertEqual([item], self.compare([self.finding()], [item])[0])

    def test_changed_rule_message_severity_column_or_source_is_new(self):
        for changes in ({'rule': 'detekt.MagicNumber'}, {'message': 'worse'},
                        {'severity': 'error'}, {'column': 8}):
            with self.subTest(changes=changes):
                item = self.finding(**changes)
                self.assertEqual([item], self.compare([self.finding()], [item])[0])
        (self.repo / self.source).write_text('fun AnotherBadName() = Unit\n')
        self.assertEqual(1, len(self.compare([self.finding()], [self.finding()])[0]))

    def test_duplicate_finding_cannot_reuse_baseline_allowance(self):
        item = self.finding()
        self.assertEqual([item], self.compare([item], [item, item])[0])

    def test_metric_may_improve_but_not_worsen(self):
        def item(size):
            return self.finding(rule='detekt.LongMethod', message=f'Function is too long ({size}). Maximum: 60')
        self.assertEqual([], self.compare([item(70)], [item(65)])[0])
        self.assertEqual([item(71)], self.compare([item(70)], [item(71)])[0])
        self.assertEqual(1, len(self.compare([item(70)], [self.finding(rule='detekt.LongMethod', message='Maximum: 80')])[0]))

    def test_new_compose_function_is_never_filtered_by_comparator(self):
        self.assertEqual([self.finding()], self.compare([], [self.finding()])[0])

    def test_binary_asset_file_level_lint_finding_requires_identical_bytes(self):
        filename = 'app/src/main/icon.png'
        for root in (self.base_repo, self.repo):
            (root / filename).write_bytes(b'\x89PNG\r\n')
        item = self.finding(family='lint', file=filename, line=0, rule='IconDensities')
        self.assertEqual([], self.compare([item], [item])[0])
        (self.repo / filename).write_bytes(b'\x89PNG\r\nchanged')
        self.assertEqual([item], self.compare([item], [item])[0])

    def test_all_module_reports_required(self):
        self.make_reports()
        issues, inventory = GATE.check_quality_reports(self.repo, 0)
        self.assertEqual([], issues)
        self.assertEqual(8, len(inventory))
        (self.repo / 'design/build/reports/detekt/detekt.xml').unlink()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(GATE.QualityError, 'Missing required report'):
            GATE.check_quality_reports(self.repo, 0)

    def test_missing_source_set_report_fails_closed(self):
        self.make_reports()
        path = self.repo / 'app/src/test/java/ExampleTest.kt'
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        path.write_text('class ExampleTest\n')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(GATE.QualityError, 'Missing required report'):
            GATE.check_quality_reports(self.repo, 0)

    def test_stale_reports_fail_closed(self):
        self.make_reports()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(GATE.QualityError, 'Stale report'):
            GATE.check_quality_reports(self.repo, time.time() + 10)

    def test_malformed_or_wrong_family_schema_fails_closed(self):
        path = self.repo / 'bad.xml'
        for text, family in (('<unknown />', 'lint'), ('<issues />', 'detekt'),
                             ('<checkstyle><file><error /></file></checkstyle>', 'detekt'),
                             ('<issues><issue id="X" /></issues>', 'lint')):
            path.write_text(text)
            with self.subTest(text=text), self.assertRaises(GATE.QualityError):
                GATE.parse_xml_report(self.repo, path, family)

    def test_primary_lint_location_is_counted_once(self):
        path = self.repo / 'lint.xml'
        source = escape(str(self.repo / self.source))
        path.write_text(f'<issues><issue id="X" message="x" severity="Warning"><location file="{source}" line="1" /><location file="{source}" line="1" /></issue></issues>')
        self.assertEqual(1, len(GATE.parse_xml_report(self.repo, path, 'lint')))

    def test_outside_or_unavailable_source_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(GATE.QualityError):
            GATE.relative_path(self.repo, '/elsewhere/Other.kt')
        path = self.repo / 'bad.xml'
        path.write_text('<checkstyle><file name="Missing.kt"><error line="1" source="X" message="x" severity="warning" /></file></checkstyle>')
        with self.assertRaises(GATE.QualityError):
            GATE.parse_xml_report(self.repo, path, 'detekt')

    def test_changed_paths_include_untracked_staged_and_deleted(self):
        (self.repo / self.source).unlink()

        merge = subprocess.check_output(
            ['git', '-C', str(self.repo), 'commit-tree', tree, '-p', self.base, '-p', descendant],
            input=b'synthetic CI merge after activation\n',
        ).decode().strip()
        with patch.object(self.git, 'head', return_value=merge):
            self.assert_entry_points_accept_activation(parent, origin)

# SonarQube Cloud, CI-based analysis (.github/workflows/sonar.yml).
# Automatic Analysis must be turned off in the project's settings, or the scan is refused.
# JVM tests, Android instrumentation tests and tests/ are test sources: classify them as tests
# so Python test harness lines do not dilute new-code coverage.
sonar.organization=aimindseye
sonar.projectKey=aimindseye_tenseven-launcher
sonar.projectName=Tenseven Launcher

sonar.sources=.
sonar.tests=app/src/test,app/src/androidTest,design/src/test,phone/src/test,calendar/src/test,tests
sonar.test.inclusions=**/src/test/**,**/src/androidTest/**,tests/**
sonar.exclusions=**/*.png,**/*.jpg,**/*.jpeg,**/*.webp,**/*.gif,**/*.ico,**/*.ttf,**/*.otf,**/src/test/**,**/src/androidTest/**,tests/**,**/build/**,**/.gradle/**,third_party/**,**/TablerGlyphPaths.kt,gradle/wrapper/**,**/*.pdf,**/*.woff,**/*.woff2
sonar.sourceEncoding=UTF-8
sonar.python.version=3.12

# CI-R4 coverage scope: JVM Kover does not execute Android Telecom, CalendarProvider, ContentResolver or Compose UI seams. Pure policies remain covered. 80% new-code gate remains unchanged.
# Coverage comes from the Kover XML reports the Sonar workflow builds. Left out of the coverage measure:
# - Compose screens and sections, the generated Tabler glyph data, and the launcher theme (no JVM test can draw them);
# - Android platform glue: Activities, Services, receivers, system repositories, the icon pack loader and registry,
#   the sound profile applier, the notes controller, setup status, conversation access and its state store, the
#   game key handler, and the Hub's PendingIntent code (ConversationHub; its grouping and counting functions have tests);
# - the translatable string tables (*Text.kt), which are data;
# - the Python tools under tools/, which no coverage report covers.
# The testable logic (model, privacy, notes, games, calculator...) stays measured.
sonar.coverage.exclusions=**/ui/**,**/platform/**,**/*Activity.kt,**/*Activities.kt,**/*Service.kt,**/*Receiver.kt,design/**,**/extras/**/ui/**,**/extras/profiles/MainActivity.kt,**/*Screen.kt,**/*Screens.kt,**/SettingsSections.kt,**/extras/games/GameFrame.kt,**/extras/games/GameKeyHandler.kt,**/TablerGlyphPaths.kt,**/LauncherTheme.kt,**/iconpacks/IconPackLoader.kt,**/iconpacks/IconPacks.kt,**/extras/profiles/SoundProfileApplier.kt,**/extras/notes/NotesController.kt,**/onboarding/SetupStatus.kt,**/conversations/ConversationAccess.kt,**/conversations/ConversationStateStore.kt,**/conversations/ConversationHub.kt,**/*Text.kt,tools/**,**/D5BbDialogs.kt,**/D5PhoneRoleSetting.kt,**/TenSeven2AppTheme.kt,**/Settings2VisualTheme.kt,**/features/phone/TenSevenPhoneData.kt,**/features/phone/TenSevenTelecom.kt,**/features/calendar/D5CalendarRepository.kt

# Translatable string tables (key to English, one per line) read as copy-paste to CPD because every
# line has the same shape, and the translations of the same strings. They are data, not duplicated logic.
# The generated static design comparison repeats fixture markup; keep CSS/accessibility analysis enabled.
sonar.cpd.exclusions=**/*Text.kt,**/*TextTest.kt,**/*Lines.kt,**/*LinesTest.kt,**/res/values*/strings.xml,docs/design/bb10-device-review/index.html

package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.phone

import android.app.Activity
import android.content.Intent
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView

/** Named presentation/protocol values; numeric values unchanged from the reviewed source. */
private const val DIALPAD_ON_CREATE_RGB_173 = 173
private const val DIALPAD_ON_CREATE_RGB_18 = 18
private const val DIALPAD_ON_CREATE_RGB_239 = 239
private const val DIALPAD_ON_CREATE_RGB_31 = 31
private const val DIALPAD_ON_CREATE_RGB_45 = 45

private object DialpadMetrics {
    const val SIDE_DP = 18
    const val TOP_DP = 9
    const val BOTTOM_DP = 11
    const val NUMBER_HEIGHT_DP = 48
    const val KEY_TEXT_SP = 25f
    const val KEY_HEIGHT_DP = 47
    const val ACTION_TEXT_SP = 17f
    const val ACTION_HEIGHT_DP = 46
}

/** An opt-in dialog-sized floating keypad; no SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW privilege or system overlay claimed. */
class TenSevenFloatingDialpadActivity : Activity() {
    private fun dp(n: Int) = (n * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()

    /** Reuse the same dialpad key layout without inflating Activity.onCreate. */
    private fun addDigitKeys(
        root: LinearLayout,
        number: EditText,
    ) {
        listOf("123", "456", "789", "*0#").forEach { symbols ->
            val line = LinearLayout(this)
            root.addView(line)
            symbols.forEach { digit ->
                val key =
                    TextView(this).apply {
                        text = digit.toString()
                        textSize = DialpadMetrics.KEY_TEXT_SP
                        setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
                        gravity = Gravity.CENTER
                        setOnClickListener { number.append(digit.toString()) }
                    }
                line.addView(key, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, dp(DialpadMetrics.KEY_HEIGHT_DP), 1f))
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        window.setLayout(WindowManager.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
        window.setGravity(Gravity.BOTTOM)
        val root =
            LinearLayout(this).apply {
                orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
                setPadding(
                    dp(DialpadMetrics.SIDE_DP),
                    dp(DialpadMetrics.TOP_DP),
                    dp(DialpadMetrics.SIDE_DP),
                    dp(DialpadMetrics.BOTTOM_DP),
                )
                setBackgroundColor(
                    Color.rgb(
                        DIALPAD_ON_CREATE_RGB_18,
                        DIALPAD_ON_CREATE_RGB_31,
                        DIALPAD_ON_CREATE_RGB_45,
                    ),
                )
            }
        val number =
            EditText(this).apply {
                hint = "Dial number"
                inputType = android.text.InputType.TYPE_CLASS_PHONE
                setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
                setHintTextColor(Color.LTGRAY)
            }
        number.showSoftInputOnFocus = false
        root.addView(number, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, dp(DialpadMetrics.NUMBER_HEIGHT_DP)))
        addDigitKeys(root, number)
        val place =
            TextView(this).apply {
                text =
                    this@TenSevenFloatingDialpadActivity.getString(
                        io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.phone.R.string.tenseven_float_open_dialer,
                    )
                textSize = DialpadMetrics.ACTION_TEXT_SP
                setTextColor(Color.rgb(0, DIALPAD_ON_CREATE_RGB_173, DIALPAD_ON_CREATE_RGB_239))
                gravity = Gravity.CENTER
                setOnClickListener {
                    val target =
                        Intent(Intent.ACTION_DIAL, Uri.fromParts("tel", number.text.toString(), null))
                            .setClass(this@TenSevenFloatingDialpadActivity, TenSevenPhoneActivity::class.java)
                    startActivity(target)
                    finish()
                }
            }
        root.addView(place, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, dp(DialpadMetrics.ACTION_HEIGHT_DP)))
        setContentView(root)
    }
}

package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.platform

import android.app.Activity
import android.graphics.Color
import android.util.Log
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowInsets
import androidx.core.view.ViewCompat
import androidx.core.view.WindowCompat
import androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat
import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model.D5ScreenFitPolicy

/**
 * Explicit safe-viewport boundary for TenSeven's View-based activities.
 *
 * Do NOT apply this blindly to Compose roots (which may already use safeDrawingPadding),
 * wallpaper-backed Home, lock-screen covers or deliberately immersive screens.
 * These need individual inset ownership checks to avoid double padding.
 *
 * Invariant: the root's content begins below system bars and display cutouts,
 * and fixed bottom controls sit above Android gesture/three-button navigation.
 * Root background still paints behind transparent bars for BB10 dark appearance.
 */
object TenSevenSafeViewport {
    fun darkSystemBars(activity: Activity) {
        activity.window.decorView.setBackgroundColor(Color.BLACK)
        WindowCompat.getInsetsController(activity.window, activity.window.decorView).apply {
            isAppearanceLightStatusBars = false
            isAppearanceLightNavigationBars = false
        }
    }

    fun show(
        activity: Activity,
        root: View,
    ) {
        // Required for targetSdk 35+: edge-to-edge is enforced by Android.
        WindowCompat.setDecorFitsSystemWindows(activity.window, false)
        darkSystemBars(activity)
        val left = root.paddingLeft
        val top = root.paddingTop
        val right = root.paddingRight
        val bottom = root.paddingBottom
        ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(root) { view, insets ->
            val safe =
                insets.getInsets(
                    WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars() or WindowInsetsCompat.Type.displayCutout(),
                )
            val targetLeft = left + safe.left
            val targetTop = top + safe.top
            val targetRight = right + safe.right
            val targetBottom = bottom + safe.bottom
            val horizontalChanged = view.paddingLeft != targetLeft || view.paddingRight != targetRight
            val verticalChanged = view.paddingTop != targetTop || view.paddingBottom != targetBottom
            if (horizontalChanged || verticalChanged) {
                view.setPadding(targetLeft, targetTop, targetRight, targetBottom)
            }
            // Do not consume: child controls and IME handlers may also need insets.
            insets
        }
        activity.setContentView(root)
        Log.i("TenSevenD5R8", "${activity.javaClass.simpleName}: safe viewport enabled")
        ViewCompat.requestApplyInsets(root)
    }

    /**
     * Select Titan 2 / Q25 sizing from current window bounds *minus* system bars,
     * rather than DisplayMetrics height (which includes system bars on Android 15+).
     */
    fun fit(activity: Activity): D5ScreenFitPolicy.Fit {
        val metrics = activity.windowManager.currentWindowMetrics
        val safe =
            metrics.windowInsets.getInsets(
                WindowInsets.Type.systemBars() or WindowInsets.Type.displayCutout(),
            )
        val density = activity.resources.displayMetrics.density
        val width = (metrics.bounds.width() - safe.left - safe.right).coerceAtLeast(1)
        val height = (metrics.bounds.height() - safe.top - safe.bottom).coerceAtLeast(1)
        return D5ScreenFitPolicy.forViewport(width / density, height / density)
    }
}

package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.platform

import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.notes.core.Note
import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.notes.core.NoteStore
import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.notes.core.NoteText
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder

class LegacyNoteSummariesTest {
    @get:Rule
    val folder = TemporaryFolder()

    @Test
    fun summariesReadExistingNotesWithoutRewritingData() {
        val note = Note(NoteStore.newId(), "# Existing title\n- [ ] Keep this task\nUnicode café", CREATED, UPDATED)
        val store = NoteStore(folder.root)
        store.save(note)
        val before =
            folder.root
                .listFiles()
                .orEmpty()
                .associate { it.name to it.readBytes().toList() }
        val summary = LegacyNoteSummaries.latest(folder.root)
        assertEquals(NoteText.title(note.body), summary?.title)
        assertEquals(NoteText.preview(note.body), summary?.preview)
        assertEquals(UPDATED, summary?.updatedAt)
        val after =
            folder.root
                .listFiles()
                .orEmpty()
                .associate { it.name to it.readBytes().toList() }
        assertEquals(before, after)
    }

    @Test
    fun missingOrMalformedDataNeverCreatesOrDeletesFiles() {
        val missing = folder.root.resolve("missing")
        assertNull(LegacyNoteSummaries.latest(missing))
        assertEquals(false, missing.exists())
        folder.root.resolve("bad.note").writeText("not a note")
        assertNull(LegacyNoteSummaries.latest(folder.root))
        assertEquals("not a note", folder.root.resolve("bad.note").readText())
    }

    private companion object {
        const val CREATED = 100L
        const val UPDATED = 200L
    }
}

name: Active Frames UI
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'app/**'
      - 'gradle/**'
      - '.github/workflows/frames-ui.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: frames-ui-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  instrumented:
    name: instrumented (API ${{ matrix.api }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        api: [34, 35]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 35
    env:
      ANDROID_USER_HOME: /tmp/tenseven-frames-android
      ANDROID_AVD_HOME: /tmp/tenseven-frames-android/avd
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-java@b843ebf9b913146b38da2eaa7aeddf76074ae1ad # v6.1.0
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@3f5f9adaf7d9fecd50b5935e54106014257a94e6 # v6.4.0
      - name: Install Android SDK and emulator
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sdkmanager="$(find "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools" -type f -name sdkmanager -print -quit)"
          test -n "$sdkmanager"
          yes | "$sdkmanager" --licenses > /dev/null || true
          "$sdkmanager" 'platforms;android-36' 'build-tools;36.0.0' platform-tools emulator 'system-images;android-${{ matrix.api }};default;x86_64'
          mkdir -p "$ANDROID_AVD_HOME"
          avdmanager="$(dirname "$sdkmanager")/avdmanager"
          echo no | "$avdmanager" create avd --name frames-ci --package 'system-images;android-${{ matrix.api }};default;x86_64' --force
          sudo chown "$(id -u)" /dev/kvm
      - name: Compile instrumentation APKs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          build=(./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain :app:assembleDebug :app:assembleDebugAndroidTest)
          if "${build[@]}" 2>&1 | tee /tmp/p2-test-compile.log; then
            exit 0
          fi
          # A repository miss can be cached by Gradle. Retry resolution once, preserving failures.
          if ! grep -Eq 'Could not (find|resolve) ' /tmp/p2-test-compile.log; then
            exit 1
          fi
          "${build[@]}" --refresh-dependencies
      - name: Run frame layout, keyboard and persistence tests
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          "$ANDROID_HOME/emulator/emulator" -avd frames-ci -no-window -no-audio -no-boot-anim -gpu swiftshader_indirect -no-snapshot > /tmp/frames-emulator.log 2>&1 &
          emulator_pid=$!
          trap 'kill "$emulator_pid" || true; cat /tmp/frames-emulator.log' EXIT
          export PATH="$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:$PATH"
          timeout 120 adb wait-for-device
          timeout 240 bash -c 'until [[ "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed | tr -d "\r")" == 1 ]]; do sleep 2; done'
          adb shell wm size 720x720
          adb shell wm density 280
          adb shell settings put global window_animation_scale 0
          adb shell settings put global transition_animation_scale 0
          adb shell settings put global animator_duration_scale 0
          adb shell input keyevent 82
          ./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest
          for apk in app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk app/build/outputs/apk/androidTest/debug/*.apk; do
            test -f "$apk"
            adb install -r -t "$apk"
          done
          adb shell am instrument -w -e class io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.ProcessReentryTest -e p2Phase seed io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.debug.l0.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner | tee /tmp/p2-process-seed.log
          adb shell am force-stop io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.debug.l0
          adb shell am instrument -w -e class io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.ProcessReentryTest -e p2Phase verify io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.debug.l0.test/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner | tee /tmp/p2-process-verify.log
          python3 - <<'PYTEST'
          from pathlib import Path
          for phase in ('seed', 'verify'):
              assert 'OK (1 test)' in Path(f'/tmp/p2-process-{phase}.log').read_text(), phase
          print('P2_PROCESS_REENTRY=PASS: persisted frame/style verified across force-stop and a different PID')
          PYTEST
      - name: Upload UI test evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: frames-ui-reports-api-${{ matrix.api }}
          path: |
            app/build/reports/androidTests/
            app/build/outputs/androidTest-results/
            /tmp/frames-emulator.log
            /tmp/p2-process-*.log
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  responsive:
    name: responsive (${{ matrix.name }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: square-large-text

            density: 280
            font: '2.0'

            size: 1080x2400

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          build=(./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain :app:assembleDebug :app:assembleDebugAndroidTest)
          if "${build[@]}" 2>&1 | tee /tmp/p2-test-compile.log; then
            exit 0
          fi
          # A repository miss can be cached by Gradle. Retry resolution once, preserving failures.
          if ! grep -Eq 'Could not (find|resolve) ' /tmp/p2-test-compile.log; then
            exit 1
          fi
          "${build[@]}" --refresh-dependencies
      - name: Run frame layout, keyboard and persistence tests
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          "$ANDROID_HOME/emulator/emulator" -avd frames-ci -no-window -no-audio -no-boot-anim -gpu swiftshader_indirect -no-snapshot > /tmp/frames-emulator.log 2>&1 &
          emulator_pid=$!
          trap 'adb shell dumpsys window > /tmp/p3-window-final.txt; kill "$emulator_pid" || true; cat /tmp/frames-emulator.log' EXIT
          export PATH="$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:$PATH"
          timeout 120 adb wait-for-device
          timeout 240 bash -c 'until [[ "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed | tr -d "\r")" == 1 ]]; do sleep 2; done'
          adb shell wm size ${{ matrix.size }}
          adb shell wm density ${{ matrix.density }}
          adb shell settings put system font_scale ${{ matrix.font }}
          adb shell settings put global window_animation_scale 0
          adb shell settings put global transition_animation_scale 0
          adb shell settings put global animator_duration_scale 0
          adb shell input keyevent 82
          adb shell dumpsys window > /tmp/p3-window-before.txt
          adb shell dumpsys power > /tmp/p3-power-before.txt
          adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP
          adb shell wm dismiss-keyguard
          adb shell dumpsys window > /tmp/p3-window-after.txt
          ./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.class=io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.ui.P3ResponsiveUiTest,io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.ui.NotificationDisplayUiTest
      - name: Upload UI test evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: p3-responsive-${{ matrix.name }}
          path: |
            app/build/reports/androidTests/
            app/build/outputs/androidTest-results/
            /tmp/frames-emulator.log
            /tmp/p3-*.txt
            /tmp/p2-process-*.log
          if-no-files-found: ignore

<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools">

    <!-- Optional Home weather; normal Internet permission, no GPS or location access. -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET" />
    <!-- Optional foreground approximate device location for Home weather. Never background or fine location. -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION" />

    <!-- Wallpaper-backed Home photo counts (optional; asked for when the user turns that on). -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES" />
    <uses-permission
        android:name="android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE"
        android:maxSdkVersion="32" />

    <!-- Hub page Contacts tab: names, favourites and one number per person, read on the device and never
         stored. Revocable in Settings; the tab then asks again. -->
    <!-- Sets one of Tenseven's own wallpapers when the user picks one in Launcher Settings. A normal permission, granted at install. -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.SET_WALLPAPER" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_CONTACTS" />
    <!-- Only for the optional lock layer: lets it start over the lock screen when the screen wakes. Off until the user turns it on. -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_CALENDAR" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROJECTION" />
    <!-- POST_NOTIFICATIONS is optional; overdue tasks remain in-app without it. -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS" />
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED" />

    <!-- Active Frames recent-apps row. A special-access permission: without this line Android does not list
         Tenseven under Settings, Usage access, and "appops set" is ignored. The user still grants it there. -->


    <!-- Home's native Sound/Vibrate quick control; normal permission, not Do Not Disturb access. -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS" />

    <!-- Lets the user give Tenseven Do Not Disturb access, which Android requires before an app may pick Silent. -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_NOTIFICATION_POLICY" />

    <uses-permission
        android:name="android.permission.PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS"
        tools:ignore="ProtectedPermissions" />

    <!-- All Apps: hand uninstall to the system uninstaller (which confirms again). -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES" />

    <!-- Private Space in All Apps: see the private profile. Android grants this to the default Home app only;
         the system asks for the private space credential itself when unlocking. -->
    <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_HIDDEN_PROFILES" />

    <!--
      Not requested here, on purpose. The SableOS build of Sable Start holds signature permissions
      (INTERACT_ACROSS_USERS, OBSERVE_GRANT_REVOKE_PERMISSIONS, MODIFY_QUIET_MODE, REAL_GET_TASKS, REORDER_TASKS,
      REMOVE_TASKS, START_TASKS_FROM_RECENTS, READ_FRAME_BUFFER, org.sableos.permission.SPEED_DIAL) because it is
      platform-signed. An ordinary install cannot hold them, Android Lint rejects them, and the code that uses
      them already falls back (Active Frames list only this app's tasks, work-profile privacy rows read
      "unavailable"). Replacements built from public APIs are on the roadmap (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).
    -->

    <uses-feature android:name="android.hardware.telephony" android:required="false" />

    <queries>
        <package android:name="io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.phone.debug" />
        <package android:name="io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.calendar.debug" />
        <package android:name="io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.tasks.debug" />
        <package android:name="io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.notes.debug" />
        <package android:name="io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.calculator.debug" />
        <package android:name="io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.profiles.debug" />

        <intent><action android:name="android.appwidget.action.APPWIDGET_UPDATE" /></intent>
        <intent>
            <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
            <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" />
        </intent>
        <!-- Icon packs advertise these actions (Nova and ADW contracts); only used to list packs in Appearance. -->
        <intent>
            <action android:name="com.novalauncher.THEME" />
        </intent>
        <intent>
            <action android:name="org.adw.ActivityStarter.THEMES" />
        </intent>
        <!-- The default apps the BlackBerry 7 home starts with (Calendar, Browser, Gallery, Music, Camera). -->
        <intent>
            <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
            <category android:name="android.intent.category.APP_CALENDAR" />
        </intent>
        <intent>
            <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
            <category android:name="android.intent.category.APP_BROWSER" />
        </intent>
        <intent>
            <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
            <category android:name="android.intent.category.APP_GALLERY" />
        </intent>
        <intent>
            <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
            <category android:name="android.intent.category.APP_MUSIC" />
        </intent>
        <intent>
            <action android:name="android.media.action.IMAGE_CAPTURE" />
        </intent>
        <!-- The phone's default Mail and Contacts apps, found by category for the Hub. -->
        <intent>
            <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
            <category android:name="android.intent.category.APP_EMAIL" />
        </intent>
        <intent>
            <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
            <category android:name="android.intent.category.APP_CONTACTS" />
        </intent>
        <!-- Optional Sable companions: when installed, their live tiles and Hub data appear on Home. -->
        <provider android:authorities="org.sableos.appearance" />
        <provider android:authorities="org.sableos.calendar.snapshot" />
        <provider android:authorities="org.sableos.hub.snapshot" />
        <provider android:authorities="org.sableos.hub.connected_apps" />
        <provider android:authorities="org.sableos.mail.snapshot" />
        <provider android:authorities="org.sableos.media.snapshot" />
        <provider android:authorities="org.sableos.dialer.speeddial" />
        <package android:name="org.sableos.messages" />
        <!-- M2-A proposed companion identities: scoped discovery ONLY, not signer trust. -->
        <package android:name="io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.phone" />
        <package android:name="io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.calendar" />
        <package android:name="io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.tasks" />
        <package android:name="io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.notes" />
        <package android:name="io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.calculator" />
        <package android:name="io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.profiles" />
    </queries>

    <!-- Counts only, same-signature readers. applicationId isolates debug installations. -->
    <permission android:name="${applicationId}.permission.READ_HUB_COUNTS"
        android:protectionLevel="signature" />
    <permission android:name="${applicationId}.permission.WRITE_HUB_COUNTS"
        android:protectionLevel="signature" />

    <application
        android:allowBackup="false"
        android:dataExtractionRules="@xml/data_extraction_rules"
        android:icon="@mipmap/ic_tenseven"
        android:roundIcon="@mipmap/ic_tenseven_round"
        android:label="@string/tenseven_app_name"
        android:supportsRtl="true"
        android:theme="@style/Theme.SableLauncher"
        android:usesCleartextTraffic="false">

        <!-- Optional D5 companions: disabled until the user enables them under Apps & Features.
             Neither requests Android's default Phone role or changes in-call UI. -->

        <receiver android:name=".platform.HubReminderAlarmReceiver" android:exported="false">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.BOOT_COMPLETED" />
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.TIME_SET" />
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.TIMEZONE_CHANGED" />
            </intent-filter>
        </receiver>
        <!-- M2-B: user-initiated companion selection only; no installer capability. -->
        <activity android:name=".CompanionWizardActivity" android:exported="false" />
        <activity android:name=".DeviceCompatibilityActivity" android:exported="false" />

        <activity
            android:name="io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.SableStartActivity"
            android:clearTaskOnLaunch="true"
            android:excludeFromRecents="true"
            android:exported="true"
            android:launchMode="singleTask"
            android:stateNotNeeded="true">

            <intent-filter android:priority="10">
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.HOME" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" />
            </intent-filter>

            <!-- Quick bar and Edit Home entry points. -->
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="org.sableos.start.action.EDIT_QUICK_BAR" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" />
            </intent-filter>
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="org.sableos.start.action.EDIT_HOME" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" />
            </intent-filter>

            <!-- Active Frames: the Recents key on SableOS; reachable from Home on other systems. -->
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="org.sableos.start.action.SHOW_ACTIVE_FRAMES" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" />
            </intent-filter>

            <!-- The Hub page (All, Messages, Calls, Contacts), optionally on a tab
                 (extra org.sableos.start.extra.HUB_FILTER). -->
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="org.sableos.start.action.SHOW_HUB" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" />
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>

        <!-- Home screen style (BlackBerry 10 or BlackBerry 7 layout), opened from setup and Start's menu. -->
        <activity
            android:name="io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.HomeStyleActivity"
            android:excludeFromRecents="true"
            android:exported="true"
            android:label="@string/home_screen_style">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="org.sableos.start.action.CHOOSE_HOME_STYLE" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" />
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>

        <!-- Launcher Settings: style cards, Home, Widgets, Device and Privacy, from the menus of both homes. -->
        <activity
            android:name=".LauncherSettingsActivity"
            android:excludeFromRecents="true"
            android:exported="true"
            android:label="@string/launcher_settings">
            <!-- What "Open" in Android's app info starts (getLaunchIntentForPackage tries INFO before LAUNCHER). Without
                 it the first enabled extra app with a launcher entry, such as Calc Plus, opens instead. INFO adds no icon. -->
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.INFO" />
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>

        <!-- Tenseven's own icon in All Apps (and what "Open" in app info starts): it opens Home. -->
        <activity-alias
            android:name=".LauncherEntry"
            android:exported="true"
            android:label="@string/tenseven_app_name"
            android:targetActivity=".SableStartActivity">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" />
            </intent-filter>
        </activity-alias>

        <!-- Hub settings: clear the Hub, choose which apps feed it, and whether message text may be shown. -->
        <activity
            android:name=".HubSettingsActivity"
            android:excludeFromRecents="true"
            android:exported="false"
            android:label="@string/hub_settings" />

        <!-- The optional lock layer: a BlackBerry-style cover over the system lock screen. The real lock stays underneath. -->
        <activity
            android:name=".LockLayerActivity"
            android:excludeFromRecents="true"
            android:exported="false"
            android:launchMode="singleInstance"
            android:showWhenLocked="true"
            android:taskAffinity=""
            android:theme="@style/Theme.Tenseven.LockLayer"
            android:turnScreenOn="true" />

        <!-- First-run setup and "Setup and permissions": the home role, then each optional permission. -->
        <activity
            android:name=".OnboardingActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:label="@string/setup_menu" />

        <!-- Double-tap to lock. Off until the user enables it in Accessibility settings; it can only lock the screen. -->
        <service
            android:name=".platform.LockScreenAccessibilityService"
            android:exported="true"
            android:label="@string/lock_service_label"
            android:permission="android.permission.BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService" />
            </intent-filter>
            <meta-data
                android:name="android.accessibilityservice"
                android:resource="@xml/lock_accessibility_service" />
        </service>

        <!-- Backup and restore of launcher settings through the system file picker. -->
        <activity
            android:name=".BackupActivity"
            android:exported="false"
            android:label="@string/backup_menu" />

        <!-- Notification access, optional and off until the user grants it: groups message and email
             notifications into conversations for the Hub bar. In memory only, nothing is stored or sent. -->
        <service
            android:name=".conversations.ConversationListenerService"
            android:exported="true"
            android:label="@string/tenseven_app_name"
            android:permission="android.permission.BIND_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SERVICE">
            <intent-filter>
                <action android:name="android.service.notification.NotificationListenerService" />
            </intent-filter>
        </service>
        <activity android:name=".ScreenCaptureActivity" android:exported="false"
            android:theme="@android:style/Theme.Material.NoActionBar" android:resizeableActivity="true" />
        <service android:name=".platform.ScreenCaptureService" android:exported="false"
            android:foregroundServiceType="mediaProjection" />
        <activity android:name=".FrameIntegrationsActivity" android:exported="false" />

        <provider
            android:name=".platform.HubCountsProvider"
            android:authorities="${applicationId}.hubcounts"
            android:exported="true"
            android:grantUriPermissions="false"
            android:readPermission="${applicationId}.permission.READ_HUB_COUNTS"
            android:writePermission="${applicationId}.permission.WRITE_HUB_COUNTS" />
    </application>
</manifest>
