+// Derived from SableOS (github.com/aimindseye/zinwaq25-sableos @ 31420f599c2f,
+// sable-src/apps/r8/android/notes/src/main),
+// Apache License 2.0. Changed: package and imports renamed for Tenseven; native Rust calls replaced by Kotlin where
+// noted.
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.notes.core
+
+/**
+ * The on-disk form of a note: a short header, a blank line, then the text verbatim.
+ *
+ * ```
+ * sable-note 1
+ * label YELLOW
+ * created 1730000000000
+ * updated 1730000000000
+ *
+ * Shopping
+ * - [ ] milk
+ * ```
+ */
+object NoteCodec {
+    const val MAGIC = "sable-note 1"
+
+    fun encode(note: Note): String =
+        buildString {
+            append(MAGIC).append('\n')
+            append("label ").append(note.label.name).append('\n')
+            append("created ").append(note.createdAt).append('\n')
+            append("updated ").append(note.updatedAt).append('\n')
+            append('\n')
+            append(note.body)
+        }
+
+    /** Null when [text] is not a note this version writes. */
+    fun decode(
+        id: String,
+        text: String,
+    ): Note? {
+        val split = text.indexOf("\n\n")
+        val header = if (split < 0) emptyList() else text.substring(0, split).split('\n')
+        if (header.firstOrNull() != MAGIC) return null
+        val fields =
+            header
+                .drop(1)
+                .mapNotNull { line ->
+                    line.indexOf(' ').takeIf { it > 0 }?.let { line.substring(0, it) to line.substring(it + 1) }
+                }.toMap()
+        return fields["created"]?.toLongOrNull()?.let { created ->
+            val updated = fields["updated"]?.toLongOrNull() ?: created
+            Note(id, text.substring(split + 2), created, updated, NoteLabel.parse(fields["label"]))
+        }
+    }
+}

+// Derived from SableOS (github.com/aimindseye/zinwaq25-sableos @ 31420f599c2f,
+// sable-src/apps/r8/android/notes/src/main),
+// Apache License 2.0. Changed: package and imports renamed for Tenseven; native Rust calls replaced by Kotlin where
+// noted.
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.notes.core
+
+import java.io.File
+import java.nio.file.Files
+import java.util.UUID
+
+/** Notes as files in an app-private directory, one `<id>.note` file each ([NoteCodec]). */
+class NoteStore(
+    private val dir: File,
+) {
+    /** Every readable note, latest edit first. */
+    fun list(): List<Note> =
+        dir
+            .listFiles { file -> file.isFile && file.name.endsWith(SUFFIX) }
+            .orEmpty()
+            .mapNotNull { file ->
+                runCatching { NoteCodec.decode(file.name.removeSuffix(SUFFIX), file.readText()) }.getOrNull()
+            }.sortedByDescending { it.updatedAt }
+
+    /** Writes to a temporary file and renames it, so a crash never leaves half a note. */
+    fun save(note: Note) {
+        dir.mkdirs()
+        val tmp = File(dir, note.id + ".tmp")
+        tmp.writeText(NoteCodec.encode(note))
+        if (!tmp.renameTo(file(note.id))) {
+            Files.deleteIfExists(tmp.toPath())
+            error("could not save note ${note.id}")
+        }
+    }
+
+    /** Throws when the file exists and cannot be removed. */
+    fun delete(id: String) {
+        Files.deleteIfExists(file(id).toPath())
+    }
+
+    private fun file(id: String): File {
+        require(ID.matches(id)) { "bad note id" }
+        return File(dir, id + SUFFIX)
+    }
+
+    companion object {
+        private const val SUFFIX = ".note"
+        private val ID = Regex("[0-9a-f-]{36}")
+
+        fun newId(): String = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.ui
+
+import android.content.ComponentName

+import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
+import org.junit.Before
+import org.junit.Rule
+import org.junit.Test
+
+@OptIn(ExperimentalTestApi::class)
+class Bb7RecentUiTest {
+    @get:Rule val compose = createComposeRule()
+    private val context: Context get() = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
+    private val preferences get() = context.getSharedPreferences("recent_launches", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
+    private var originalHistory: String? = null
+    private var originalRemember = true
+    private val opened = mutableListOf<String>()
+
+    @Before
+    fun retainTestTargetPreferences() {
+        check(context.packageName == "io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.debug.l0")
+        originalHistory = preferences.getString("launches", null)
+        val state = StartStateRepository(context)
+        originalRemember = state.loadFrameSettings().rememberReturnedApps
+        state.saveFrameSettings(state.loadFrameSettings().copy(rememberReturnedApps = true))
+    }
+
+    @After
+    fun restoreTestTargetPreferences() {
+        preferences.edit().putString("launches", originalHistory).commit()
+        val state = StartStateRepository(context)
+        state.saveFrameSettings(state.loadFrameSettings().copy(rememberReturnedApps = originalRemember))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun recentUsesRealHistoryOrderForTouchAndKeyboard() {
+        saveHistory(listOf(ForegroundEvent(OLD_APP, OLD_TIME), ForegroundEvent(NEW_APP, NEW_TIME)))
+        showHome(mutableIntStateOf(0))
+        compose.onRoot().performKeyInput {
+            pressKey(Key.Spacebar)
+            pressKey(Key.Spacebar)
+        }
+        compose.onNodeWithText("Recent").assertIsDisplayed()
+        compose.onNodeWithText("Zulu newest").assertIsDisplayed()
+        compose.onNodeWithText("Alpha older").assertIsDisplayed()
+        val newest = compose.onNodeWithText("Zulu newest").fetchSemanticsNode().boundsInRoot
+        val oldest = compose.onNodeWithText("Alpha older").fetchSemanticsNode().boundsInRoot
+        assertTrue(newest.left < oldest.left)
+        compose.onNodeWithText("Recent").performClick()
+        compose.onRoot().performKeyInput {
+            pressKey(Key.DirectionRight)
+            pressKey(Key.DirectionLeft)
+            pressKey(Key.Enter)
+        }
+        compose.runOnIdle { assertEquals(listOf(NEW_APP), opened) }
+        compose.onNodeWithText("Alpha older").performClick()
+        compose.runOnIdle { assertEquals(listOf(NEW_APP, OLD_APP), opened) }
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun resumeRefreshReordersAndDeduplicatesRecentApps() {
+        saveHistory(listOf(ForegroundEvent(NEW_APP, NEW_TIME), ForegroundEvent(OLD_APP, OLD_TIME)))
+        val generation = mutableIntStateOf(0)
+        showHome(generation)
+        repeat(2) { compose.onNodeWithText("›").performClick() }
+        compose.runOnIdle {
+            saveHistory(listOf(ForegroundEvent(OLD_APP, LATEST_TIME), ForegroundEvent(NEW_APP, NEW_TIME)))
+            generation.intValue++
+        }
+        val oldest = compose.onNodeWithText("Alpha older").fetchSemanticsNode().boundsInRoot
+        val newest = compose.onNodeWithText("Zulu newest").fetchSemanticsNode().boundsInRoot
+        assertTrue(oldest.left < newest.left)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun unavailableHistoryShowsAnHonestEmptyState() {
+        saveHistory(listOf(ForegroundEvent("fixture.uninstalled", NEW_TIME)))
+        showHome(mutableIntStateOf(0))
+        repeat(2) { compose.onNodeWithText("›").performClick() }
+        compose.onNodeWithText("Recent").assertIsDisplayed()
+        compose.onNodeWithText(EMPTY).assertIsDisplayed()
+        compose.onNodeWithText("Zulu newest").assertDoesNotExist()
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun privacyOptOutDoesNotShowPreviouslyStoredApps() {
+        saveHistory(listOf(ForegroundEvent(NEW_APP, NEW_TIME)))
+        val state = StartStateRepository(context)
+        state.saveFrameSettings(state.loadFrameSettings().copy(rememberReturnedApps = false))
+        showHome(mutableIntStateOf(0))
+        repeat(2) { compose.onNodeWithText("›").performClick() }
+        compose.onNodeWithText(EMPTY).assertIsDisplayed()
+        compose.onNodeWithText("Zulu newest").assertDoesNotExist()
+    }
+
+    private fun showHome(generation: MutableIntState) {
+        val apps = listOf(app("Alpha older", OLD_APP), app("Zulu newest", NEW_APP))
+        compose.setContent {
+            SableTheme {
+                Bb7HomeScreen(
+                    apps = apps,
+                    favoriteKeys = emptyList(),
+                    homeRows = 1,
+                    liveSurfaceRepository = LiveSurfaceRepository(context),
+                    appearance = SableAppearance(),
+                    refreshGeneration = generation.intValue,
+                    homeGeneration = 0,
+                    onLaunchApp = {
+                        opened.add(it.component.packageName)
+                        true
+                    },
+                    onOpenAppInfo = {},
+                    onOpenHub = {},
+                    onFavoritesChanged = {},
+                    onHomeRowsChanged = {},
+                    onOpenMenu = {},
+                    gridColumns = GRID_COLUMNS,
+                )
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun app(
+        label: String,
+        packageName: String,
+    ) = io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model.AppEntry(
+        label,
+        ComponentName(packageName, "$packageName.Main"),
+        Process.myUserHandle(),
+    )
+
+    private fun saveHistory(events: List<ForegroundEvent>) {
+        preferences.edit().putString("launches", RecentLaunches.encode(events)).commit()
+    }
+
+    private companion object {
+        const val OLD_APP = "fixture.old"
+        const val NEW_APP = "fixture.new"
+        const val OLD_TIME = 10L
+        const val NEW_TIME = 20L
+        const val LATEST_TIME = 30L
+        const val GRID_COLUMNS = 4
+        const val EMPTY =
+            "No recent apps. Open an app from TenSeven; " +
+                "history follows Remember returned apps in Settings."
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.ui

+
+@OptIn(ExperimentalTestApi::class)
+class HomePeekRecoveryUiTest {
+    @get:Rule val compose = createAndroidComposeRule<ComponentActivity>()
+    private val context: Context get() = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
+    private lateinit var inputMode: InputModeManager
+
+    @After
+    fun clearSyntheticNotifications() {
+        ConversationHub.replace(emptyList())
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun homeEdgeSwipeOverlaysHomeWithoutPagingWithWidgetsEnabled() {
+        showHome(widgets = true)
+        val density = context.resources.displayMetrics.density
+        compose.onRoot().performTouchInput {
+            swipe(Offset(EDGE_START_DP * density, centerY), Offset(width * END_FRACTION, centerY))
+        }
+        awaitPeek()
+        compose.onNodeWithTag("hub-peek-panel", useUnmergedTree = true).assertIsDisplayed()
+        compose.onNodeWithContentDescription("Active Frames").assertIsSelected()
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun hubLongPressOpensPeekAndOpenHubNavigatesToFullHub() {
+        showHome()
+        openFromHub()
+        awaitPeek()
+        compose.onNodeWithTag("hub-peek-panel", useUnmergedTree = true).assertIsDisplayed()
+        compose.onNodeWithText("Open Hub").performClick()
+        compose.onNodeWithTag("hub-peek-panel", useUnmergedTree = true).assertDoesNotExist()
+        compose.onNodeWithTag("home-reference-bar").assertDoesNotExist()
+        compose.onNodeWithText("All").assertIsDisplayed()
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun ordinaryHubTapStillNavigatesWithoutPeek() {
+        showHome()
+        compose.onNodeWithContentDescription("Hub").performClick()
+        compose.onNodeWithTag("hub-peek-panel", useUnmergedTree = true).assertDoesNotExist()
+        compose.onNodeWithTag("home-reference-bar").assertDoesNotExist()
+        compose.onNodeWithText("All").assertIsDisplayed()
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun focusedHubSpaceOpensPeek() {
+        showHome()
+        compose.runOnIdle { check(inputMode.requestInputMode(InputMode.Keyboard)) }
+        compose.onNodeWithContentDescription("Hub").performSemanticsAction(SemanticsActions.RequestFocus) { it() }
+        compose.onNodeWithContentDescription("Hub").assertIsFocused()
+        compose.onNodeWithContentDescription("Hub").performKeyInput { pressKey(Key.Spacebar) }
+        awaitPeek()
+        compose.onNodeWithTag("hub-peek-panel", useUnmergedTree = true).assertIsDisplayed()
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun escapeAndOutsideTapClosePeekWithoutLeavingHome() {
+        showHome()
+        openFromHub()
+        compose.runOnIdle { check(inputMode.requestInputMode(InputMode.Keyboard)) }
+        compose.onNodeWithText("Open Hub").performKeyInput { pressKey(Key.Escape) }
+        compose.onNodeWithTag("hub-peek-panel", useUnmergedTree = true).assertDoesNotExist()
+        openFromHub()
+        compose.onRoot().performTouchInput { click(Offset(width - 1f, centerY)) }
+        compose.onNodeWithTag("hub-peek-panel", useUnmergedTree = true).assertDoesNotExist()
+        compose.onNodeWithContentDescription("Active Frames").assertIsSelected()
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun androidBackDismissesOnlyPeek() {
+        showHome()
+        openFromHub()
+        compose.runOnUiThread { compose.activity.onBackPressedDispatcher.onBackPressed() }
+        compose.onNodeWithTag("hub-peek-panel", useUnmergedTree = true).assertDoesNotExist()
+        compose.onNodeWithContentDescription("Active Frames").assertIsSelected()
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun conversationTapUsesTheNotificationTargetAndDismissesPeek() {
+        val opened = AtomicInteger()
+        val receiver =
+            object : BroadcastReceiver() {
+                override fun onReceive(
+                    context: Context,
+                    intent: Intent,
+                ) {
+                    opened.incrementAndGet()
+                }
+            }
+        ContextCompat.registerReceiver(context, receiver, IntentFilter(OPEN_FIXTURE), ContextCompat.RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED)
+        val pending =
+            PendingIntent.getBroadcast(
+                context,
+                0,
+                Intent(OPEN_FIXTURE).setPackage(context.packageName),
+                PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE or PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT,
+            )
+        try {
+            ConversationHub.replace(listOf(notification(pending)))
+            showHome(access = true)
+            openFromHub()
+            compose.onNodeWithText("Recovery conversation").assertIsDisplayed().performClick()
+            compose.waitUntil { opened.get() == 1 }
+            compose.onNodeWithTag("hub-peek-panel", useUnmergedTree = true).assertDoesNotExist()
+            compose.runOnIdle { assertEquals(1, opened.get()) }
+        } finally {
+            pending.cancel()
+            context.unregisterReceiver(receiver)
+        }
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun accessDenialNeverExposesCachedConversationText() {
+        ConversationHub.replace(listOf(notification(null)))
+        showHome()
+        openFromHub()
+        awaitPeek()
+        compose.onNodeWithTag("hub-peek-panel", useUnmergedTree = true).assertIsDisplayed()
+        compose.onNodeWithText("Recovery conversation").assertDoesNotExist()
+        compose.onNodeWithText("Private fixture text").assertDoesNotExist()
+    }
+
+    private fun openFromHub() {
+        compose.onNodeWithContentDescription("Hub").performTouchInput { longClick() }
+        awaitPeek()
+    }
+
+    private fun awaitPeek() {
+        compose.waitUntil { compose.onNodeWithTag("hub-peek-panel", useUnmergedTree = true).isDisplayed() }
+    }
+
+    private fun showHome(
+        widgets: Boolean = false,
+        access: Boolean = false,
+    ) {
+        val capabilities =
+            PlatformCapabilities.evaluate(
+                access,
+                true,
+                false,
+                false,
+                false,
+                false,
+                FramePlatformAccess(deviceLocked = false),
+            )
+        compose.setContent {
+            inputMode = LocalInputModeManager.current
+            CompositionLocalProvider(LocalPlatformCapabilities provides capabilities) {
+                SableStartScreen(
+                    apps = emptyList(),
+                    liveSurfaceRepository = LiveSurfaceRepository(context),
+                    widgetsPage = widgets,
+                    onLaunchApp = { true },
+                    onOpenSystemSettings = {},
+                    onOpenAppInfo = {},
+                    onRequestLivePermissions = {},
+                    onRefreshLive = {},
+                )
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun notification(pending: PendingIntent?): HubNotification {
+        val message =
+            ConversationMessage(
+                "recovery",
+                "recovery",
+                "recovery",
+                "fixture.messages",
+                "Fixture",
+                "Private fixture text",
+                1L,
+                "Sender",
+                false,
+            )
+        return HubNotification(
+            "recovery",
+            "recovery",
+            "Recovery conversation",
+            "fixture.messages",
+            "Fixture",
+            1L,
+            false,
+            listOf(message),
+            pending,
+            null,
+        )
+    }
+
+    private companion object {
+        const val EDGE_START_DP = 24f
+        const val END_FRACTION = 0.6f
+        const val OPEN_FIXTURE = "io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.test.RECOVERY_OPEN"
+    }
+}

+        val intent =
+            Intent(context, LauncherSettingsActivity::class.java)
+                .putExtra("tenseven.settings.category", "frames")
+        ActivityScenario.launch<LauncherSettingsActivity>(intent).use {
+            compose.onNodeWithText("Next").performClick()
+            compose.onNodeWithText("Review & Finish").assertIsDisplayed()
+            compose.onNodeWithText("Back").performClick()

+            Intent(context, LauncherSettingsActivity::class.java)
+                .putExtra("tenseven.settings.category", "apps")

+            compose.onNodeWithText("Optional companion apps").assertExists()

+            compose.onNodeWithText("Device compatibility").performScrollTo().assertIsDisplayed()

+
+/** Read-only companion presence and independent planning; never enables bundled activities or installs APKs. */
+@Composable
+internal fun CompanionAppsStatusSection() {
+    val context = LocalContext.current
+    var refresh by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
+    val observations = remember(context, refresh) { CompanionDiscovery.snapshot(context) }
+
+    Section("Optional companion apps · status")
+    Text(
+        "Phone and Calendar are independent development APKs. Tasks, Notes, Calculator and " +
+            "Sound Profiles await separate extraction. Launcher works without any companion.",
+        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
+        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
+    )
+    Text(
+        "Package names are proposed. No signer trust, installer, migration or release approval yet.",
+        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
+        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
+    )
+    observations.forEach { observed ->
+        val detail =
+            when (observed.presence) {
+                CompanionPresence.DETECTED_SIGNER_UNVERIFIED -> {
+                    "Detected in this profile · signature NOT verified" +
+                        (observed.versionLabel?.let { " · reported version $it" } ?: "")
+                }
+
+                CompanionPresence.NOT_DETECTED_IN_PROFILE -> {
+                    "Not detected in this Android profile"
+                }
+            }
+        Text(
+            "${observed.spec.label} — $detail",
+            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
+            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface,
+        )
+    }
+    Card(
+        "Open companion setup planner",
+        "Informational selections only; this Launcher does not install APKs",
+        false,
+    ) {
+        context.startActivity(Intent(context, CompanionWizardActivity::class.java))
+    }
+    Card("Refresh companion detection", "Read-only; does not install or change any application", false) {
+        refresh++
+    }
+}

+) {
+    val enabledExtras = extras.enabledExtras
+    val onApplyExtras = extras.onApplyExtras
+    val onOpenLauncherSettings = extras.onOpenLauncherSettings
+    val onFinish = extras.onFinish
+    var index by rememberSaveable { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
+    var picked by remember { mutableStateOf(enabledExtras) }
+    val stages = Setup2Plan.stages
+    val stage = stages[index.coerceIn(0, stages.lastIndex)]
+    val scroll = rememberScrollState()
+    val selectApps: (Set<String>) -> Unit = { ids ->
+        val normalized = Setup2Plan.normalizedCustom(ids)
+        picked = normalized
+        onApplyExtras(normalized)
+    }
+
+    BackHandler(enabled = index > 0) { index -= 1 }
+    LaunchedEffect(index) { scroll.scrollTo(0) }
+    Surface(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background) {
+        Column(
+            modifier =
+                Modifier
+                    .fillMaxSize()
+                    .safeDrawingPadding()
+                    .verticalScroll(scroll)
+                    .padding(12.dp),
+            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
+        ) {
+            SetupWizardHeader(index, stages.size, stage.title)
+
+            when (stage) {
+                Setup2Stage.WELCOME -> SetupStageWelcome(state, access)
+                Setup2Stage.HOME -> SetupStageHome(settings)
+                Setup2Stage.APPEARANCE -> SetupStageAppearance(settings)
+                Setup2Stage.APPS -> SetupStageApps(picked, selectApps)
+                Setup2Stage.HUB_LOCK -> SetupStageHubLock(settings)
+                Setup2Stage.PERMISSIONS -> SetupStagePermissions(state, access)
+                Setup2Stage.REVIEW -> SetupStageReview(state, picked.size, onOpenLauncherSettings)
+            }
+
+            SetupWizardNavigation(
+                index = index,
+                last = stages.lastIndex,
+                onBack = { index -= 1 },
+                onNext = { index += 1 },
+                onFinish = onFinish,
+            )
+        }
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven
+
+import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
+import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
+import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.design.AccentPreset

+
+private val TENSEVEN_CLASSIC_ACCENT_COLOR = Color(0xFF4D9CFF)
+
+private val TENSEVEN_CLASSIC_SURFACE_COLOR = Color(0xFF0D1115)
+
+private val TENSEVEN_CLASSIC_OUTLINE_COLOR = Color(0xFF444A52)
+
+/**
+ * One Settings/Setup surface palette. No launcher Home, Peek, Active Frames source, or system UI
+ * is altered. The BB10 default uses black/white with distinct blue borders rather than legacy
+ * cyan-filled emphasis; selected nondefault palettes keep their user-specified accent.
+ */
+@Suppress("FunctionNaming")
+@Composable
+internal fun Settings2VisualTheme(
+    appearance: SableAppearance,
+    content: @Composable () -> Unit,
+) {
+    val classic =
+        appearance.mode == AppearanceMode.Dark &&
+            appearance.accent == AccentPreset.Blue &&
+            appearance.custom == null
+    val current = MaterialTheme.colorScheme
+    val selectedAccent = if (classic) TENSEVEN_CLASSIC_ACCENT_COLOR else current.primary
+    MaterialTheme(
+        colorScheme =
+            current.copy(
+                primary = selectedAccent,
+                onPrimary = if (classic) Color.White else current.onPrimary,
+                // Thin neutral outlines for unselected rows; only focus/selection is blue.
+                outlineVariant = if (classic) TENSEVEN_CLASSIC_OUTLINE_COLOR else current.outlineVariant,
+                surfaceVariant = if (classic) TENSEVEN_CLASSIC_SURFACE_COLOR else current.surfaceVariant,
+            ),
+        typography = MaterialTheme.typography,
+        shapes = MaterialTheme.shapes,
+        content = content,
+    )
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.companions
+
+/**
+ * Proposed independent package identities. These are NOT verified/registered release identities.
+ * In particular, a matching package name does not establish APK authenticity.
+ */
+data class CompanionSpec(
+    val id: String,
+    val label: String,
+    val packageName: String,
+    val minimumPreset: Boolean,
+)
+
+object CompanionCatalog {
+    val all: List<CompanionSpec> =
+        listOf(
+            CompanionSpec("phone", "Phone", "io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.phone", false),
+            CompanionSpec("calendar", "Calendar", "io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.calendar", false),
+            CompanionSpec("tasks", "Tasks / Remind", "io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.tasks", true),
+            CompanionSpec("notes", "Notes", "io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.notes", true),
+            CompanionSpec("calculator", "Calc Plus", "io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.calculator", true),
+            CompanionSpec("profiles", "Sound Profiles", "io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.profiles", false),
+        )
+
+    val minimumPreset: Set<String> = all.filter { it.minimumPreset }.map { it.id }.toSet()
+    val fullPreset: Set<String> = all.map { it.id }.toSet()
+
+    /** Ignores obsolete or unrecognized input without toggling bundled component settings. */
+    fun normalize(ids: Collection<String>): Set<String> = ids.filterTo(mutableSetOf()) { it in fullPreset }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.companions
+
+import android.content.Context
+import android.content.pm.PackageManager
+
+/**
+ * Package presence is informational only. Never use this result to install, trust,
+ * launch privileged IPC, or represent a verified release. Signer pins are not yet approved.
+ */
+enum class CompanionPresence {
+    DETECTED_SIGNER_UNVERIFIED,
+    NOT_DETECTED_IN_PROFILE,
+}
+
+data class CompanionObservation(
+    val spec: CompanionSpec,
+    val presence: CompanionPresence,
+    val versionLabel: String?,
+)
+
+private const val MAX_VERSION_LABEL_LENGTH = 80
+
+object CompanionDiscovery {
+    fun snapshot(context: Context): List<CompanionObservation> =
+        CompanionCatalog.all.map { spec ->
+            val packageInfo =
+                try {
+                    context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(spec.packageName, PackageManager.PackageInfoFlags.of(0))
+                } catch (_: PackageManager.NameNotFoundException) {
+                    null
+                } catch (_: SecurityException) {
+                    null
+                }
+            CompanionObservation(
+                spec = spec,
+                presence =
+                    if (packageInfo == null) {
+                        CompanionPresence.NOT_DETECTED_IN_PROFILE
+                    } else {
+                        CompanionPresence.DETECTED_SIGNER_UNVERIFIED
+                    },
+                versionLabel = packageInfo?.versionName?.take(MAX_VERSION_LABEL_LENGTH),
+            )
+        }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.companions
+
+/**
+ * No companion identity/signing pins are yet approved for independent release.
+ * Presence or a matching APK package name is never evidence of an authentic APK.
+ * Any future installer must verify Android's package signing information against
+ * an explicitly reviewed, release-specific trust policy before invoking Android.
+ */
+enum class CompanionInstallGate {
+    NOT_SELECTED,
+    RELEASE_IDENTITY_UNAPPROVED,
+}
+
+object CompanionInstallPolicy {
+    fun installationGate(
+        id: String,
+        selected: Collection<String>,
+    ): CompanionInstallGate =
+        if (id !in CompanionCatalog.normalize(selected)) {
+            CompanionInstallGate.NOT_SELECTED
+        } else {
+            CompanionInstallGate.RELEASE_IDENTITY_UNAPPROVED
+        }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.companions
+
+import android.content.Context
+import androidx.core.content.edit
+
+/** Stores requested companion ids separately from the existing bundled Extras settings. */
+object CompanionSelectionStore {
+    private const val STORE = "tenseven_companion_wizard_v1"
+    private const val SELECTED_IDS = "requested_companion_ids"
+
+    fun load(context: Context): Set<String> =
+        CompanionSetupPlan.decode(
+            context
+                .getSharedPreferences(STORE, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
+                .getString(SELECTED_IDS, ""),
+        )
+
+    fun save(
+        context: Context,
+        selected: Collection<String>,
+    ) {
+        context.getSharedPreferences(STORE, Context.MODE_PRIVATE).edit {
+            putString(SELECTED_IDS, CompanionSetupPlan.encode(selected))
+        }
+    }

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.companions
+
+/** User choice only: a selection never changes installed packages or bundled extras. */
+enum class CompanionPreset {
+    MINIMUM,
+    FULL,
+    CUSTOM,
+}
+
+object CompanionSetupPlan {
+    fun choosePreset(
+        preset: CompanionPreset,
+        current: Set<String>,
+    ): Set<String> =
+        when (preset) {
+            CompanionPreset.MINIMUM -> CompanionCatalog.minimumPreset
+            CompanionPreset.FULL -> CompanionCatalog.fullPreset
+            CompanionPreset.CUSTOM -> CompanionCatalog.normalize(current)
+        }
+
+    fun selectedPreset(selected: Collection<String>): CompanionPreset {
+        val normalized = CompanionCatalog.normalize(selected)
+        return when (normalized) {
+            CompanionCatalog.minimumPreset -> CompanionPreset.MINIMUM
+            CompanionCatalog.fullPreset -> CompanionPreset.FULL
+            else -> CompanionPreset.CUSTOM
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun toggle(
+        selected: Collection<String>,
+        id: String,
+        enabled: Boolean,
+    ): Set<String> {
+        val normalized = CompanionCatalog.normalize(selected)
+        if (id !in CompanionCatalog.fullPreset) return normalized
+        return if (enabled) normalized + id else normalized - id
+    }
+
+    /** Stable, non-sensitive ids only. No private app records, APK paths, or certificates. */
+    fun encode(selected: Collection<String>): String =
+        CompanionCatalog
+            .normalize(selected)
+            .sorted()
+            .joinToString(",")
+
+    fun decode(encoded: String?): Set<String> =
+        CompanionCatalog.normalize(
+            encoded
+                .orEmpty()
+                .split(",")
+                .filter { it.isNotBlank() },
+        )
+}

-/** Fixed-point (thousandths) unit conversion, answered as "OK:<milli>" or "ERR:<reason>". */
-internal object NativeBridge {
-    private enum class Category { Length, Mass, Temperature, Volume }
-
-    // The frozen unit codes, in order: 0 mm, 1 cm, 2 m, 3 km, 4 in, 5 ft, 6 mi, 7 g, 8 kg, 9 oz, 10 lb,
-    // 11 C, 12 F, 13 K, 14 mL, 15 L, 16 cup, 17 gal.
-    private val categories =
-        listOf(
-            Category.Length, Category.Length, Category.Length, Category.Length, Category.Length, Category.Length, Category.Length,
-            Category.Mass, Category.Mass, Category.Mass, Category.Mass,
-            Category.Temperature, Category.Temperature, Category.Temperature,
-            Category.Volume, Category.Volume, Category.Volume, Category.Volume,
-        )
-
-    // numerator, denominator relative to the category's base unit (mm, g, mL); temperatures have none.
-    private val ratios: List<Pair<Long, Long>?> =
-        listOf(
-            1L to 1L, 10L to 1L, 1_000L to 1L, 1_000_000L to 1L, 254L to 10L, 3_048L to 10L, 1_609_344L to 1L,
-            1L to 1L, 1_000L to 1L, 28_349_523_125L to 1_000_000_000L, 45_359_237L to 100_000L,
-            null, null, null,
-            1L to 1L, 1_000L to 1L, 2_365_882_365L to 10_000_000L, 3_785_411_784L to 1_000_000L,
-        )
-
-    private val LONG_MIN = BigInteger.valueOf(Long.MIN_VALUE)
-    private val LONG_MAX = BigInteger.valueOf(Long.MAX_VALUE)
-    private val I128_MAX = BigInteger.ONE.shiftLeft(127) - BigInteger.ONE
-    private val I128_MIN = BigInteger.ONE.shiftLeft(127).negate()
-
-    fun selfTest(): String = convertMilli(5_000, 6, 3).let { if (it == "OK:8047") "PASS:convert-core:8047" else "FAIL:convert-core:$it" }
-
-    fun convertMilli(
-        valueMilli: Long,
-        fromUnit: Int,
-        toUnit: Int,
-    ): String {
-        if (fromUnit !in categories.indices || toUnit !in categories.indices) return "ERR:INVALID_UNIT"
-        if (categories[fromUnit] != categories[toUnit]) return "ERR:INCOMPATIBLE_UNITS"
-        val converted =
-            if (categories[fromUnit] == Category.Temperature) {
-                temperature(valueMilli, fromUnit, toUnit)
-            } else {
-                linear(valueMilli, fromUnit, toUnit)
-            }
-        return if (converted == null) "ERR:OUT_OF_RANGE" else "OK:$converted"
-    }
-
-    private fun linear(
-        value: Long,
-        from: Int,
-        to: Int,
-    ): Long? {
-        val (fromNum, fromDen) = ratios[from]!!
-        val (toNum, toDen) = ratios[to]!!
-        val numerator = BigInteger.valueOf(value) * BigInteger.valueOf(fromNum) * BigInteger.valueOf(toDen)
-        val denominator = BigInteger.valueOf(fromDen) * BigInteger.valueOf(toNum)
-        if (numerator > I128_MAX || numerator < I128_MIN) return null
-        return toLongOrNull(divRound(numerator, denominator))
-    }
-
-    private fun temperature(
-        value: Long,
-        from: Int,
-        to: Int,
-    ): Long? {
-        val v = BigInteger.valueOf(value)
-        val celsius =
-            when (from) {
-                11 -> v
-                12 -> divRound((v - BigInteger.valueOf(32_000)) * BigInteger.valueOf(5), BigInteger.valueOf(9))
-                else -> v - BigInteger.valueOf(273_150)
-            }
-        if (celsius < BigInteger.valueOf(-273_150)) return null
-        val converted =
-            when (to) {
-                11 -> celsius
-                12 -> divRound(celsius * BigInteger.valueOf(9), BigInteger.valueOf(5)) + BigInteger.valueOf(32_000)
-                else -> celsius + BigInteger.valueOf(273_150)
-            }
-        return toLongOrNull(converted)
-    }
-
-    /** Rounds half away from zero, as the Rust core did. The denominator is positive. */
-    private fun divRound(
-        numerator: BigInteger,
-        denominator: BigInteger,
-    ): BigInteger {
-        val half = denominator / BigInteger.valueOf(2)
-        return if (numerator.signum() >= 0) {
-            (numerator + half) / denominator
-        } else {
-            ((numerator.negate() + half) / denominator).negate()
-        }
-    }
-
-    private fun toLongOrNull(value: BigInteger): Long? = if (value < LONG_MIN || value > LONG_MAX) null else value.toLong()
-}

-/**
- * Where the board and controls go. A window less than [TALL_RATIO] times as tall as it is wide
- * (the Q25's 720x720 square) puts the board on the left at the full height and the title, status
- * and controls in a narrow rail on the right, so the whole game shows without scrolling. A tall
- * phone keeps the header, status panel, board and buttons in one column.
- */
-internal object GameLayout {
-    const val TALL_RATIO = 1.3f
-    val RailWidth = 88.dp
-    val Gap = 8.dp
-    val Edge = 8.dp
-
-    fun isSquare(
-        widthDp: Float,
-        heightDp: Float,
-    ): Boolean = heightDp < widthDp * TALL_RATIO
-
-    /** The board's side in a square window: the height, or the width left beside the rail. */
-    fun squareBoardSide(
-        width: Dp,
-        height: Dp,
-    ): Dp = min(height - Edge * 2, width - Edge * 2 - RailWidth - Gap)
-
-    /** The board's side in a tall window: the width, at most 60 % of the height. */
-    fun tallBoardSide(
-        width: Dp,
-        height: Dp,
-    ): Dp = min(width - SableSpacing.ScreenHorizontal * 2, height * 0.6f)
-}

-// Derived from SableOS (github.com/aimindseye/zinwaq25-sableos @ 31420f599c2f, sable-src/apps/r8/android/games/src/main),
-// Apache License 2.0. Changed: package and imports renamed for Tenseven; native Rust calls replaced by Kotlin where noted.
-package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.games
-
-import android.view.KeyEvent
-
-/**
- * Keyboard play for the Sable games (keyboard-first, like the other Sable apps).
- *
- * The trackpad sends arrow keys, so arrows move the board cursor (Sudoku, Minesweeper) or slide the
- * tiles (2048). Numbers come from the character the key produces, so Alt+W E R S D F Z X C (the Q25
- * and Titan digit layer) and a number row both work; plain W E R S D F Z X C also enter 1-9 in Sudoku,
- * where no letter has another meaning. There is no Ctrl on the Q25: Ctrl chords are left alone.
- */
-internal sealed interface GameCommand {
-    data class Move(
-        val dx: Int,
-        val dy: Int,
-    ) : GameCommand
-
-    data class Digit(
-        val value: Int,
-    ) : GameCommand
-
-    /** Space or Enter: reveal (Minesweeper) or nothing special. */
-    data object Primary : GameCommand
-
-    data object Flag : GameCommand
-
-    data object Erase : GameCommand
-
-    data object Undo : GameCommand
-
-    data object NewGame : GameCommand
-
-    /** A letter typed for a word game, upper case. */
-    data class Letter(
-        val value: Char,
-    ) : GameCommand
-
-    /** P: pause or resume a game that runs on its own (Bricks, Snake, Blocks). */
-    data object Pause : GameCommand
-
-    /** H: show a move that works (Mahjong). */
-    data object Hint : GameCommand
-
-    /** Space in Solitaire: turn the next card from the stock. */
-    data object Draw : GameCommand
-
-    /** A in Solitaire: send the selected card to its foundation. */
-    data object Auto : GameCommand
-}
-
-/** A key-down reduced to what the keymap needs, so the mapping is testable on the JVM. */
-internal data class GameKeyPress(
-    val keyCode: Int,
-    /** The character the key produces with the current meta state, or null. */
-    val char: Char? = null,
-    val alt: Boolean = false,
-    val ctrl: Boolean = false,
-    val repeatCount: Int = 0,
-)
-
-internal enum class GameKind { Sudoku, Minesweeper, Game2048, Bricks, Snake, Blocks, Reversi, Solitaire, Mahjong, Words }
-
-internal object GameKeymap {
-    /** BlackBerry-style digit keys: W E R S D F Z X C are 1-9. */
-    private val LETTER_DIGITS =
-        mapOf(
-            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_W to 1,
-            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_E to 2,
-            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_R to 3,
-            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_S to 4,
-            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_D to 5,
-            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_F to 6,
-            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_Z to 7,
-            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_X to 8,
-            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_C to 9,
-        )
-
-    fun command(
-        game: GameKind,
-        press: GameKeyPress,
-    ): GameCommand? {
-        if (press.ctrl) return null
-        move(press.keyCode)?.let { return it }
-        // A held key repeats only cursor moves.
-        if (press.repeatCount > 0) return null
-        return when (game) {
-            GameKind.Sudoku -> sudoku(press)
-            GameKind.Minesweeper -> minesweeper(press)
-            GameKind.Game2048 -> common(press)
-            GameKind.Bricks, GameKind.Snake, GameKind.Blocks -> arcade(press)
-            GameKind.Reversi -> board(press)
-            GameKind.Solitaire -> solitaire(press)
-            GameKind.Mahjong -> mahjong(press)
-            GameKind.Words -> words(press)
-        }
-    }
-
-    private fun move(keyCode: Int): GameCommand.Move? =
-        when (keyCode) {
-            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP -> GameCommand.Move(0, -1)
-            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN -> GameCommand.Move(0, 1)
-            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_LEFT -> GameCommand.Move(-1, 0)
-            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_RIGHT -> GameCommand.Move(1, 0)
-            else -> null
-        }
-
-    private fun sudoku(press: GameKeyPress): GameCommand? {
-        val digit = press.char?.takeIf { it in '1'..'9' }?.digitToInt()
-        return when {
-            digit != null -> GameCommand.Digit(digit)
-
-            press.char == '0' -> GameCommand.Erase
-
-            press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DEL || press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_FORWARD_DEL -> GameCommand.Erase
-
-            // Alt plus a letter types a symbol; only the digits above are taken from it.
-            press.alt -> null
-
-            press.keyCode in LETTER_DIGITS -> GameCommand.Digit(LETTER_DIGITS.getValue(press.keyCode))
-
-            press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_U -> GameCommand.Undo
-
-            else -> common(press)
-        }
-    }
-
-    private fun minesweeper(press: GameKeyPress): GameCommand? =
-        when {
-            press.alt -> null
-
-            press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SPACE ||
-                press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER ||
-                press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_CENTER -> GameCommand.Primary
-
-            press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_F || press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_G -> GameCommand.Flag
-
-            else -> common(press)
-        }
-
-    private fun isPrimary(keyCode: Int): Boolean =
-        keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SPACE || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER ||
-            keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_CENTER
-
-    /** Bricks, Snake and Blocks: Space or Enter launches, drops or restarts; P pauses. */
-    private fun arcade(press: GameKeyPress): GameCommand? =
-        when {
-            press.alt -> null
-            isPrimary(press.keyCode) -> GameCommand.Primary
-            press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_P -> GameCommand.Pause
-            else -> common(press)
-        }
-
-    private fun board(press: GameKeyPress): GameCommand? =
-        when {
-            press.alt -> null
-            isPrimary(press.keyCode) -> GameCommand.Primary
-            else -> common(press)
-        }
-
-    /** Solitaire: Enter picks up and puts down, Space turns the stock, A sends to a foundation, Del drops the pick. */
-    private fun solitaire(press: GameKeyPress): GameCommand? =
-        when {
-            press.alt -> null
-            press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SPACE -> GameCommand.Draw
-            press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER || press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_CENTER -> GameCommand.Primary
-            press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_A -> GameCommand.Auto
-            press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DEL || press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ESCAPE -> GameCommand.Erase
-            else -> common(press)
-        }
-
-    private fun mahjong(press: GameKeyPress): GameCommand? =
-        when {
-            press.alt -> null
-            isPrimary(press.keyCode) -> GameCommand.Primary
-            press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_H -> GameCommand.Hint
-            else -> common(press)
-        }
-
-    /** Words: every letter types, so N is a letter here; Enter guesses (or starts over when the round is done). */
-    private fun words(press: GameKeyPress): GameCommand? {
-        val letter = press.char?.takeIf { !press.alt && it.isLetter() && it.lowercaseChar() in 'a'..'z' }
-        return when {
-            letter != null -> GameCommand.Letter(letter.uppercaseChar())
-            press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DEL -> GameCommand.Erase
-            press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER || press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_CENTER -> GameCommand.Primary
-            else -> null
-        }
-    }
-
-    private fun common(press: GameKeyPress): GameCommand? =
-        when {
-            press.alt -> null
-            press.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_N -> GameCommand.NewGame
-            else -> null
-        }
-
-    /** The cursor after [move] on a [size] x [size] board, clamped at the edges. */
-    fun moveCursor(
-        row: Int,
-        col: Int,
-        move: GameCommand.Move,
-        size: Int,
-    ): Pair<Int, Int> = (row + move.dy).coerceIn(0, size - 1) to (col + move.dx).coerceIn(0, size - 1)
-
-    /** 2048 slide direction for the native bridge: 0 left, 1 right, 2 up, 3 down. */
-    fun slideDirection(move: GameCommand.Move): Int =
-        when {
-            move.dx < 0 -> 0
-            move.dx > 0 -> 1
-            move.dy < 0 -> 2
-            else -> 3
-        }
-}
-
-/** Set by the current game screen; [MainActivity] offers it every key-down first. */
-internal class GameKeyHost {
-    var handler: ((GameKeyPress) -> Boolean)? = null
-}
-
-internal fun KeyEvent.toGameKeyPress(): GameKeyPress {
-    val produced = unicodeChar
-    return GameKeyPress(
-        keyCode = keyCode,
-        char = if (produced > 0) produced.toChar() else null,
-        alt = isAltPressed,
-        ctrl = isCtrlPressed,
-        repeatCount = repeatCount,
-    )
-}

@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model
+
+/** Named presentation/protocol values; numeric values unchanged from the reviewed source. */
+private const val PHONE_DIAL_POLICY_APPEND_VALUE_48 = 48
+private const val PHONE_DIAL_POLICY_NORMALIZE_MAX_48 = 48
+
+/** Strict keypad input policy; actual call placement is always delegated to Android ACTION_DIAL. */
+object D5PhoneDialPolicy {
+    private const val ACCEPTED = "0123456789*#+"
+
+    fun append(
+        current: String,
+        key: String,
+    ): String {
+        if (key.length != 1 || key[0] !in ACCEPTED || current
+                .length >= PHONE_DIAL_POLICY_APPEND_VALUE_48
+        ) {
+            return current
+        }
+        return if (key == "+" && current.isNotEmpty()) current else current + key
+    }
+
+    fun normalize(number: String): String = number.filter { it in ACCEPTED }.take(PHONE_DIAL_POLICY_NORMALIZE_MAX_48)
+
+    fun canDial(number: String) = number.isNotBlank() && number.any(Char::isDigit)
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model
+
+/** Named presentation/protocol values; numeric values unchanged from the reviewed source. */
+private const val HOME_BAR_COMPACT_POLICY_COMPACT_VALUE_340 = 340
+
+/** Four primary destinations remain visible on compact square devices.
+ * User-saved shortcuts are never deleted; on compact screens they remain accessible in the app grid.
+ */
+internal object HomeBarCompactPolicy {
+    fun compact(
+        model: String,
+        widthDp: Int,
+    ): Boolean = model.contains("Q25", ignoreCase = true) || widthDp < HOME_BAR_COMPACT_POLICY_COMPACT_VALUE_340
+
+    /** The two optional slots at most on Titan 2; role destinations are already in the fixed dock. */
+    fun optionalTokens(
+        tokens: List<String>,
+        compact: Boolean,
+    ): List<String> =
+        if (compact) {
+            emptyList()
+        } else {
+            tokens
+                .filter { it == QuickBar.PHONE || it == QuickBar.COMMAND || QuickBar.appKey(it) != null }
+                .distinct()
+                .take(2)
+        }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model
+
+/** Release 2.0 status presentation is independent for BB7 and BB10. */
+enum class HomeStatusMode(
+    val key: String,
+) {
+    Dials("dials"),
+    Text("text"),
+    Hidden("hidden"),
+    ;
+
+    companion object {
+        /** Migration: a legacy explicitly empty dial set was equivalent to hidden. */
+        fun decode(
+            saved: String?,
+            legacyDialCount: Int,
+        ): HomeStatusMode =
+            entries.firstOrNull { it.key == saved }
+                ?: if (legacyDialCount == 0) Hidden else Dials
+
+        fun preference(style: HomeStyle): String =
+            if (style ==
+                HomeStyle
+                    .Bb7
+            ) {
+                "home_status_mode_bb7"
+            } else {
+                "home_status_mode_bb10"
+            }

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model
+
+import kotlin.math.abs
+
+/** Only an inward horizontal drag at Home's left edge belongs to Peek. */
+internal object HubPeekGesture {
+    const val EDGE_DP = 32
+    const val EXCLUSION_DP = 200
+
+    fun startsAtEdge(
+        x: Float,
+        edge: Float,
+    ): Boolean = x >= 0f && x <= edge
+
+    fun opens(
+        dx: Float,
+        dy: Float,
+        slop: Float,
+    ): Boolean = slop > 0f && dx > slop && dx > abs(dy)
+
+    fun cancels(
+        dx: Float,
+        dy: Float,
+        slop: Float,
+    ): Boolean = abs(dy) > slop && abs(dy) > abs(dx)
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model
+
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.live.AppUnreadCount
+
+/**
+ * The one choice of per-app unread counts that the Hub bar, the badges, the lock layer and the watch share:
+ * the listener's waiting counts when it has any, otherwise the Hub's unread counts. Package and count only.
+ */
+object HubUnreadCounts {
+    fun pick(
+        lockCounts: Map<String, Int>,
+        maxApps: Int,
+        hubCounts: () -> List<AppUnreadCount>,
+    ): List<AppUnreadCount> {
+        val waiting =
+            lockCounts.entries
+                .filter { it.value > 0 }
+                .map { AppUnreadCount(it.key, it.value) }
+                .sortedWith(compareByDescending<AppUnreadCount> { it.count }.thenBy { it.packageName })
+                .take(maxApps)
+        return waiting.ifEmpty { hubCounts() }
+    }
+}

+    val title: String,
+) {
+    WELCOME("Welcome & Home role"),
+    HOME("Home screens"),
+    APPEARANCE("Appearance & themes"),
+    APPS("Apps & features"),
+    HUB_LOCK("Hub & lock screen"),
+    PERMISSIONS("Device & permissions"),
+    REVIEW("Review & finish"),
+}
+
+/** Mapping covers every legacy setup choice exactly once, without changing its persisted key. */
+internal object Setup2Plan {
+    val stages: List<Setup2Stage> = Setup2Stage.entries
+
+    fun steps(stage: Setup2Stage): List<SetupStep> =
+        when (stage) {
+            Setup2Stage.WELCOME -> {
+                listOf(SetupStep.HOME)
+            }
+
+            Setup2Stage.HOME -> {
+                listOf(SetupStep.STYLE, SetupStep.GRID, SetupStep.WIDGETS)

+
+            Setup2Stage.APPEARANCE -> {
+                listOf(SetupStep.LOOK)
+            }
+
+            Setup2Stage.APPS -> {
+                listOf(SetupStep.EXTRAS)
+            }
+
+            Setup2Stage.HUB_LOCK -> {
+                listOf(SetupStep.HUB, SetupStep.LOCK)
+            }
+
+            Setup2Stage.PERMISSIONS -> {
+                listOf(
+                    SetupStep.CONTACTS,
+                    SetupStep.PHOTOS,
+                    SetupStep.NOTIFICATIONS,
+                    SetupStep.USAGE,
+                )
+            }
+
+            Setup2Stage.REVIEW -> {
+                emptyList()
+            }
+        }
+
+    /** Presets choose only real, currently bundled app components. Calendar/Phone arrive later. */

+

+
+    fun normalizedCustom(ids: Collection<String>): Set<String> = ExtraApps.normalize(ids)

diff --git a/app/src/main/java/io/github/aimindseye/tenseven/platform/CompanionLaunches.kt b/app/src/main/java/io/github/aimindseye/tenseven/platform/CompanionLaunches.kt

@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.platform
+
+import android.content.Context
+import android.content.Intent
+
+/** User-initiated app opening only. Package presence is not signer verification or an install request. */
+object CompanionLaunches {
+    fun intent(
+        context: Context,
+        id: String,
+    ): Intent? {
+        val suffix =
+            when (id) {
+                "tenseven_phone" -> "phone"
+                "tenseven_calendar" -> "calendar"
+                else -> id.removePrefix("local:")
+            }
+        if (suffix !in setOf("phone", "calendar", "tasks", "notes", "calculator", "profiles")) return null
+        val root = "io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.$suffix"
+        return listOf(root + ".debug", root).firstNotNullOfOrNull {
+            context.packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(it)
+        }
+    }
+}

diff --git a/app/src/main/java/io/github/aimindseye/tenseven/platform/HomeWeatherClient.kt b/app/src/main/java/io/github/aimindseye/tenseven/platform/HomeWeatherClient.kt

@@ -0,0 +1,295 @@
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.platform
+
+import android.Manifest
+import android.content.Context
+import android.content.pm.PackageManager
+import android.location.Address
+import android.location.Geocoder
+import android.location.Location
+import android.location.LocationManager
+import android.net.Uri
+import androidx.core.content.edit
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model.HomeWeatherCodes
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model.WeatherCityQuery
+import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
+import kotlinx.coroutines.suspendCancellableCoroutine
+import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
+import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeoutOrNull
+import org.json.JSONObject
+import java.net.HttpURLConnection
+import java.net.URL
+import java.util.Locale
+import kotlin.coroutines.resume
+import kotlin.math.roundToInt
+
+private const val WEATHER_HTTP_SUCCESS_MAX = 299
+
+/** Named presentation/protocol values; numeric values unchanged from the reviewed source. */
+private const val WEATHER_CURRENT_NEAR_DEVIC_TIME_1000_L = 1000L
+private const val WEATHER_CURRENT_NEAR_DEVIC_TIME_8_000_L = 8_000L
+private const val WEATHER_CURRENT_NEAR_DEVIC_VALUE_2 = 2
+private const val WEATHER_CURRENT_NEAR_DEVIC_VALUE_60 = 60
+private const val WEATHER_JSON_MAX_160_000 = 160_000
+private const val WEATHER_JSON_VALUE_200 = 200
+private const val WEATHER_JSON_VALUE_5000 = 5000
+private const val WEATHER_RESOLVE_LOCALITY_TIME_3_500_L = 3_500L
+
+/** The user chooses a city. No GPS permission, IP-location lookup or tracking is used. */
+internal data class HomeWeatherObservation(
+    val temperature: Int,
+    val unit: String,
+    val condition: String,
+    val locationName: String? = null,
+)
+
+internal class HomeWeatherClient(
+    context: Context,
+) {
+    private val applicationContext = context.applicationContext
+    private var nearbyAt = 0L
+    private var nearbyWeather: HomeWeatherObservation? = null
+    private val cache =
+        context.applicationContext.getSharedPreferences(
+            "tenseven_home_weather_cache",
+            Context.MODE_PRIVATE,
+        )
+
+    suspend fun current(
+        city: String,
+        fahrenheit: Boolean,
+    ): HomeWeatherObservation? =
+        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
+            val normalized = WeatherCityQuery.normalized(city)
+            if (normalized.length < 2) return@withContext null
+            val cacheKey = normalized.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) + if (fahrenheit) "|f" else "|c"
+            val savedAt = cache.getLong("timestamp", 0)
+            val cached =
+                if (cache.getString("city_unit", null) == cacheKey) {
+                    cache.getString("weather", null)?.let { decode(it) }
+                } else {
+                    null
+                }
+            val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
+            if (cached != null && now - savedAt in 0 until CACHE_LIFETIME_MS) return@withContext cached
+            runCatching { fetchCityObservation(normalized, fahrenheit, cacheKey, now) }.getOrNull()
+                ?: cached?.takeIf { now - savedAt in 0 until MAX_STALE_MS }
+        }
+
+    private fun fetchCityObservation(
+        normalized: String,
+        fahrenheit: Boolean,
+        cacheKey: String,
+        now: Long,
+    ): HomeWeatherObservation? {
+        // Open-Meteo's geocoder accepts a city name; do not transmit personal device location.
+        val coordinates = resolveCityCoordinates(normalized) ?: return null
+        val unit = if (fahrenheit) "fahrenheit" else "celsius"
+        val data =
+            json(
+                "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=${coordinates.first}&longitude=${coordinates.second}" +
+                    "&current=temperature_2m,weather_code&temperature_unit=$unit&timezone=auto",
+            )
+        return saveCityObservation(data.optJSONObject("current"), fahrenheit, cacheKey, now)
+    }
+
+    private fun resolveCityCoordinates(normalized: String): Pair<Double, Double>? {
+        val city = resolveWeatherCity(normalized) ?: return null
+        val latitude = city.optDouble("latitude", Double.NaN)
+        val longitude = city.optDouble("longitude", Double.NaN)
+        return if (latitude.isFinite() && longitude.isFinite()) latitude to longitude else null
+    }
+
+    private fun saveCityObservation(
+        current: JSONObject?,
+        fahrenheit: Boolean,
+        cacheKey: String,
+        now: Long,
+    ): HomeWeatherObservation? {
+        val temp = current?.optDouble("temperature_2m", Double.NaN) ?: Double.NaN
+        if (!temp.isFinite()) return null
+        val weatherCode = current?.optInt("weather_code", -1) ?: -1
+        val observation =
+            HomeWeatherObservation(
+                temp.roundToInt(),
+                if (fahrenheit) "°F" else "°C",
+                HomeWeatherCodes.description(weatherCode),
+            )
+        cache.edit {
+            putString("city_unit", cacheKey)
+            putLong("timestamp", now)
+            putString("weather", "${observation.temperature}|$weatherCode")
+        }
+        return observation
+    }
+
+    /** No raw device coordinates are persisted. Approximate location is consulted only on Home. */
+    @android.annotation.SuppressLint("MissingPermission") // guarded by coarse location check at start of method
+    suspend fun currentNearDevice(fahrenheit: Boolean): HomeWeatherObservation? =
+        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
+            if (applicationContext.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION) !=
+                PackageManager
+                    .PERMISSION_GRANTED
+            ) {
+                return@withContext null
+            }
+            val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
+            val cached = nearbyWeather
+            if (cached != null && now - nearbyAt in 0 until CACHE_LIFETIME_MS) return@withContext cached
+            val manager = applicationContext.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java) ?: return@withContext null
+            val provider = nearbyProvider(manager) ?: return@withContext null
+            val location = recentOrCurrentLocation(manager, provider, now) ?: return@withContext null
+            val observation = nearbyForecast(location, fahrenheit)
+            if (observation != null) {
+                nearbyWeather = observation
+                nearbyAt = now
+            }
+            observation ?: cached?.takeIf { now - nearbyAt in 0 until MAX_STALE_MS }
+        }
+
+    private fun resolveWeatherCity(normalized: String): JSONObject? {
+        val query = Uri.encode(normalized.substringBefore(",").trim())
+        val matches =
+            json("https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search?name=$query&count=10&language=en&format=json")
+                .optJSONArray("results")
+        val requestedRegion = normalized.substringAfter(',', "").trim()
+        val candidates =
+            if (matches == null) {
+                emptyList()
+            } else {
+                (0 until matches.length()).mapNotNull { matches.optJSONObject(it) }
+            }
+        return candidates.firstOrNull {
+            requestedRegion.isNotEmpty() && (
+                it.optString("admin1").equals(requestedRegion, ignoreCase = true) ||
+                    it.optString("country_code").equals(requestedRegion, ignoreCase = true)
+            )
+        } ?: candidates.firstOrNull()
+    }
+
+    private fun nearbyProvider(manager: LocationManager): String? =
+        when {
+            manager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER) -> LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER
+            manager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.PASSIVE_PROVIDER) -> LocationManager.PASSIVE_PROVIDER
+            else -> null
+        }
+
+    private suspend fun nearbyForecast(
+        location: Location,
+        fahrenheit: Boolean,
+    ): HomeWeatherObservation? {
+        val url =
+            "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=${location.latitude}&longitude=${location.longitude}" +
+                "&current=temperature_2m,weather_code&temperature_unit=" +
+                (if (fahrenheit) "fahrenheit" else "celsius") + "&timezone=auto"
+        return runCatching {
+            val current = json(url).optJSONObject("current") ?: return@runCatching null
+            val temp = current.optDouble("temperature_2m", Double.NaN)
+            if (!temp.isFinite()) return@runCatching null
+            HomeWeatherObservation(
+                temp.roundToInt(),
+                if (fahrenheit) "°F" else "°C",
+                HomeWeatherCodes.description(current.optInt("weather_code", -1)),
+                locationName = resolveLocality(location) ?: "Approximate location",
+            )
+        }.getOrNull()
+    }
+
+    // Called only after currentNearDevice has verified ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION.
+    @android.annotation.SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
+    private suspend fun recentOrCurrentLocation(
+        manager: LocationManager,
+        provider: String,
+        now: Long,
+    ): Location? {
+        val recent =
+            runCatching { manager.getLastKnownLocation(provider) }
+                .getOrNull()
+                ?.takeIf {
+                    now - it.time in
+                        0..(
+                            WEATHER_CURRENT_NEAR_DEVIC_VALUE_2 * WEATHER_CURRENT_NEAR_DEVIC_VALUE_60 *
+                                WEATHER_CURRENT_NEAR_DEVIC_VALUE_60 *
+                                WEATHER_CURRENT_NEAR_DEVIC_TIME_1000_L
+                        )
+                }
+        return recent ?: if (provider == LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER) {
+            withTimeoutOrNull(WEATHER_CURRENT_NEAR_DEVIC_TIME_8_000_L) {
+                suspendCancellableCoroutine<Location?> { continuation ->
+                    runCatching {
+                        manager.getCurrentLocation(provider, null, applicationContext.mainExecutor) { result ->
+                            if (continuation.isActive) continuation.resume(result)
+                        }
+                    }.onFailure { if (continuation.isActive) continuation.resume(null) }
+                }
+            }
+        } else {
+            runCatching { manager.getLastKnownLocation(provider) }.getOrNull()
+        }
+    }
+
+    /** Android's coarse location only; a city label is best-effort, not guessed. */
+    private suspend fun resolveLocality(location: Location): String? {
+        if (!Geocoder.isPresent()) return null
+        return withTimeoutOrNull(WEATHER_RESOLVE_LOCALITY_TIME_3_500_L) {
+            suspendCancellableCoroutine<String?> { continuation ->
+                val geocoder = Geocoder(applicationContext, Locale.getDefault())
+                runCatching {
+                    geocoder.getFromLocation(
+                        location.latitude,
+                        location.longitude,
+                        1,
+                        object : Geocoder.GeocodeListener {
+                            override fun onGeocode(addresses: MutableList<Address>) {
+                                val place =
+                                    addresses.firstOrNull()?.let { address ->
+                                        address.locality?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
+                                            ?: address.subAdminArea?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
+                                            ?: address.adminArea?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
+                                    }
+                                if (continuation.isActive) continuation.resume(place)
+                            }
+
+                            override fun onError(errorMessage: String?) {
+                                if (continuation.isActive) continuation.resume(null)
+                            }
+                        },
+                    )
+                }.onFailure { if (continuation.isActive) continuation.resume(null) }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun decode(text: String): HomeWeatherObservation? {
+        val pieces = text.split('|')
+        val temperature = pieces.getOrNull(0)?.toIntOrNull()
+        val code = pieces.getOrNull(1)?.toIntOrNull()
+        return if (pieces.size != 2 || temperature == null || code == null) {
+            null
+        } else {
+            val fahrenheit = cache.getString("city_unit", "")?.endsWith("|f") == true
+            HomeWeatherObservation(temperature, if (fahrenheit) "°F" else "°C", HomeWeatherCodes.description(code))
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun json(url: String): JSONObject {
+        val connection = URL(url).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
+        try {
+            connection.connectTimeout = WEATHER_JSON_VALUE_5000
+            connection.readTimeout = WEATHER_JSON_VALUE_5000
+            connection.requestMethod = "GET"
+            connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json")
+            if (connection.responseCode !in WEATHER_JSON_VALUE_200..WEATHER_HTTP_SUCCESS_MAX) {
+                error("Weather HTTP ${connection.responseCode}")
+            }
+            val response = connection.inputStream.bufferedReader().use { it.readText().take(WEATHER_JSON_MAX_160_000) }
+            return JSONObject(response)
+        } finally {
+            connection.disconnect()
+        }
+    }
+
+    companion object {
+        const val CACHE_LIFETIME_MS = 30 * 60_000L
+        private const val MAX_STALE_MS = 90 * 60_000L
+    }
+}

diff --git a/app/src/main/java/io/github/aimindseye/tenseven/platform/HubCountsProvider.kt b/app/src/main/java/io/github/aimindseye/tenseven/platform/HubCountsProvider.kt

--- /dev/null
+++ b/app/src/main/java/io/github/aimindseye/tenseven/platform/HubCountsProvider.kt
@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.platform
+
+import android.content.ContentProvider
+import android.content.ContentValues
+import android.database.Cursor
+import android.database.MatrixCursor
+import android.net.Uri
+import androidx.core.net.toUri
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.conversations.ConversationAccess
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.conversations.ConversationHub
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.live.AppUnreadCount
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model.HubUnreadCounts
+
+/**
+ * Read-only per-app counts for same-signature readers. Never publishes notification content.
+ * The installed package identity isolates development from the production Watch contract.
+ */
+class HubCountsProvider : ContentProvider() {
+    private var listening = false
+    private var published: List<AppUnreadCount>? = null
+    private val changed: () -> Unit = { notifyIfChanged() }
+
+    override fun onCreate(): Boolean {
+        val app = context ?: return false
+        if (!listening) {
+            published = snapshot(app)
+            ConversationHub.addChangeListener(changed)
+            LockLayerState.addChangeListener(changed)
+            listening = true
+            notifyIfChanged()
+        }
+        return true
+    }
+
+    override fun shutdown() {
+        ConversationHub.removeChangeListener(changed)
+        LockLayerState.removeChangeListener(changed)
+        listening = false
+        super.shutdown()
+    }
+
+    override fun query(
+        uri: Uri,
+        projection: Array<out String>?,
+        selection: String?,
+        selectionArgs: Array<out String>?,
+        sortOrder: String?,
+    ): Cursor? {
+        val app = context?.takeIf { valid(uri, it.packageName) } ?: return null
+        return snapshot(app)?.let { rows ->
+            MatrixCursor(arrayOf("package", "count"), rows.size).apply {
+                rows.forEach { addRow(arrayOf<Any>(it.packageName, it.count)) }
+                setNotificationUri(app.contentResolver, appsUri(app.packageName))
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    override fun getType(uri: Uri): String? =
+        context?.packageName?.takeIf { valid(uri, it) }?.let {
+            "vnd.android.cursor.dir/vnd.$it.hubcounts"
+        }
+
+    override fun insert(
+        uri: Uri,
+        values: ContentValues?,
+    ): Uri? = throw UnsupportedOperationException("Read-only provider")
+
+    override fun delete(
+        uri: Uri,
+        selection: String?,
+        selectionArgs: Array<out String>?,
+    ): Int = throw UnsupportedOperationException("Read-only provider")
+
+    override fun update(
+        uri: Uri,
+        values: ContentValues?,
+        selection: String?,
+        selectionArgs: Array<out String>?,
+    ): Int = throw UnsupportedOperationException("Read-only provider")
+
+    private fun snapshot(app: android.content.Context): List<AppUnreadCount>? {
+        if (!ConversationAccess.isGranted(app)) return null
+        ConversationHub.ensureStateLoaded(app)
+        return HubUnreadCounts.pick(LockLayerState.counts, ConversationHub.DEFAULT_MAX_APPS) {
+            ConversationHub.unreadCounts()
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun notifyIfChanged() {
+        val app = context ?: return
+        val different =
+            synchronized(this) {
+                val current = snapshot(app)
+                (current != published).also { if (it) published = current }
+            }
+        if (different) app.contentResolver.notifyChange(appsUri(app.packageName), null)
+    }
+
+    companion object {
+        const val PATH_APPS = "apps"
+
+        fun appsUri(applicationId: String): Uri = "content://$applicationId.hubcounts/$PATH_APPS".toUri()
+
+        private fun valid(
+            uri: Uri,
+            applicationId: String,
+        ): Boolean {
+            val authority = "$applicationId.hubcounts"
+            return uri.scheme == "content" && uri.authority == authority && uri.pathSegments == listOf(PATH_APPS)
+        }
+    }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.platform
+
+import java.io.File
+
+/** Read-only compatibility for existing Active Frames summaries. Never changes or migrates notes. */
+object LegacyNoteSummaries {
+    private const val MAGIC = "sable-note 1"
+    private const val PREVIEW_LIMIT = 120
+    private const val CHECKLIST_TEXT_GROUP = 3
+    private val heading = Regex("^#+\\s*")
+    private val checklist = Regex("^(\\s*)- \\[([ xX])] ?(.*)$")
+
+    data class Summary(
+        val title: String,
+        val preview: String,
+        val updatedAt: Long,
+    )
+
+    fun latest(directory: File): Summary? =
+        directory
+            .listFiles { file -> file.isFile && file.name.endsWith(".note") }
+            .orEmpty()
+            .mapNotNull { file -> runCatching { decode(file.readText()) }.getOrNull() }
+            .maxByOrNull { it.updatedAt }
+
+    private fun decode(text: String): Summary? {
+        val parts = text.split("\n\n", limit = 2)
+        val header = parts.first().lines()
+        if (parts.size != 2 || header.firstOrNull() != MAGIC) return null
+        val fields =
+            header
+                .drop(1)
+                .mapNotNull { line ->
+                    val at = line.indexOf(' ')
+                    if (at > 0) line.substring(0, at) to line.substring(at + 1) else null
+                }.toMap()
+        return fields["created"]?.toLongOrNull()?.let { created ->
+            summary(parts.last(), fields["updated"]?.toLongOrNull() ?: created)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun summary(
+        body: String,
+        updated: Long,
+    ): Summary {
+        val lines =
+            body
+                .lineSequence()
+                .map {
+                    checklist.matchEntire(it)?.groupValues?.get(CHECKLIST_TEXT_GROUP) ?: it.replace(heading, "")
+                }.map { it.trim() }
+                .filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
+                .toList()
+        val preview = lines.drop(1).joinToString(" · ")
+        val bounded = if (preview.length > PREVIEW_LIMIT) preview.take(PREVIEW_LIMIT).trimEnd() + "…" else preview
+        return Summary(lines.firstOrNull() ?: "Empty note", bounded, updated)
+    }
+}

+/** One SharedPreferences instance shared by all preference domains. */
+internal class StartStateBacking(
+    context: Context,
+) {
+    val hubSources = HubSourceRepository(context)
+    val preferences =
+        context.applicationContext.getSharedPreferences(
+            StartStateRepository.PREFERENCES_NAME,
+            Context.MODE_PRIVATE,
+        )
+
+    fun loadOrdered(key: String): List<String>? =
+        preferences
+            .getString(key, null)
+            ?.split(QUICK_BAR_SEPARATOR)
+            ?.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
+
+    fun saveOrdered(
+        key: String,
+        values: List<String>?,
+    ) {
+        preferences
+            .edit()
+            .apply {
+                if (values == null) {
+                    remove(key)
+                } else {
+                    putString(key, values.joinToString(QUICK_BAR_SEPARATOR))
+                }
+            }.apply()
+    }
+}

+                    "home_weather_use_device_location", "home_status_size",

+internal class StartAppearanceStateImpl(
+    private val shared: StartStateBacking,
+) : StartAppearanceState {
+    private val preferences: SharedPreferences get() = shared.preferences
+
+    /** The theme chosen in Tenseven (mode and accent, stable values); null means follow the system's Sable appearance. */
+    override fun loadAppearanceMode(): String? = preferences.getString(KEY_APPEARANCE_MODE, null)
+
+    override fun loadAppearanceAccent(): String? = preferences.getString(KEY_APPEARANCE_ACCENT, null)
+
+    /** Choosing a built-in theme also clears any imported theme that was chosen. */
+    override fun saveAppearance(
+        mode: String?,
+        accent: String?,
+    ) {
+        preferences
+            .edit()
+            .apply {
+                if (mode == null) remove(KEY_APPEARANCE_MODE) else putString(KEY_APPEARANCE_MODE, mode)
+                if (accent == null) remove(KEY_APPEARANCE_ACCENT) else putString(KEY_APPEARANCE_ACCENT, accent)
+                remove(KEY_APPEARANCE_CUSTOM)
+            }.apply()
+    }
+
+    /** The imported themes (a JSON array, see [CustomThemes.formatStored]); included in a backup. */
+    override fun loadCustomThemes(): List<CustomTheme> {
+        val storedThemes = preferences.getString(KEY_CUSTOM_THEMES, null)
+        return CustomThemes.parseStored(storedThemes)
+    }

+    }

+    override fun loadActiveCustomThemeId(): String? = preferences.getString(KEY_APPEARANCE_CUSTOM, null)
+
+    /** Uses the imported [theme]: its mode, the "custom" accent, and its id. */
+    override fun saveActiveCustomTheme(theme: CustomTheme) {
+        preferences
+            .edit()
+            .putString(KEY_APPEARANCE_MODE, theme.mode)
+            .putString(KEY_APPEARANCE_ACCENT, CustomThemes.ACCENT_VALUE)
+            .putString(KEY_APPEARANCE_CUSTOM, theme.id)
+            .apply()
+    }
+
+    /** Calls [listener] when the theme choice changes; the returned function stops listening. */
+    override fun onAppearanceChanged(listener: () -> Unit): () -> Unit {
+        val callback =
+            SharedPreferences.OnSharedPreferenceChangeListener { _, key ->
+                when (key) {
+                    KEY_APPEARANCE_MODE, KEY_APPEARANCE_ACCENT,
+                    KEY_APPEARANCE_CUSTOM, KEY_CUSTOM_THEMES,
+                    -> listener()
+                }
+            }
+        preferences.registerOnSharedPreferenceChangeListener(callback)
+        return { preferences.unregisterOnSharedPreferenceChangeListener(callback) }
+    }

+internal class StartBackupStateImpl(
+    private val shared: StartStateBacking,
+) : StartBackupState {
+    private val preferences: SharedPreferences get() = shared.preferences
+
+    /** The settings a backup carries (see LauncherBackup); nothing else in preferences is read. */
+    override fun exportSettings(): Map<String, BackupValue> = LauncherBackup.select(preferences.all)
+
+    /** Replaces every backed-up setting with [settings]: keys the file lacks go back to their defaults. */
+    override fun restoreSettings(settings: Map<String, BackupValue>) {
+        preferences
+            .edit()
+            .apply {
+                LauncherBackup.keys.forEach { remove(it) }
+                settings.forEach { (key, value) ->
+                    if (key in LauncherBackup.keys) {
+                        when (value) {
+                            is BackupValue.Text -> putString(key, value.value)
+                            is BackupValue.Number -> putInt(key, value.value)
+                            is BackupValue.Items -> putStringSet(key, value.values)
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }.apply()
+    }
+}

+private object TaskLimits {

+@Composable
+internal fun TaskItem(
+    task: TaskRecord,
+    onOpen: () -> Unit,
+    onComplete: () -> Unit,
+    onDelete: () -> Unit,
+    onTomorrow: () -> Unit,
+) {
+    val context = LocalContext.current
+    Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
+        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
+            Checkbox(checked = task.completed, onCheckedChange = { onComplete() })
+            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).clickable(onClick = onOpen)) {
+                Text(task.title, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge)
+                Text(
+                    listOfNotNull(
+                        task.dueAtEpochMs?.let { "Due " + whenFormatted(it) },
+                        task.remindAtEpochMs?.let { "Remind " + whenFormatted(it) },
+                        task.originPackage?.let { pkg ->
+                            "From " +
+                                runCatching {
+                                    context.packageManager
+                                        .getApplicationLabel(context.packageManager.getApplicationInfo(pkg, 0))
+                                        .toString()
+                                }.getOrDefault("Unavailable app")
+                        },
+                    ).joinToString(" · ").ifBlank { "No date" },
+                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
+                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
+                )
+            }
+        }
+        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
+            TextButton(onClick = onOpen) { Text("Edit") }
+            TextButton(onClick = onTomorrow, enabled = !task.completed) { Text("Tomorrow") }
+            if (task.originPackage != null) {
+                TextButton(onClick = {
+                    val launch = context.packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(task.originPackage)
+                    if (launch != null) {
+                        context.startActivity(launch)
+                    } else {
+                        android.widget.Toast
+                            .makeText(context, "Source app unavailable", android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_SHORT)
+                            .show()
+                    }
+                }) { Text("Open source") }
+            }
+            TextButton(onClick = onDelete) { Text("Delete") }
+        }
+    }
+}
