+private fun showTaskDatePicker(
+    context: android.content.Context,
+    zone: ZoneId,
+    current: Long?,
+    set: (Long) -> Unit,
+) {
+    val at = current?.let { Instant.ofEpochMilli(it).atZone(zone) } ?: java.time.ZonedDateTime.now(zone)
+    DatePickerDialog(context, { _, year, month, day ->
+        TimePickerDialog(context, { _, hour, minute ->
+            set(
+                LocalDateTime
+                    .of(year, month + 1, day, hour, minute)
+                    .atZone(zone)
+                    .toInstant()
+                    .toEpochMilli(),
+            )
+        }, at.hour, at.minute, true).show()
+    }, at.year, at.monthValue - 1, at.dayOfMonth).show()
+}

+    OutlinedTextField(

+        label = { Text("Details (optional)") },
+        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
+        maxLines = 4,
+    )

+private class TaskEditDraft(

+    var priority by mutableStateOf(task.priority)
+    var repeat by mutableStateOf(task.repeat)

+    var reminder by mutableStateOf(task.remindAtEpochMs)

+    fun updatedTask(

+                .filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
+                .take(TaskLimits.MAX_TAGS)

+            details = details,
+            priority = priority,
+            repeat = repeat,
+            dueAtEpochMs = due,
+            remindAtEpochMs = reminder,
+            tags = cleaned,

+            }) { Text("Repeat: " + draft.repeat.name) }

+private fun Modifier.startStripPreviewEvents(
+    state: StripInputState,
+    actions: StripNavigationActions,
+): Modifier {
+    val quickSlots = state.quickSlots
+    val phoneSlotFocused = state.phoneSlotFocused
+    val onMovePage = actions.onMovePage
+    val onQuickSlot = actions.onQuickSlot
+    val onDial = actions.onDial
+    val onCommand = actions.onCommand
+    return this
+        .onPreviewKeyEvent { event ->
+            val native = event.nativeKeyEvent
+            val delta = StartPages.keyDelta(native.keyCode, native.metaState)
+            val alt = native.metaState and (QuickBar.META_ALT_ON or QuickBar.META_FUNCTION_ON) != 0
+            val dial = if (phoneSlotFocused) QuickBar.dialChar(native.unicodeChar) else null
+            val slot =
+                QuickBar.shortcutSlot(
+                    keyCode = native.keyCode,
+                    metaState = native.metaState,
+                    slotCount = quickSlots.size,
+                    unicode = native.unicodeChar,
+                )
+            val action: (() -> Unit)? =
+                when {
+                    delta != null -> {
+                        { onMovePage(delta) }
+                    }
+
+                    alt && native.keyCode == AllAppsKeyPolicy.KEYCODE_SPACE -> {
+                        onCommand
+                    }
+
+                    dial != null -> {
+                        { onDial(dial) }
+                    }
+
+                    slot != null -> {
+                        { onQuickSlot(quickSlots[slot]) }
+                    }
+
+                    else -> {
+                        null
+                    }
+                }
+            if (action != null && event.type == KeyEventType.KeyDown && native.repeatCount == 0) action()
+            action != null
+        }

+    val speedDialLetters = state.speedDialLetters

+    val onTypeToSearch = actions.onTypeToSearch
+    val onSpeedDial = actions.onSpeedDial
+    return this

+            // What no frame, icon or slot took: Menu edits Home, printable keys search.
+            val native = event.nativeKeyEvent
+            if (DeviceCompatibility.keyAction(native) == LauncherKeys.Action.Menu) {
+                if (event.type == KeyEventType.KeyDown) onEditHome()

+            }

+                        unicode = native.unicodeChar,
+                        metaState = native.metaState,
+                        repeat = native.repeatCount > 0,
+                    )
+                } else {

+            val step =

+                    native.metaState,
+                    seed,
+                    speedDialLetters,

+                step is SpeedDialKeys.Step.Search -> onTypeToSearch(step.seed)
+                step == SpeedDialKeys.Step.Consume -> Unit
+                seed != null -> onTypeToSearch(seed.toString())
+                else -> return@onKeyEvent false

+/** One quiet, lifecycle-bound device readout, shared by BB7 and BB10. Never samples in Hidden mode. */
+@Suppress("FunctionNaming")
+@Composable
+internal fun BbHomeStatus(
+    mode: HomeStatusMode,
+    visible: Set<String>,
+    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
+) {
+    if (mode == HomeStatusMode.Hidden) return
+    val context = LocalContext.current.applicationContext
+    val lifecycle = LocalLifecycleOwner.current.lifecycle
+    val sampler = remember { DeviceStatsSampler() }
+    var stats by remember { mutableStateOf<DeviceStats?>(null) }
+    LaunchedEffect(lifecycle, mode, visible) {
+        lifecycle.repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.STARTED) {
+            while (true) {
+                stats = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { runCatching { sampler.sample(context) }.getOrNull() }
+                delay(STATUS_SAMPLE_MS)
+            }
+        }
+    }

+    // normalization; a value of "–" means Android did not provide a reading.
+    val metrics =
+        listOf(
+            Triple(HomeDisplayPolicy.CPU, "CPU", stats?.cpu),
+            Triple(HomeDisplayPolicy.RAM, "RAM", stats?.ram),
+            Triple(HomeDisplayPolicy.BATTERY, "BAT", stats?.battery),
+            Triple(HomeDisplayPolicy.WIFI, "Wi-Fi", stats?.wifiDown?.let(DeviceStatsFormat::heat)),
+            Triple(HomeDisplayPolicy.MOBILE, "Mobile", stats?.mobileDown?.let(DeviceStatsFormat::heat)),
+            Triple(HomeDisplayPolicy.CELL, "Cell", stats?.signal),
+            Triple(HomeDisplayPolicy.STORAGE, "Storage", stats?.storage),
+        ).filter { it.first in visible }

+    val textScale = header.statusSize.multiplier

+    // Titan 2; constrained viewports shrink labels and dial rings instead of wrapping.

+        val count = metrics.size.coerceAtLeast(1)
+        val cellWidth = maxWidth / count
+        val compact =
+            metrics.size > HOME_STATUS_BB_HOME_STATUS_VALUE_4 ||
+                cellWidth < HOME_STATUS_BB_HOME_STATUS_VALUE_56.dp
+        val diameter =
+            (cellWidth - 4.dp).coerceIn(
+                23.dp,
+                if (header.statusSize == io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model.HomeStatusSize.Larger) 47.dp else 43.dp,
+            )

+// One metric cell, preserving the parent RowScope's weight and single-line sizing.
+@Suppress("FunctionNaming")
+@Composable
+private fun androidx.compose.foundation.layout.RowScope.BbHomeStatusMetric(

+    metric: Triple<String, String, Float?>,

+    textScale: Float,

+            HomeStatusMode.Text -> {

+                    )
+                }
+            }
+
+            HomeStatusMode.Hidden -> {
+                Unit
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+/** Minimal original outline paths; each metric retains its full accessible label. */
+private fun statusMetricIcon(key: String): List<String> =
+    when (key) {
+        HomeDisplayPolicy.CPU -> {
+            listOf(
+                "M7 7h10v10H7z",
+                "M10 10h4v4h-4z",
+                "M3 8h4",
+                "M3 12h4",
+                "M3 16h4",
+                "M17 8h4",
+                "M17 12h4",
+                "M17 16h4",
+            )
+        }
+
+        HomeDisplayPolicy.RAM -> {
+            listOf("M3 7h18v10H3z", "M7 10v4", "M11 10v4", "M15 10v4", "M5 17v3", "M19 17v3")
+        }
+
+        HomeDisplayPolicy.BATTERY -> {
+            listOf("M3 7h16v10H3z", "M19 10h2v4", "M7 10v4", "M10 10v4")
+        }
+
+        HomeDisplayPolicy.WIFI -> {
+            listOf("M3 9c5 -5 13 -5 18 0", "M6 12c4 -3 8 -3 12 0", "M9 15c2 -2 4 -2 6 0", "M12 18h.01")
+        }
+
+        HomeDisplayPolicy.MOBILE -> {
+            listOf("M5 3h14v18H5z", "M9 17h6")
+        }
+
+        HomeDisplayPolicy.CELL -> {
+            listOf("M4 20v-3", "M9 20v-7", "M14 20v-11", "M19 20v-16")
+        }
+
+        HomeDisplayPolicy.STORAGE -> {
+            listOf("M4 7c0 -4 16 -4 16 0", "M4 7v11c0 4 16 4 16 0V7", "M4 12c0 4 16 4 16 0")
+        }
+
+        else -> {
+            listOf("M4 12h16")

+
+private fun statusPercent(value: Float?): String =
+    value?.takeIf { it.isFinite() }?.let { "${(it.coerceIn(0f, 1f) * HOME_STATUS_PERCENT_SCALE).roundToInt()}%" } ?: "–"
+
+@Suppress("FunctionNaming")
+@Composable
+private fun ThinStatusDial(
+    key: String,
+    label: String,
+    fraction: Float?,
+    diameter: Dp,
+    textScale: Float,
+) {
+    val progress = fraction?.takeIf { it.isFinite() }?.coerceIn(0f, 1f)
+    val accent = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
+    Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
+        Box(
+            Modifier.size(diameter).semantics { contentDescription = "$label ${statusPercent(progress)}" },
+            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
+        ) {
+            Canvas(Modifier.size(diameter - 4.dp)) {
+                drawArc(
+                    color = StatusTrack.copy(alpha = 0.65f),
+                    startAngle = -90f,
+                    sweepAngle = 360f,
+                    useCenter = false,
+                    style = Stroke(width = 2.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
+                )
+                if (progress != null) {
+                    drawArc(
+                        color = accent,
+                        startAngle = -90f,
+                        sweepAngle = 360f * progress,
+                        useCenter = false,
+                        style = Stroke(width = 2.dp.toPx(), cap = StrokeCap.Round),
+                    )
+                }
+            }
+            Text(
+                statusPercent(progress).removeSuffix("%"),
+                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground,
+                fontSize = ((if (diameter < 30.dp) 8f else 10f) * textScale).sp,
+                maxLines = 1,
+            )
+        }
+        LineIcon(
+            paths = statusMetricIcon(key),
+            modifier =
+                Modifier
+                    .size(if (diameter < 30.dp) 11.dp else 14.dp)
+                    .semantics { contentDescription = label },
+            tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
+        )
+    }
+}

+                    Modifier

+                    color = Bb10Text,
+                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge,
+                )
+            }
+        }
+    }

+/** Home reads new settings on resume; it does not require a launcher restart. */
+@Composable
+internal fun rememberHeaderOptions(): HeaderOptions {
+    val context = LocalContext.current
+    val lifecycle = LocalLifecycleOwner.current.lifecycle
+    val repository = remember(context) { StartStateRepository(context) }
+
+    fun read() =
+        HeaderOptions(
+            repository.loadLauncherTextSize(),
+            repository.loadHomeWeatherEnabled(),
+            repository.loadHomeWeatherCity(),
+            repository.loadHomeWeatherUseDeviceLocation(),
+            repository.loadHomeStatusSize(),
+        )
+    var current by remember(context) { mutableStateOf(read()) }
+    DisposableEffect(lifecycle, repository) {
+        val observer =
+            LifecycleEventObserver { _, event ->
+                if (event == Lifecycle.Event.ON_RESUME) current = read()
+            }
+        lifecycle.addObserver(observer)
+        // Preference changes must update active settings too, not only after leaving the Activity.
+        val stop = repository.onHomeReadabilityChanged { current = read() }
+        onDispose {
+            stop()
+            lifecycle.removeObserver(observer)
+        }
+    }
+    return current
+}

+internal fun TextUnit.safeLauncherScale(value: LauncherTextSize): TextUnit = this * value.multiplier
+
+/** Current conditions are optional; no placeholder or made-up temperature is displayed. */
+@Suppress("FunctionNaming")
+@Composable
+internal fun HomeWeatherLine(
+    options: HeaderOptions,
+    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
+) {
+    if (!options.showWeather || (!options.useDeviceLocation && options.city.isBlank())) return
+    val context = LocalContext.current.applicationContext
+    val locale = Locale.getDefault()
+    val fahrenheit = locale.country.equals("US", ignoreCase = true)
+    val lifecycle = LocalLifecycleOwner.current.lifecycle
+    val client = remember(context) { HomeWeatherClient(context) }
+    val weather by produceState<io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.platform.HomeWeatherObservation?>(
+        initialValue = null,
+        options.city,
+        options.useDeviceLocation,
+        fahrenheit,
+        lifecycle,
+    ) {
+        lifecycle.repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.STARTED) {
+            while (true) {
+                value =
+                    if (options.useDeviceLocation) {
+                        client.currentNearDevice(fahrenheit)
+                            ?: options.city.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { client.current(it, fahrenheit) }
+                    } else {
+                        client.current(options.city, fahrenheit)
+                    }
+                delay(HomeWeatherClient.CACHE_LIFETIME_MS)
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    val conditions = weather ?: return
+    val uriHandler = LocalUriHandler.current
+    // Display actual locality if Android's coarse-location geocoder provided it.
+    // If unavailable, be transparent instead of claiming an invented nearby city.
+    val locality =
+        if (options.useDeviceLocation) {
+            conditions.locationName ?: options.city.trim().takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: "Approximate location"
+        } else {
+            options.city.trim().ifBlank { "Selected city" }
+        }
+    Column(modifier = modifier) {
+        Text(
+            "$locality · ${conditions.temperature}${conditions.unit} ${conditions.condition}",
+            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
+            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontSize = (11f * options.size.multiplier).sp),
+            maxLines = 1,
+            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
+        )
+        // Attribution remains visible and tappable but does not replace the location name.
+        Text(
+            "Open-Meteo",
+            modifier = Modifier.clickable { uriHandler.openUri("https://open-meteo.com/") },
+            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
+            style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall.copy(fontSize = (9f * options.size.multiplier).sp),
+            maxLines = 1,
+        )
+    }
+}
+
+/** Scale only reading typography. Compact nav labels, indicators and system text keep original sizes. */
+@Suppress("FunctionNaming")
+@Composable
+internal fun ScaledLauncherTextTheme(content: @Composable () -> Unit) {
+    val multiplier = rememberHeaderOptions().size.multiplier
+    val base = MaterialTheme.typography
+    MaterialTheme(
+        typography =
+            base.copy(
+                headlineSmall = base.headlineSmall.copy(fontSize = base.headlineSmall.fontSize * multiplier),
+                titleLarge = base.titleLarge.copy(fontSize = base.titleLarge.fontSize * multiplier),
+                titleMedium = base.titleMedium.copy(fontSize = base.titleMedium.fontSize * multiplier),
+                bodyLarge = base.bodyLarge.copy(fontSize = base.bodyLarge.fontSize * multiplier),
+                bodyMedium = base.bodyMedium.copy(fontSize = base.bodyMedium.fontSize * multiplier),
+                bodySmall = base.bodySmall.copy(fontSize = base.bodySmall.fontSize * multiplier),
+                labelLarge = base.labelLarge.copy(fontSize = base.labelLarge.fontSize * multiplier),
+                labelMedium = base.labelMedium.copy(fontSize = base.labelMedium.fontSize * multiplier),
+                labelSmall = base.labelSmall.copy(fontSize = base.labelSmall.fontSize * multiplier),
+                titleSmall = base.titleSmall.copy(fontSize = base.titleSmall.fontSize * multiplier),
+            ),
+        content = content,
+    )
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.ui

+
+/** Named presentation/protocol values; numeric values unchanged from the reviewed source. */
+private const val HUB_COMPACT_BAR_HUB_COMPACT_VIEWS_VALUE_3 = 3
+
+/** Hub's own three-action navigation: never display the shared Home dock inside Hub. */
+@Suppress("FunctionNaming")
+@Composable
+internal fun HubCompactBar(
+    onViews: () -> Unit,
+    onCompose: () -> Unit,
+    onSearch: () -> Unit,
+) {
+    Row(
+        Modifier.fillMaxWidth().background(Bb10Background).padding(vertical = 3.dp),
+        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
+        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceEvenly,

+            listOf("M12 5h-7v14h14v-7", "M9 15l2 -5 8 -8 3 3 -8 8z"),
+            Modifier.weight(1f),
+            onCompose,
+        )
+        HubCompactControl("Search", LineIconPaths.SEARCH, Modifier.weight(1f), onSearch)
+    }
+}
+
+@Suppress("FunctionNaming")
+@Composable
+private fun HubCompactControl(
+    label: String,
+    paths: List<String>,
+    modifier: Modifier,
+    onClick: () -> Unit,
+) {
+    Column(
+        modifier
+            .heightIn(min = 52.dp)
+            .clickable(onClick = onClick)
+            .semantics { contentDescription = label }
+            .padding(vertical = 4.dp),
+        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
+        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
+    ) {
+        LineIcon(paths, Modifier.size(22.dp), Bb10Text)
+        Text(label, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall, color = Bb10Muted)
+    }
+}
+
+/** A flat list of the extra Hub views; none is mistaken for a new notification source. */
+@Suppress("FunctionNaming")
+@Composable
+internal fun HubCompactViews(
+    ui: HubConversationsUi,
+    onTabChange: (HubFilter) -> Unit,
+    onCalendar: () -> Unit,
+    onDismiss: () -> Unit,
+) {
+    val choices = listOf("All", "Unread", "Messages", "Email", "Snoozed", "Remind", "Calls", "Contacts", "Calendar")
+    Column(
+        Modifier
+            .fillMaxWidth()
+            .heightIn(max = 176.dp)
+            .background(Bb10Background)
+            .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
+    ) {
+        choices.chunked(HUB_COMPACT_BAR_HUB_COMPACT_VIEWS_VALUE_3).forEach { group ->
+            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp)) {
+                group.forEach { choice ->
+                    Text(
+                        choice,
+                        modifier =
+                            Modifier
+                                .weight(1f)
+                                .clickable {
+                                    onHubCompactChoice(choice, ui, onTabChange, onCalendar, onDismiss)
+                                }.padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 10.dp),
+                        color = Bb10Text,
+                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
+                    )
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/** Route a compact Hub action independently of the menu's Compose layout. */
+private fun onHubCompactChoice(
+    choice: String,
+    ui: HubConversationsUi,
+    onTabChange: (HubFilter) -> Unit,
+    onCalendar: () -> Unit,
+    onDismiss: () -> Unit,
+) {
+    when (choice) {
+        "Calendar" -> {
+            onCalendar()
+        }
+
+        "Remind" -> {
+            onTabChange(HubFilter.All)
+            ui.onShowReminders()
+        }
+
+        else -> {
+            val next =
+                when (choice) {
+                    "Messages" -> ConversationFilter(kind = ConversationKind.Messages)
+                    "Email" -> ConversationFilter(kind = ConversationKind.Email)
+                    "Unread" -> ConversationFilter(unreadOnly = true)
+                    "Snoozed" -> ConversationFilter(snoozed = true)
+                    else -> ConversationFilter()
+                }
+            onTabChange(
+                when (choice) {
+                    "Calls" -> HubFilter.Calls
+                    "Contacts" -> HubFilter.Contacts
+                    "Messages" -> HubFilter.Messages
+                    else -> HubFilter.All
+                },
+            )
+            ui.onFilterChange(next)
+            ui.onSourceChange(null)
+        }
+    }
+    onDismiss()
+}

+)
+

+private fun saveHubConversationReminder(
+    context: android.content.Context,
+    conversation: HubConversation,
+    due: Long?,
+) {
+    val n = conversation.latestNotification
+    io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.platform
+        .taskRepository(context)
+        .followUp(n.packageName, n.key, n.appName, due)
+    android.widget.Toast

+        .show()

+        enabledAppCount = snapshot.enabledAppCount,

+        deviceLocked = snapshot.capabilities.deviceLocked,
+        conversations = snapshot.conversations,
+        filter = selection.filter,
+        sourcePackage = selection.sourcePackage,
+        onSourceChange = selection.onSourceChange,
+        state = snapshot.state,
+        now = snapshot.now,
+        onFilterChange = selection.onFilterChange,
+        reminders = snapshot.reminders,
+        remindersSelected = selection.remindersSelected,
+        onShowReminders = selection.onShowReminders,
+        onMarkRead = { ConversationHub.markRead(dependencies.context, it) },
+        onSnooze = { conversation, until -> ConversationHub.snooze(dependencies.context, conversation, until) },
+        onWake = { ConversationHub.wake(dependencies.context, it) },

+                saveHubConversationReminder(dependencies.context, conversation, due)
+            }

+        onReply = { conversation, text -> ConversationHub.reply(dependencies.context, conversation, text) },
+        onAllowAccess = {
+            runCatching {
+                dependencies.context.startActivity(

+                )
+            }
+        },
+    )

+/** Keep consuming the initiating drag when opening Peek recomposes the overlay. */
+private fun Modifier.peekEdgeInput(
+    enabled: Boolean,
+    edge: Float,
+    open: State<Boolean>,
+    change: State<(Boolean) -> Unit>,
+): Modifier =
+    pointerInput(enabled, edge) {
+        if (!enabled) return@pointerInput
+        val slop = viewConfiguration.touchSlop
+        awaitEachGesture {
+            val down = awaitFirstDown(requireUnconsumed = false, pass = PointerEventPass.Initial)
+            if (open.value || !HubPeekGesture.startsAtEdge(down.position.x, edge)) return@awaitEachGesture
+            var opened = false
+            var dragging = true
+            while (dragging) {
+                val event = awaitPointerEvent(PointerEventPass.Initial)
+                val pointer = event.changes.firstOrNull { it.id == down.id }

+                    if (!opened && HubPeekGesture.opens(delta.x, delta.y, slop)) {

+                    }
+                }
+            }

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.ui
+
+import androidx.compose.foundation.gestures.detectTapGestures
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.WindowInsets
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.safeDrawing
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.windowInsetsPadding
+import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
+import androidx.compose.material3.Surface
+import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
+import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
+import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
+import androidx.compose.ui.input.pointer.pointerInput
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.design.SableAppearance
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.platform.WidgetHostController
+
+internal data class StartSurfaceStyle(
+    val appearance: SableAppearance,
+    val widgetsController: WidgetHostController?,
+    val homeWidgetIds: List<Int>,
+    val wallpaperBehind: Boolean,
+)
+
+/** Shared root theme, safe insets and empty-space gesture boundary; owns no launcher state. */
+@Composable
+internal fun StartContentSurface(
+    style: StartSurfaceStyle,
+    destination: SableStartDestination,
+    onDoubleTapEmpty: (() -> Unit)?,
+    content: @Composable () -> Unit,
+) {
+    SableThemeWithWidgets(
+        style.appearance,
+        style.widgetsController,
+        style.homeWidgetIds,
+        if (style.wallpaperBehind) HOME_BACKDROP_ALPHA else 1f,
+    ) {
+        // Home, Hub and app grid must use the same safe reading scale as Settings.
+        ScaledLauncherTextTheme {
+            val seeThrough = style.wallpaperBehind && destination == SableStartDestination.Start
+            Surface(
+                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
+                color = if (seeThrough) Color.Transparent else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background,
+            ) {
+                Box(
+                    modifier =
+                        Modifier
+                            .fillMaxSize()
+                            .windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.safeDrawing)
+                            .pointerInput(onDoubleTapEmpty, destination) {
+                                // Home only, and only empty space: taps on tiles and rows are consumed by them first.
+                                if (onDoubleTapEmpty != null && destination == SableStartDestination.Start) {
+                                    detectTapGestures(onDoubleTap = { onDoubleTapEmpty() })
+                                }
+                            },
+                ) {
+                    content()
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.conversations
+
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model.LockLayer
+import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
+import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
+import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
+import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
+import org.junit.Test
+
+/** D2 protection for Titan 2 findings: grouped chats, silent sources and lock-preview privacy. */
+class HubD2RegressionTest {
+    @Test
+    fun multipleWhatsAppChatsSurviveTheirGroupSummary() {
+        val notifications =
+            listOf(
+                NotificationGroupEntry("summary", "com.whatsapp", "group", true),
+                NotificationGroupEntry("first", "com.whatsapp", "group", false),
+                NotificationGroupEntry("second", "com.whatsapp", "group", false),
+            )
+        assertEquals(setOf("first", "second"), NotificationGroupSelection.visibleKeys(notifications))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun summarySurvivesIfItsOnlyChildCouldNotBeConverted() {
+        assertEquals(
+            setOf("summary"),
+            NotificationGroupSelection.visibleKeys(
+                listOf(NotificationGroupEntry("summary", "com.whatsapp", "group", true)),
+            ),
+        )
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun silentDeliveryIsNotAnExclusionReason() {
+        val silent = HubAuditSound.SILENT_CANDIDATE
+        val event =
+            HubAuditEvent(
+                "com.whatsapp",
+                HubAuditPolicy.reason(
+                    sameUser = true,
+                    ownApp = false,
+                    sourceEnabled = true,
+                    conversion = HubAuditConversion(failed = false, converted = true, retained = true),
+                ),
+                silent,
+            )
+        assertEquals(HubAuditReason.VISIBLE, event.reason)
+        assertEquals(HubAuditSound.SILENT_CANDIDATE, event.sound)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun lockCountsExcludeGroupSummariesAndOngoingButRetainSilentItems() {
+        // LockLayer tally intentionally has no sound input or rejection rule.
+        val notifications =
+            listOf(
+                Triple("com.whatsapp", false, true),
+                Triple("com.whatsapp", false, false),
+                Triple("com.whatsapp", false, false),
+                Triple("com.music", true, false),
+            )
+        assertEquals(mapOf("com.whatsapp" to 2), LockLayer.tally(notifications, "io.github.aimindseye.tenseven"))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun selectedNotificationPreviewNeverShowsWhileLocked() {
+        val msg =
+            ConversationMessage(
+                id = "m1",
+                conversationId = "c1",
+                notificationKey = "k1",
+                packageName = "com.whatsapp",
+                appName = "WhatsApp",
+                text = "A private test message",
+                timestamp = 100L,
+                senderName = "Sender",
+                isOutgoing = false,
+            )
+        val source =
+            HubNotification(
+                key = "k1",
+                conversationId = "c1",
+                conversationName = "Sender",
+                packageName = "com.whatsapp",
+                appName = "WhatsApp",
+                postedAt = 100L,
+                isOngoing = false,
+                messages = listOf(msg),
+                contentIntent = null,
+                replyAction = null,
+            )
+        val conversation = HubConversation("c1", "Sender", listOf(source), listOf(msg))
+        assertNull(conversationPreview(conversation, locked = true, you = "You"))
+        val readable = conversationPreview(conversation, locked = false, you = "You")
+        assertTrue(readable.orEmpty().contains("A private test message"))
+        assertFalse(readable.orEmpty().contains("notificationKey"))
+    }
+}

+    /** Menu: show the keys of this screen. */
+    Help,
+}
+
+/**
+ * The launcher's key habits in the bundled apps: Escape goes back (and out, from the first screen) and Menu shows
+ * the keys, as they do on Home. Applied only to a key the app itself did not use, so typing always wins. Pure,
+ * unit tested.
+ */
+object ExtraKeys {
+    fun action(
+        keyCode: Int,
+        repeatCount: Int,
+        alt: Boolean = false,
+        ctrl: Boolean = false,
+    ): ExtraKeyAction? {
+        if (repeatCount > 0 || alt || ctrl) return null
+        return when (keyCode) {
+            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ESCAPE -> ExtraKeyAction.Leave
+            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MENU -> ExtraKeyAction.Help
+            else -> null
+        }
+    }
+}

+// Derived from SableOS (github.com/aimindseye/zinwaq25-sableos @ 31420f599c2f,
+// sable-src/apps/r8/android/calculator/src/main),
+// Apache License 2.0. Changed: package and imports renamed for Tenseven; native Rust calls replaced by Kotlin where
+// noted.
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.calculator
+
+/** What a hardware key does on the calculator keypad. */
+internal sealed interface CalcKey {
+    data class Digit(
+        val digit: String,
+    ) : CalcKey
+
+    /** 0 +, 1 −, 2 ×, 3 ÷, the same codes the keypad and the native bridge use. */
+    data class Operation(
+        val code: Int,
+    ) : CalcKey {
+        companion object {
+            const val ADD = 0
+            const val SUBTRACT = 1
+            const val MULTIPLY = 2
+            const val DIVIDE = 3
+        }
+    }
+
+    data object Decimal : CalcKey
+
+    data object Equals : CalcKey
+
+    data object Backspace : CalcKey
+
+    data object Clear : CalcKey
+}
+
+/**
+ * Hardware keyboard input for the keypad. Pure, so it is unit-tested on the JVM.
+ *
+ * Keyboards without a number row (Q25, Titan 2) put digits and operators on the Alt layer. The calculator has no
+ * text field, so a plain key press also counts as its Alt character, the way a phone-style keypad works: on the
+ * Q25 W E R give 1 2 3 without holding Alt. A printable plain character wins when it means something here, so a
+ * number row or a numeric keypad behaves as printed.
+ */
+internal object CalculatorKeys {
+    // android.view.KeyEvent key codes (stable public ABI).
+    const val KEYCODE_ENTER = 66
+    const val KEYCODE_DEL = 67
+    const val KEYCODE_ESCAPE = 111
+    const val KEYCODE_FORWARD_DEL = 112
+    const val KEYCODE_NUMPAD_ENTER = 160
+
+    fun resolve(
+        keyCode: Int,
+        plain: Char?,
+        alt: Char?,
+        ctrlOrMeta: Boolean,
+    ): CalcKey? {
+        // Shortcuts stay with the system and the app.
+        if (ctrlOrMeta) return null
+        return when (keyCode) {
+            KEYCODE_ENTER, KEYCODE_NUMPAD_ENTER -> CalcKey.Equals
+            KEYCODE_DEL -> CalcKey.Backspace
+            KEYCODE_ESCAPE, KEYCODE_FORWARD_DEL -> CalcKey.Clear
+            else -> plain?.let(::forChar) ?: alt?.let(::forChar)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun forChar(c: Char): CalcKey? =
+        when (c) {
+            in '0'..'9' -> CalcKey.Digit(c.toString())
+            '.', ',' -> CalcKey.Decimal
+            '+' -> CalcKey.Operation(CalcKey.Operation.ADD)
+            '-', '−' -> CalcKey.Operation(CalcKey.Operation.SUBTRACT)
+            '*', '×' -> CalcKey.Operation(CalcKey.Operation.MULTIPLY)
+            '/', '÷' -> CalcKey.Operation(CalcKey.Operation.DIVIDE)
+            '=' -> CalcKey.Equals
+            else -> null
+        }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,221 @@
+// Ported from SableOS (github.com/aimindseye/zinwaq25-sableos @ 31420f599c2f), sable-src/apps/r8/rust/crates/
+// calculator-core and calculator-jni (Rust), Apache License 2.0. Changed: written in Kotlin with BigInteger, so the
+// app needs no native library; the "OK:" and "ERR:" text protocol and the arithmetic rules are unchanged.
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.calculator
+
+import java.math.BigInteger
+import java.util.Locale
+import kotlin.math.abs
+import kotlin.math.cos
+import kotlin.math.ln
+import kotlin.math.log10
+import kotlin.math.sin
+import kotlin.math.sqrt
+import kotlin.math.tan
+
+/** Exact decimal arithmetic and the unary scientific functions, answered as "OK:<value>" or "ERR:<reason>". */
+internal object NativeBridge {
+    private enum class Failure(
+        val code: String,
+    ) {
+        InvalidNumber("ERR:INVALID_NUMBER"),
+        DivisionByZero("ERR:DIVIDE_BY_ZERO"),
+        Overflow("ERR:OVERFLOW"),
+        Domain("ERR:DOMAIN"),
+    }
+
+    private class Fail(
+        val failure: Failure,
+    ) : Exception()
+
+    private val I128_MAX = BigInteger.ONE.shiftLeft(127) - BigInteger.ONE
+    private val I128_MIN = BigInteger.ONE.shiftLeft(127).negate()
+
+    fun selfTest(): String {
+        val binary = applyBinary("0.1", 0, "0.2")
+        val scientific = applyScientific("9", 0)
+        return if (binary == "OK:3/10" && scientific == "OK:3") {
+            "PASS:calculator-core:3/10:scientific:3"
+        } else {
+            "FAIL:calculator-core:$binary:$scientific"
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun applyBinary(
+        left: String,
+        operation: Int,
+        right: String,
+    ): String {
+        if (operation !in 0..3) return "ERR:INVALID_OPERATION"
+        return try {
+            val a = parseDecimal(left)
+            val b = parseDecimal(right)
+            "OK:" + apply(a, operation, b)
+        } catch (fail: Fail) {
+            fail.failure.code
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun applyScientific(
+        input: String,
+        operation: Int,
+    ): String {
+        if (operation !in 0..7) return "ERR:INVALID_OPERATION"
+        return try {
+            "OK:" + formatScientific(scientific(input, operation))
+        } catch (fail: Fail) {
+            fail.failure.code
+        }
+    }
+
+    /** value = numerator / denominator, lowest terms, denominator > 0, both within the signed 128-bit range. */
+    private class Exact(
+        val numerator: BigInteger,
+        val denominator: BigInteger,
+    ) {
+        override fun toString() = "$numerator/$denominator"
+    }
+
+    private fun checked(value: BigInteger): BigInteger {
+        if (value > I128_MAX || value < I128_MIN) throw Fail(Failure.Overflow)
+        return value
+    }
+
+    private fun make(
+        numerator: BigInteger,
+        denominator: BigInteger,
+    ): Exact {
+        if (denominator.signum() == 0) throw Fail(Failure.DivisionByZero)
+        if (numerator.signum() == 0) return Exact(BigInteger.ZERO, BigInteger.ONE)
+        val gcd = numerator.abs().gcd(denominator.abs())
+        var n = numerator.abs() / gcd
+        val d = denominator.abs() / gcd
+        if (numerator.signum() * denominator.signum() < 0) n = n.negate()
+        return Exact(checked(n), checked(d))
+    }
+
+    private data class DecimalParts(
+        val whole: String,
+        val fraction: String?,
+        val negative: Boolean,
+    )
+
+    private fun decimalParts(raw: String): DecimalParts {
+        val text = raw.trim()
+        val negative = text.startsWith("-")
+        val unsigned = if (text.startsWith("+") || negative) text.substring(1) else text
+        val parts = unsigned.split('.')
+        val whole = parts[0]
+        val fraction = parts.getOrNull(1)
+        val invalidFraction = fraction != null && !decimalDigits(fraction)
+        if (parts.size > 2 || !decimalDigits(whole) || invalidFraction) throw Fail(Failure.InvalidNumber)
+        return DecimalParts(whole, fraction, negative)
+    }
+
+    private fun decimalDigits(text: String): Boolean = text.isNotEmpty() && text.all { it in '0'..'9' }
+
+    private fun parseDecimal(raw: String): Exact {
+        val parts = decimalParts(raw)
+        val wholeValue = checked(BigInteger(parts.whole))
+        val fraction = parts.fraction
+        val denominator = if (fraction == null) BigInteger.ONE else checked(BigInteger.TEN.pow(fraction.length))
+        val fractionValue = if (fraction == null) BigInteger.ZERO else checked(BigInteger(fraction))
+        var numerator = checked(checked(wholeValue * denominator) + fractionValue)
+        if (parts.negative) numerator = checked(numerator.negate())
+        return make(numerator, denominator)
+    }
+
+    private fun apply(
+        a: Exact,
+        operation: Int,
+        b: Exact,
+    ): Exact =
+        when (operation) {
+            0 -> {
+                make(
+                    checked(checked(a.numerator * b.denominator) + checked(b.numerator * a.denominator)),
+                    checked(a.denominator * b.denominator),
+                )
+            }
+
+            1 -> {
+                make(
+                    checked(checked(a.numerator * b.denominator) - checked(b.numerator * a.denominator)),
+                    checked(a.denominator * b.denominator),
+                )
+            }
+
+            2 -> {
+                make(checked(a.numerator * b.numerator), checked(a.denominator * b.denominator))
+            }
+
+            else -> {
+                if (b.numerator.signum() == 0) throw Fail(Failure.DivisionByZero)
+                make(checked(a.numerator * b.denominator), checked(a.denominator * b.numerator))
+            }
+        }
+
+    private fun scientific(
+        text: String,
+        operation: Int,
+    ): Double {
+        val value = scientificInput(text)
+        val result =
+            when (operation) {
+                0 -> squareRoot(value)
+                1 -> value * value
+                2 -> reciprocal(value)
+                3 -> sin(Math.toRadians(value))
+                4 -> cos(Math.toRadians(value))
+                5 -> tan(Math.toRadians(value))
+                else -> logarithm(value, operation)
+            }
+        if (result.isNaN()) throw Fail(Failure.Domain)
+        if (!result.isFinite()) throw Fail(Failure.Overflow)
+        return result
+    }
+
+    private fun scientificInput(text: String): Double {
+        val value = text.trim().toDoubleOrNull() ?: throw Fail(Failure.InvalidNumber)
+        if (!value.isFinite()) throw Fail(Failure.Overflow)
+        return value
+    }
+
+    private fun squareRoot(value: Double): Double {
+        if (value < 0.0) throw Fail(Failure.Domain)
+        return sqrt(value)
+    }
+
+    private fun reciprocal(value: Double): Double {
+        if (value == 0.0) throw Fail(Failure.DivisionByZero)
+        return 1.0 / value
+    }
+
+    private fun logarithm(
+        value: Double,
+        operation: Int,
+    ): Double {
+        if (value <= 0.0) throw Fail(Failure.Domain)
+        return if (operation == 6) ln(value) else log10(value)
+    }
+
+    private fun formatScientific(value: Double): String {
+        val magnitude = abs(value)
+        return when {
+            value == 0.0 -> "0"
+            magnitude < 1.0e-9 || magnitude >= 1.0e12 -> exponential(value)
+            else -> fixed(value)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun exponential(value: Double): String {
+        val text = String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.10e", value)
+        val (mantissa, exponent) = text.split('e')
+        return mantissa + "e" + exponent.toInt()
+    }
+
+    private fun fixed(value: Double): String {
+        val rendered = String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.12f", value)
+        return if (rendered.contains('.')) rendered.trimEnd('0').trimEnd('.') else rendered
+    }
+}

diff --git a/app/src/test/java/io/github/aimindseye/tenseven/extras/convert/NativeBridge.kt b/app/src/test/java/io/github/aimindseye/tenseven/extras/convert/NativeBridge.kt

+// Ported from SableOS (github.com/aimindseye/zinwaq25-sableos @ 31420f599c2f), sable-src/apps/r8/rust/crates/
+// convert-core and convert-jni (Rust), Apache License 2.0. Changed: written in Kotlin with Long and BigInteger, so
+// the app needs no native library; the "OK:" and "ERR:" text protocol and the conversion table are unchanged.
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.convert
+
+import java.math.BigInteger
+
+/** Fixed-point (thousandths) unit conversion, answered as "OK:<milli>" or "ERR:<reason>". */
+internal object NativeBridge {
+    private enum class Category { Length, Mass, Temperature, Volume }
+
+    // The frozen unit codes, in order: 0 mm, 1 cm, 2 m, 3 km, 4 in, 5 ft, 6 mi, 7 g, 8 kg, 9 oz, 10 lb,
+    // 11 C, 12 F, 13 K, 14 mL, 15 L, 16 cup, 17 gal.
+    private val categories =
+        listOf(
+            Category.Length,
+            Category.Length,
+            Category.Length,
+            Category.Length,
+            Category.Length,
+            Category.Length,
+            Category.Length,
+            Category.Mass,
+            Category.Mass,
+            Category.Mass,
+            Category.Mass,
+            Category.Temperature,
+            Category.Temperature,
+            Category.Temperature,
+            Category.Volume,
+            Category.Volume,
+            Category.Volume,
+            Category.Volume,
+        )
+
+    // numerator, denominator relative to the category's base unit (mm, g, mL); temperatures have none.
+    private val ratios: List<Pair<Long, Long>?> =
+        listOf(
+            1L to 1L,
+            10L to 1L,
+            1_000L to 1L,
+            1_000_000L to 1L,
+            254L to 10L,
+            3_048L to 10L,
+            1_609_344L to 1L,
+            1L to 1L,
+            1_000L to 1L,
+            28_349_523_125L to 1_000_000_000L,
+            45_359_237L to 100_000L,
+            null,
+            null,
+            null,
+            1L to 1L,
+            1_000L to 1L,
+            2_365_882_365L to 10_000_000L,
+            3_785_411_784L to 1_000_000L,
+        )
+
+    private val LONG_MIN = BigInteger.valueOf(Long.MIN_VALUE)
+    private val LONG_MAX = BigInteger.valueOf(Long.MAX_VALUE)
+    private val I128_MAX = BigInteger.ONE.shiftLeft(127) - BigInteger.ONE
+    private val I128_MIN = BigInteger.ONE.shiftLeft(127).negate()
+
+    fun selfTest(): String =
+        convertMilli(5_000, 6, 3).let {
+            if (it == "OK:8047") "PASS:convert-core:8047" else "FAIL:convert-core:$it"
+        }
+
+    fun convertMilli(
+        valueMilli: Long,
+        fromUnit: Int,
+        toUnit: Int,
+    ): String =
+        when {
+            fromUnit !in categories.indices || toUnit !in categories.indices -> "ERR:INVALID_UNIT"
+            categories[fromUnit] != categories[toUnit] -> "ERR:INCOMPATIBLE_UNITS"
+            else -> converted(valueMilli, fromUnit, toUnit)
+        }
+
+    private fun converted(
+        valueMilli: Long,
+        fromUnit: Int,
+        toUnit: Int,
+    ): String {
+        val result =
+            if (categories[fromUnit] == Category.Temperature) {
+                temperature(valueMilli, fromUnit, toUnit)
+            } else {
+                linear(valueMilli, fromUnit, toUnit)
+            }
+        return if (result == null) "ERR:OUT_OF_RANGE" else "OK:$result"
+    }
+
+    private fun linear(
+        value: Long,
+        from: Int,
+        to: Int,
+    ): Long? {
+        val (fromNum, fromDen) = ratios[from]!!
+        val (toNum, toDen) = ratios[to]!!
+        val numerator = BigInteger.valueOf(value) * BigInteger.valueOf(fromNum) * BigInteger.valueOf(toDen)
+        val denominator = BigInteger.valueOf(fromDen) * BigInteger.valueOf(toNum)
+        if (numerator > I128_MAX || numerator < I128_MIN) return null
+        return toLongOrNull(divRound(numerator, denominator))
+    }
+
+    private fun temperature(
+        value: Long,
+        from: Int,
+        to: Int,
+    ): Long? {
+        val v = BigInteger.valueOf(value)
+        val celsius =
+            when (from) {
+                11 -> v
+                12 -> divRound((v - BigInteger.valueOf(32_000)) * BigInteger.valueOf(5), BigInteger.valueOf(9))
+                else -> v - BigInteger.valueOf(273_150)
+            }
+        if (celsius < BigInteger.valueOf(-273_150)) return null
+        val converted =
+            when (to) {
+                11 -> celsius
+                12 -> divRound(celsius * BigInteger.valueOf(9), BigInteger.valueOf(5)) + BigInteger.valueOf(32_000)
+                else -> celsius + BigInteger.valueOf(273_150)
+            }
+        return toLongOrNull(converted)
+    }
+
+    /** Rounds half away from zero, as the Rust core did. The denominator is positive. */
+    private fun divRound(
+        numerator: BigInteger,
+        denominator: BigInteger,
+    ): BigInteger {
+        val half = denominator / BigInteger.valueOf(2)
+        return if (numerator.signum() >= 0) {
+            (numerator + half) / denominator
+        } else {
+            ((numerator.negate() + half) / denominator).negate()
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun toLongOrNull(value: BigInteger): Long? =
+        when {
+            value < LONG_MIN || value > LONG_MAX -> null
+            else -> value.toLong()

+// sable-src/apps/r8/android/notes/src/main),
+// Apache License 2.0. Changed: package and imports renamed for Tenseven; native Rust calls replaced by Kotlin where

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.notes.core
+
+/**
+ * Checklist lines in a note's text: "- [ ] milk" is open, "- [x] milk" is done. The text stays
+ * plain, so an exported note reads the same in any editor.
+ */
+object Checklist {
+    const val OPEN = "- [ ] "
+    const val DONE = "- [x] "
+    private val ITEM = Regex("""^(\s*)- \[([ xX])] ?(.*)$""")
+
+    data class Item(
+        val indent: String,
+        val text: String,
+        val done: Boolean,
+    )
+
+    data class Progress(
+        val done: Int,
+        val total: Int,
+    )
+
+    /** An edit to the text: the new text and where the cursor goes. */
+    data class Edit(
+        val text: String,
+        val cursor: Int,
+    )
+
+    fun parse(line: String): Item? =
+        ITEM.matchEntire(line)?.let { match ->
+            val (indent, mark, text) = match.destructured
+            Item(indent, text, mark != " ")
+        }
+
+    fun progress(body: String): Progress {
+        val items = body.lineSequence().mapNotNull(::parse).toList()
+        return Progress(items.count { it.done }, items.size)
+    }
+
+    /** Ticks or unticks the item on line [line] (0-based); null when that line is not an item. */
+    fun toggleLine(
+        body: String,
+        line: Int,
+    ): String? {
+        val lines = body.split('\n').toMutableList()
+        val item = lines.getOrNull(line)?.let(::parse) ?: return null
+        lines[line] = item.indent + (if (item.done) OPEN else DONE) + item.text
+        return lines.joinToString("\n")
+    }
+
+    /** Ctrl+Enter: ticks or unticks the item under the cursor, keeping the cursor on its line. */
+    fun toggleAt(
+        body: String,
+        cursor: Int,
+    ): Edit? {
+        val line = lineIndex(body, cursor)
+        val text = toggleLine(body, line) ?: return null
+        return Edit(text, cursor.coerceIn(0, text.length))
+    }
+
+    /** Ctrl+T: turns the line under the cursor into an open item, or an item back into plain text. */
+    fun convertAt(
+        body: String,
+        cursor: Int,
+    ): Edit {
+        val start = lineStart(body, cursor)
+        val end = lineEnd(body, cursor)
+        val line = body.substring(start, end)
+        val item = parse(line)
+        val replaced =
+            if (item != null) {
+                item.indent + item.text
+            } else {
+                val indent = line.takeWhile { it == ' ' || it == '\t' }
+                indent + OPEN + line.substring(indent.length)
+            }
+        val delta = replaced.length - line.length
+        val text = body.substring(0, start) + replaced + body.substring(end)
+        return Edit(text, (cursor + delta).coerceIn(start, start + replaced.length))
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Enter at the end of an item starts the next open item, as list apps do; Enter on an empty item
+     * ends the list. Null when the cursor's line is not an item, so Enter types a plain newline.
+     */
+    fun newline(
+        body: String,
+        cursor: Int,
+    ): Edit? {
+        val start = lineStart(body, cursor)
+        val end = lineEnd(body, cursor)
+        return parse(body.substring(start, end))?.let { item ->
+            if (item.text.isBlank()) {
+                Edit(body.substring(0, start) + body.substring(end), start)
+            } else {
+                val insert = "\n" + item.indent + OPEN
+                Edit(body.substring(0, cursor) + insert + body.substring(cursor), cursor + insert.length)
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun lineIndex(
+        body: String,
+        cursor: Int,
+    ): Int = body.substring(0, cursor.coerceIn(0, body.length)).count { it == '\n' }
+
+    private fun lineStart(
+        body: String,
+        cursor: Int,
+    ): Int = body.lastIndexOf('\n', cursor.coerceIn(0, body.length) - 1) + 1
+
+    private fun lineEnd(
+        body: String,
+        cursor: Int,
+    ): Int = body.indexOf('\n', cursor.coerceIn(0, body.length)).let { if (it < 0) body.length else it }
+}

+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.notes.core.NotesText.t
+
+/**
+ * One note: plain text with lightweight structure ("# " headings and [Checklist] lines) and an
+ * optional colour label. The first line that has text is the title.
+ */
+data class Note(
+    val id: String,
+    val body: String,
+    val createdAt: Long,
+    val updatedAt: Long,
+    val label: NoteLabel = NoteLabel.NONE,
+) {
+    val title: String get() = NoteText.title(body)
+}
+
+private object NoteColors {
+    const val NONE: Long = 0xFF64748B
+    const val YELLOW: Long = 0xFFF5C542
+    const val ORANGE: Long = 0xFFF28C45
+    const val RED: Long = 0xFFE5534B
+    const val PINK: Long = 0xFFE8458F
+    const val PURPLE: Long = 0xFF7A42E8
+    const val BLUE: Long = 0xFF4D9CFF
+    const val GREEN: Long = 0xFF35C66B
+}
+
+/** Colour labels, as in Color Notes and BlackBerry Remember's categories. [NONE] draws a neutral bar. */
+enum class NoteLabel(
+    val argb: Long,
+    private val nameKey: String,
+) {
+    NONE(NoteColors.NONE, "no_colour"),
+    YELLOW(NoteColors.YELLOW, "yellow"),
+    ORANGE(NoteColors.ORANGE, "orange"),
+    RED(NoteColors.RED, "red"),
+    PINK(NoteColors.PINK, "pink"),
+    PURPLE(NoteColors.PURPLE, "purple"),
+    BLUE(NoteColors.BLUE, "blue"),
+    GREEN(NoteColors.GREEN, "green"),
+    ;
+
+    val displayName: String get() = t(nameKey)
+
+    fun next(): NoteLabel = entries[(ordinal + 1) % entries.size]
+
+    companion object {
+        fun parse(name: String?): NoteLabel = entries.firstOrNull { it.name == name } ?: NONE
+    }
+}
+
+/** Title and preview text for lists. */
+object NoteText {
+    val UNTITLED: String get() = t("empty_note")
+    private const val PREVIEW_CHARS = 120
+    private val HEADING = Regex("""^#+\s*""")
+
+    fun title(body: String): String = lines(body).firstOrNull() ?: UNTITLED
+
+    /** The lines after the title, joined on one line. */
+    fun preview(body: String): String =
+        lines(body).drop(1).joinToString(" · ").let {
+            if (it.length > PREVIEW_CHARS) it.take(PREVIEW_CHARS).trimEnd() + "…" else it
+        }
+
+    /** Non-blank lines without heading or checklist markers. */
+    private fun lines(body: String): List<String> =

+            .lineSequence()

+            .map { it.trim() }

+            .toList()

+// Derived from SableOS (github.com/aimindseye/zinwaq25-sableos @ 31420f599c2f,
+// sable-src/apps/r8/android/notes/src/main),
+// Apache License 2.0. Changed: package and imports renamed for Tenseven; native Rust calls replaced by Kotlin where
+// noted.
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.notes.core
+
+/**
+ * The on-disk form of a note: a short header, a blank line, then the text verbatim.
+ *
+ * ```
+ * sable-note 1
+ * label YELLOW
+ * created 1730000000000
+ * updated 1730000000000
+ *
+ * Shopping
+ * - [ ] milk
+ * ```
+ */
+object NoteCodec {
+    const val MAGIC = "sable-note 1"
+
+    fun encode(note: Note): String =
+        buildString {
+            append(MAGIC).append('\n')
+            append("label ").append(note.label.name).append('\n')
+            append("created ").append(note.createdAt).append('\n')
+            append("updated ").append(note.updatedAt).append('\n')
+            append('\n')
+            append(note.body)
+        }
+
+    /** Null when [text] is not a note this version writes. */
+    fun decode(
+        id: String,
+        text: String,
+    ): Note? {
+        val split = text.indexOf("\n\n")
+        val header = if (split < 0) emptyList() else text.substring(0, split).split('\n')
+        if (header.firstOrNull() != MAGIC) return null
+        val fields =
+            header
+                .drop(1)
+                .mapNotNull { line ->
+                    line.indexOf(' ').takeIf { it > 0 }?.let { line.substring(0, it) to line.substring(it + 1) }
+                }.toMap()
+        return fields["created"]?.toLongOrNull()?.let { created ->
+            val updated = fields["updated"]?.toLongOrNull() ?: created
+            Note(id, text.substring(split + 2), created, updated, NoteLabel.parse(fields["label"]))
+        }
+    }
+}

+// Derived from SableOS (github.com/aimindseye/zinwaq25-sableos @ 31420f599c2f,
+// sable-src/apps/r8/android/notes/src/main),
+// Apache License 2.0. Changed: package and imports renamed for Tenseven; native Rust calls replaced by Kotlin where
+// noted.
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.notes.core
+
+/** Search across notes (every word must appear) and find-in-note. Case is ignored. */
+object NoteSearch {
+    private const val CONTEXT_CHARS = 24
+
+    data class Hit(
+        val note: Note,
+        /** The text around the first match, or null when the match is in the title. */
+        val context: String?,
+    )
+
+    fun search(
+        notes: List<Note>,
+        query: String,
+    ): List<Hit> {
+        val words = query.trim().split(Regex("\\s+")).filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
+        if (words.isEmpty()) return notes.map { Hit(it, null) }
+        return notes
+            .filter { note -> words.all { note.body.contains(it, ignoreCase = true) } }
+            .map { Hit(it, context(it, words.first())) }
+    }
+
+    /** The next match of [query] at or after [from], wrapping to the start; null when there is none. */
+    fun nextMatch(
+        body: String,
+        query: String,
+        from: Int,
+    ): IntRange? {
+        val start = from.coerceIn(0, body.length)
+        val at =
+            body.indexOf(query, start, ignoreCase = true).takeIf { it >= 0 }
+                ?: body.indexOf(query, 0, ignoreCase = true)
+        return if (query.isEmpty() || at < 0) null else at until at + query.length
+    }
+
+    private fun context(
+        note: Note,
+        word: String,
+    ): String? {
+        if (note.title.contains(word, ignoreCase = true)) return null
+        val at = note.body.indexOf(word, ignoreCase = true)
+        val start = (at - CONTEXT_CHARS).coerceAtLeast(0)
+        val end = (at + word.length + CONTEXT_CHARS).coerceAtMost(note.body.length)
+        val text =
+            note.body
+                .substring(start, end)
+                .replace('\n', ' ')
+                .trim()
+        return (if (start > 0) "…" else "") + text + (if (end < note.body.length) "…" else "")
+    }
+}

+// Derived from SableOS (github.com/aimindseye/zinwaq25-sableos @ 31420f599c2f,
+// sable-src/apps/r8/android/notes/src/main),
+// Apache License 2.0. Changed: package and imports renamed for Tenseven; native Rust calls replaced by Kotlin where
+// noted.
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.notes.core
+
+import java.io.File
+import java.nio.file.Files
+import java.util.UUID
+
+/** Notes as files in an app-private directory, one `<id>.note` file each ([NoteCodec]). */
+class NoteStore(
+    private val dir: File,
+) {
+    /** Every readable note, latest edit first. */
+    fun list(): List<Note> =
+        dir
+            .listFiles { file -> file.isFile && file.name.endsWith(SUFFIX) }
+            .orEmpty()
+            .mapNotNull { file ->
+                runCatching { NoteCodec.decode(file.name.removeSuffix(SUFFIX), file.readText()) }.getOrNull()
+            }.sortedByDescending { it.updatedAt }
+
+    /** Writes to a temporary file and renames it, so a crash never leaves half a note. */
+    fun save(note: Note) {
+        dir.mkdirs()
+        val tmp = File(dir, note.id + ".tmp")
+        tmp.writeText(NoteCodec.encode(note))
+        if (!tmp.renameTo(file(note.id))) {
+            Files.deleteIfExists(tmp.toPath())
+            error("could not save note ${note.id}")
+        }
+    }
+
+    /** Throws when the file exists and cannot be removed. */
+    fun delete(id: String) {
+        Files.deleteIfExists(file(id).toPath())
+    }
+
+    private fun file(id: String): File {
+        require(ID.matches(id)) { "bad note id" }
+        return File(dir, id + SUFFIX)
+    }
+
+    companion object {
+        private const val SUFFIX = ".note"
+        private val ID = Regex("[0-9a-f-]{36}")
+
+        fun newId(): String = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.notes.core
+
+import java.time.Instant
+import java.time.ZoneId
+import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
+import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit
+import java.util.Locale
+
+/** Short "when edited" labels: 14:05 today, Mon this week, 3 Oct this year, 3 Oct 2025 before. */
+object NoteTime {
+    private const val WEEK_DAYS = 6L
+
+    fun label(
+        at: Long,
+        now: Long,
+        zone: ZoneId = ZoneId.systemDefault(),
+        locale: Locale = Locale.getDefault(),
+    ): String {
+        val then = Instant.ofEpochMilli(at).atZone(zone)
+        val today = Instant.ofEpochMilli(now).atZone(zone).toLocalDate()
+        val day = then.toLocalDate()
+        val pattern =
+            when {
+                day == today -> "HH:mm"
+                !day.isAfter(today) && ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(day, today) <= WEEK_DAYS -> "EEE"
+                day.year == today.year -> "d MMM"
+                else -> "d MMM yyyy"
+            }
+        return then.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(pattern, locale))
+    }
+}

+    ToggleItem(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_T, 'T', "tick_or_untick_this_item"),
+    Find(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_F, 'F', "find_in_note"),
+    FindNext(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_G, 'G', "find_next"),
+    Label(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_C, 'C', "colour"),
+    Share(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_S, 'S', "share"),
+    Export(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_E, 'E', "export_to_a_file"),
+    Delete(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_D, 'D', "delete_note"),
+    ;
+
+    val label: String get() = t(labelKey)
+
+    companion object {
+        fun forKey(keyCode: Int): EditorMenu? = entries.firstOrNull { it.key == keyCode }
+    }
+}
+
+/** Tasks screen keys. */
+enum class TasksKey { OpenNote, History }
+
+/**
+ * The Notes keymap (UTILITIES_NOTES_RECORDER_UX: Ctrl+N new, Ctrl+S save, Ctrl+F find, Ctrl+Enter
+ * complete checklist item, Esc leave the editor). T, B, N, P and Space stay the shared list moves
+ * ([io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.design.SableListKeys]), so C composes a new note, as on BlackBerry.
+ */
+object NotesKeys {
+    val LIST_HINT: String get() = t("c_new_s_find_k")
+    val EDITOR_HINT: String get() = t("menu_list_item_tick_find")
+    val TASKS_HINT: String get() = t("enter_tick_o_open_note")
+
+    fun list(
+        keyCode: Int,
+        ctrl: Boolean,
+        chord: Boolean,
+    ): ListKey? =
+        when {
+            ctrl && keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_N -> {
+                ListKey.New
+            }
+
+            ctrl && keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_F -> {
+                ListKey.Search
+            }
+
+            chord -> {
+                null
+            }
+
+            else -> {
+                when (keyCode) {
+                    KeyEvent.KEYCODE_C -> ListKey.New
+                    KeyEvent.KEYCODE_S, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_SLASH -> ListKey.Search
+                    KeyEvent.KEYCODE_K -> ListKey.Tasks
+                    KeyEvent.KEYCODE_L -> ListKey.Label
+                    KeyEvent.KEYCODE_D, KeyEvent.KEYCODE_FORWARD_DEL -> ListKey.Delete
+                    KeyEvent.KEYCODE_I -> ListKey.Import
+                    else -> null
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+    fun editor(
+        keyCode: Int,
+        ctrl: Boolean,
+        alt: Boolean,
+    ): EditorKey? {
+        val enter = keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ENTER || keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_NUMPAD_ENTER
+        return when {
+            keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_ESCAPE -> EditorKey.Close
+
+            keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_MENU -> EditorKey.Menu
+
+            // Enter has no Alt character on the Q25, so Alt+Enter ticks there.
+            enter && (ctrl || alt) -> EditorKey.ToggleItem
+
+            ctrl -> CTRL[keyCode]
+
+            else -> null
+        }
+    }
+
+    private val CTRL =
+        mapOf(
+            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_S to EditorKey.Save,
+            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_F to EditorKey.Find,
+            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_G to EditorKey.FindNext,
+            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_T to EditorKey.MakeItem,
+            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_L to EditorKey.Label,
+            KeyEvent.KEYCODE_E to EditorKey.Export,
+        )
+
+    fun tasks(
+        keyCode: Int,
+        chord: Boolean,
+    ): TasksKey? =
+        when {
+            chord -> null
+            keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_O -> TasksKey.OpenNote
+            keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_H -> TasksKey.History
+            else -> null
+        }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.notes.core
+
+/** Checklist items gathered from every note: the Tasks screen. */
+object Tasks {
+    data class Task(
+        val noteId: String,
+        val noteTitle: String,
+        /** The item's line in its note (0-based), for [Checklist.toggleLine]. */
+        val line: Int,
+        val text: String,
+        val done: Boolean,
+    )
+
+    /** Open items, latest-edited note first; done items too only when [withDone] (explicit history). */
+    fun collect(
+        notes: List<Note>,
+        withDone: Boolean,
+    ): List<Task> =
+        notes.sortedByDescending { it.updatedAt }.flatMap { note ->
+            note.body.split('\n').mapIndexedNotNull { line, text ->
+                Checklist
+                    .parse(text)
+                    ?.takeIf { (withDone || !it.done) && it.text.isNotBlank() }
+                    ?.let { Task(note.id, note.title, line, it.text, it.done) }
+            }
+        }
+}

+// Derived from SableOS (github.com/aimindseye/zinwaq25-sableos, patches/sable-src 0076, 0077 and 0085:
+// sable-src/apps/titan2/platform/profiles),
+// Apache License 2.0. Changed: package and imports renamed for Tenseven; the Sable palette replaced by a fixed one;
+// English only (no string resources); no Quick Settings tile.
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.profiles.core
+
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.profiles.core.ProfilesText.t
+
+/**
+ * BlackBerry sound profiles. Picking one sets the ringer, Do Not Disturb, the ring and notification
+ * volumes, vibration, the notification light and, when the profile has them, its own ringtone and
+ * notification tone. Pure: [plan] says what to set and the Android side sets it.
+ */
+enum class SoundProfile(
+    private val titleKey: String,
+    private val summaryKey: String,
+) {
+    NORMAL("normal", "rings_and_alerts_at_your"),
+    LOUD("loud", "rings_and_alerts_at_full"),
+    VIBRATE_ONLY("vibrate_only", "vibrates_for_calls_and_alerts"),
+    PHONE_CALLS_ONLY("phone_calls_only", "only_calls_ring_messages_and"),
+    ALL_ALERTS_OFF("all_alerts_off", "nothing_rings_or_vibrates_alarms"),
+    ;
+
+    val title: String get() = t(titleKey)
+    val summary: String get() = t(summaryKey)
+
+    companion object {
+        fun fromName(name: String?): SoundProfile? = entries.firstOrNull { it.name == name }
+    }
+}
+
+enum class Ringer { NORMAL, VIBRATE, SILENT }
+
+/** Do Not Disturb as Android's interruption filters: off, priority only (calls), alarms only. */
+enum class Dnd { OFF, CALLS_ONLY, ALARMS_ONLY }
+
+/** What the user changed for one profile; null keeps the profile's default or the phone's current tone. */
+data class ProfileSettings(
+    /** Ring and notification volume, 0 to 100 percent of the stream's maximum. */
+    val volumePercent: Int? = null,
+    val vibrate: Boolean? = null,
+    val light: Boolean? = null,
+    val ringtone: String? = null,
+    val notificationTone: String? = null,
+)
+
+/** Everything one profile sets. A null volume or tone leaves it as it is. */
+data class ProfilePlan(
+    val ringer: Ringer,
+    val dnd: Dnd,
+    val volumePercent: Int?,
+    val vibrateWhenRinging: Boolean,
+    val light: Boolean,
+    val ringtone: String?,
+    val notificationTone: String?,
+)
+
+object SoundProfiles {
+    const val NORMAL_VOLUME = 70
+    const val FULL_VOLUME = 100
+
+    fun plan(
+        profile: SoundProfile,
+        settings: ProfileSettings = ProfileSettings(),
+    ): ProfilePlan {
+        val base = basePlan(profile)
+        // A silent or vibrating profile has no volume to set; the user's volume applies only where it rings.
+        val volume =
+            settings.volumePercent?.coerceIn(0, FULL_VOLUME)?.takeIf {
+                base.volumePercent !=
+                    null
+            }
+        return base.copy(
+            volumePercent = volume ?: base.volumePercent,
+            vibrateWhenRinging =
+                settings.vibrate?.takeIf { profile != SoundProfile.ALL_ALERTS_OFF }
+                    ?: base.vibrateWhenRinging,
+            light = settings.light ?: base.light,
+            ringtone = settings.ringtone,
+            notificationTone = settings.notificationTone,
+        )
+    }
+
+    /** Profile defaults, independent of user overrides. */
+    private fun basePlan(profile: SoundProfile): ProfilePlan =
+        when (profile) {
+            SoundProfile.NORMAL -> {
+                ProfilePlan(Ringer.NORMAL, Dnd.OFF, NORMAL_VOLUME, true, true, null, null)
+            }
+
+            SoundProfile.LOUD -> {
+                ProfilePlan(Ringer.NORMAL, Dnd.OFF, FULL_VOLUME, true, true, null, null)
+            }
+
+            SoundProfile.VIBRATE_ONLY -> {
+                ProfilePlan(Ringer.VIBRATE, Dnd.OFF, null, true, true, null, null)
+            }
+
+            SoundProfile.PHONE_CALLS_ONLY -> {
+                ProfilePlan(Ringer.NORMAL, Dnd.CALLS_ONLY, NORMAL_VOLUME, true, false, null, null)
+            }
+
+            SoundProfile.ALL_ALERTS_OFF -> {
+                ProfilePlan(Ringer.SILENT, Dnd.ALARMS_ONLY, null, false, false, null, null)
+            }
+        }
+
+    /** The next profile, for a key or tile that steps through them. */
+    fun next(current: SoundProfile?): SoundProfile {
+        val all = SoundProfile.entries
+        return if (current == null) all.first() else all[(current.ordinal + 1) % all.size]
+    }
+
+    /** Reads one profile's stored settings: `key=value` lines (volume, vibrate, light, ringtone, notification). */
+    fun parse(text: String?): ProfileSettings {
+        val map =
+            text
+                .orEmpty()
+                .lineSequence()
+                .mapNotNull { line ->
+                    val eq = line.indexOf('=')
+                    if (eq > 0) line.substring(0, eq) to line.substring(eq + 1) else null
+                }.toMap()
+        return ProfileSettings(
+            volumePercent = map["volume"]?.toIntOrNull()?.coerceIn(0, FULL_VOLUME),
+            vibrate = map["vibrate"]?.toBooleanStrictOrNull(),
+            light = map["light"]?.toBooleanStrictOrNull(),
+            ringtone = map["ringtone"]?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
+            notificationTone = map["notification"]?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
+        )
+    }
+
+    fun format(s: ProfileSettings): String =
+        listOfNotNull(
+            s.volumePercent?.let { "volume=$it" },
+            s.vibrate?.let { "vibrate=$it" },
+            s.light?.let { "light=$it" },
+            s.ringtone?.let { "ringtone=${oneLine(it)}" },
+            s.notificationTone?.let { "notification=${oneLine(it)}" },
+        ).joinToString("\n")
+
+    private fun oneLine(s: String) = s.replace('\n', ' ')
+}

+        root: View,
+        hint: String,
+    ): EditText = descendants(root).filterIsInstance<EditText>().first { it.hint?.toString() == hint }
+
+    fun permission(
+        name: String,
+        granted: Boolean,
+    ) {
+        val application = shadowOf(RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication())
+        if (granted) application.grantPermissions(name) else application.denyPermissions(name)
+    }
+
+    fun provider(authority: String): FixtureProvider =
+        FixtureProvider().also { ShadowContentResolver.registerProviderInternal(authority, it) }
+}
+
+/** Synthetic records only. No provider writes, real contacts, network or device calls. */
+internal class FixtureProvider : ContentProvider() {
+    val records = mutableMapOf<String, List<Map<String, Any>>>()
+    val queries = mutableListOf<Uri>()
+
+    override fun onCreate() = true
+
+    override fun query(
+        uri: Uri,
+        projection: Array<out String>?,
+        selection: String?,
+        selectionArgs: Array<out String>?,
+        sortOrder: String?,
+    ): Cursor {
+        synchronized(queries) { queries.add(uri) }
+        val columns = projection?.toList().orEmpty()
+        val rows =
+            records.entries
+                .firstOrNull { uri.path.orEmpty().startsWith(it.key) }
+                ?.value
+                .orEmpty()
+        return MatrixCursor(columns.toTypedArray()).apply {
+            rows.forEach { row -> addRow(columns.map { row[it] }.toTypedArray()) }
+        }
+    }
+
+    override fun getType(uri: Uri): String? = null
+
+    override fun insert(
+        uri: Uri,
+        values: ContentValues?,
+    ): Uri = error("Unexpected provider write")
+
+    override fun delete(
+        uri: Uri,
+        selection: String?,
+        selectionArgs: Array<out String>?,
+    ): Int = error("Unexpected provider delete")
+
+    override fun update(
+        uri: Uri,
+        values: ContentValues?,
+        selection: String?,
+        selectionArgs: Array<out String>?,
+    ): Int = error("Unexpected provider update")
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.calendar
+
+import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
+import org.junit.Test
+import java.time.LocalDate
+import java.time.ZoneId
+
+class CalendarScheduleContentTest {
+    private val day = LocalDate.parse("2026-11-01")
+    private val zone = ZoneId.of("America/New_York")
+    private val start = day.atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()
+    private val end =
+        day
+            .plusDays(1)
+            .atStartOfDay(zone)
+            .toInstant()
+            .toEpochMilli()
+
+    private fun event(
+        id: Long,
+        from: Long,
+        to: Long,
+    ) = D5R2Event(id, id, "Event", from, to, false)
+
+    @Test
+    fun excludesEventsAtEitherExclusiveBoundary() {
+        val before = event(1L, start - 1L, start)
+        val after = event(2L, end, end + 1L)
+        assertEquals(emptyList<D5R2Event>(), calendarEventsOn(listOf(before, after), day, zone))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun includesOvernightAndDaylightSavingInstancesInStableStartOrder() {
+        val first = event(1L, start - 1L, start + 1L)
+        val second = event(2L, start, end)
+        val sameStart = event(3L, start, end)
+        val last = event(4L, end - 1L, end + 1L)
+        assertEquals(
+            listOf(first, second, sameStart, last),
+            calendarEventsOn(listOf(last, first, second, sameStart), day, zone),
+        )
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun respectsSuppliedVisibilityAndRetainsAllDayInstances() {
+        val visible = D5R2Event(1L, 1L, "All day", start, end, true)
+        val hidden = event(2L, start, end)
+        assertEquals(
+            listOf(visible),
+            calendarEventsOn(listOf(visible, hidden).filter { it.calendarId == 1L }, day, zone),
+        )
+        assertEquals(emptyList<D5R2Event>(), calendarEventsOn(emptyList(), day, zone))
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.calendar
+
+import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
+import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
+import org.junit.Test
+import java.time.LocalDate
+import java.time.ZoneId
+import java.time.ZoneOffset
+
+class D5CalendarEventTest {
+    private fun event(
+        start: Long,
+        end: Long,
+        allDay: Boolean,
+    ) = D5CalendarEvent(
+        id = 1,
+        title = "Test event",
+        startMillis = start,
+        endMillis = end,
+        allDay = allDay,
+        calendarId = 4,
+        calendarName = "Personal",
+    )
+
+    @Test
+    fun allDayUsesUtcDateRatherThanLocalZoneAndExclusiveEnd() {
+        val first = LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 9)
+        val start = first.atStartOfDay(ZoneOffset.UTC).toInstant().toEpochMilli()
+        val end =
+            first
+                .plusDays(1)
+                .atStartOfDay(ZoneOffset.UTC)
+                .toInstant()
+                .toEpochMilli()
+        val item = event(start, end, true)
+        val westCoast = ZoneId.of("America/Los_Angeles")
+        assertTrue(item.overlaps(first, westCoast))
+        assertFalse(item.overlaps(first.minusDays(1), westCoast))
+        assertFalse(item.overlaps(first.plusDays(1), westCoast))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun timedEventsOverlapOnlyDaysTheyActuallyIntersect() {
+        val zone = ZoneId.of("America/New_York")
+        val first = LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 9)
+        val start =
+            first
+                .atTime(23, 45)
+                .atZone(zone)
+                .toInstant()
+                .toEpochMilli()
+        val end =
+            first
+                .plusDays(1)
+                .atTime(0, 15)
+                .atZone(zone)
+                .toInstant()
+                .toEpochMilli()
+        val item = event(start, end, false)
+        assertTrue(item.overlaps(first, zone))
+        assertTrue(item.overlaps(first.plusDays(1), zone))
+        assertFalse(item.overlaps(first.minusDays(1), zone))
+        assertFalse(item.overlaps(first.plusDays(2), zone))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun timedEventEndingExactlyAtMidnightDoesNotOverlapNextDay() {
+        val zone = ZoneId.of("UTC")
+        val day = LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 9)
+        val start =
+            day
+                .atTime(12, 0)
+                .atZone(zone)
+                .toInstant()
+                .toEpochMilli()
+        val end =
+            day
+                .plusDays(1)
+                .atStartOfDay(zone)
+                .toInstant()
+                .toEpochMilli()
+        val item = event(start, end, false)
+        assertTrue(item.overlaps(day, zone))
+        assertFalse(item.overlaps(day.plusDays(1), zone))
+    }
+}
