+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.phone
+
+import android.Manifest
+import android.app.role.RoleManager
+import android.content.pm.PackageManager
+import android.telecom.TelecomManager
+import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
+import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
+import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
+import org.junit.Test
+import org.junit.runner.RunWith
+import org.robolectric.Robolectric
+import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
+import org.robolectric.Shadows.shadowOf
+import org.robolectric.annotation.Config
+import org.robolectric.shadows.ShadowRoleManager
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.AndroidViewFixtures as Views
+
+/** Telecom is Robolectric's in-memory shadow; these tests cannot place device calls. */
+@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
+@Config(sdk = [35])
+class PhonePermissionBehaviorTest {
+    private val callPermissionRequest = 203
+
+    @Test
+    fun queuedCallWaitsForPermissionAndConsumesNumberOnlyOnce() {
+        Views.permission(Manifest.permission.CALL_PHONE, false)
+        Robolectric.buildActivity(TenSevenPhoneActivity::class.java).setup().use { controller ->
+            val activity = controller.get()
+            ShadowRoleManager.addRoleHolder(
+                RoleManager.ROLE_DIALER,
+                activity.packageName,
+                android.os.Process.myUserHandle(),
+            )
+            val telecom = shadowOf(activity.getSystemService(TelecomManager::class.java))
+            activity.placeCall(PhoneFixtureRecords.FIRST_NUMBER)
+            assertTrue(telecom.allOutgoingCalls.isEmpty())
+            assertEquals(callPermissionRequest, shadowOf(activity).lastRequestedPermission.requestCode)
+            activity.onRequestPermissionsResult(
+                callPermissionRequest,
+                arrayOf(Manifest.permission.CALL_PHONE),
+                intArrayOf(PackageManager.PERMISSION_DENIED),
+            )
+            assertTrue(telecom.allOutgoingCalls.isEmpty())
+            Views.permission(Manifest.permission.CALL_PHONE, true)
+            activity.onRequestPermissionsResult(
+                callPermissionRequest,
+                arrayOf(Manifest.permission.CALL_PHONE),
+                intArrayOf(PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED),
+            )
+            assertEquals(1, telecom.allOutgoingCalls.size)
+            activity.onRequestPermissionsResult(
+                callPermissionRequest,
+                arrayOf(Manifest.permission.CALL_PHONE),
+                intArrayOf(PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED),
+            )
+            assertEquals(1, telecom.allOutgoingCalls.size)
+        }
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun nonDefaultPhoneNeverAcquiresRoleOrInitiatesTelecomCall() {
+        Robolectric.buildActivity(TenSevenPhoneActivity::class.java).setup().use { controller ->
+            val activity = controller.get()
+            val roles = activity.getSystemService(RoleManager::class.java)
+            val telecom = shadowOf(activity.getSystemService(TelecomManager::class.java))
+            assertFalse(roles.isRoleHeld(RoleManager.ROLE_DIALER))
+            activity.placeCall(PhoneFixtureRecords.FIRST_NUMBER)
+            assertTrue(telecom.allOutgoingCalls.isEmpty())
+            assertFalse(roles.isRoleHeld(RoleManager.ROLE_DIALER))
+            assertEquals(null, shadowOf(activity).lastRequestedPermission)
+        }
+    }
+}

+            assertEquals(listOf("role", "voicemail"), callbacks)
+            Views.text(root, "Request call-log permission").performClick()
+            assertEquals(
+                listOf(Manifest.permission.READ_CALL_LOG),

+            assertEquals(TenSevenPhoneActivity.Screen.DIAL, activity.screen)

+        PhoneFixtureRecords.calls()

+        Views.permission(Manifest.permission.READ_CALL_LOG, true)
+        Robolectric.buildActivity(TenSevenPhoneActivity::class.java).setup().use { controller ->
+            val activity = controller.get()
+            val root = FrameLayout(activity)

+            PhoneRecentsContent(activity, { selected = it }, {}, {}).recents(root)
+            assertEquals("Alex Fixture", Views.text(root, "Alex Fixture").text.toString())
+            assertEquals("Private number", Views.text(root, "Private number").text.toString())

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.frames
+
+import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
+import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
+import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
+import org.junit.Test
+
+class FramePolicyBoundsTest {
+    @Test fun captureIntervalRetainsInclusiveBoundaryAndPrivacyGuards() {
+        assertFalse(CapturePolicy.accept(false, false, 1199L, 200L))
+        assertTrue(CapturePolicy.accept(false, false, 1200L, 200L))
+        assertTrue(CapturePolicy.accept(false, false, 1201L, 200L))
+        assertFalse(CapturePolicy.accept(true, false, 1200L, 200L))
+        assertFalse(CapturePolicy.accept(false, true, 1200L, 200L))
+        assertFalse(CapturePolicy.accept(false, false, 199L, 200L))
+    }
+
+    @Test fun summaryCapPreservesFilteringFirstDuplicateAndNewestOrdering() {
+        val values = (1..30).map { AppSummary("$it", "Title", "Text", SummarySource.Local, updatedAt = it.toLong()) }
+        val first = values.last().copy(detail = "First duplicate")
+        val blank = AppSummary("blank", "Title", " ", SummarySource.Local)
+        val selected = AppSummaryPolicy.select(listOf(blank, first) + values.reversed(), true)
+        assertEquals(24, selected.size)
+        assertEquals((30 downTo 7).map { "$it" }, selected.map { it.key })
+        assertEquals("First duplicate", selected.first().detail)
+        val external = AppSummary("external", "Title", "Text", SummarySource.Notification)
+        assertEquals(selected, AppSummaryPolicy.select(listOf(external, blank, first) + values.reversed(), false))
+    }
+
+    @Test fun windowCapsPreserveNewestEntriesAndCloseReopenOrdering() {
+        val events = (1..100).map { FrameOpening(FrameApp("app$it", 0), it.toLong()) }
+        val window = FrameWindow().record(events.reversed(), 1L)
+        assertEquals(8, window.active.size)
+        assertEquals(96, window.seen.size)
+        assertEquals((100 downTo 93).map { "0:app$it" }, window.active.keys.toList())
+        assertEquals((100 downTo 5).map { "0:app$it" }, window.seen.keys.toList())
+        val app = FrameApp("app100", 0)
+        val closed = window.close(app, 101L)
+        assertFalse(closed.active.containsKey(app.key))
+        assertEquals(closed, closed.record(listOf(FrameOpening(app, 100L)), 1L))
+        val reopened = closed.record(listOf(FrameOpening(app, 102L)), 1L)
+        assertEquals(app, reopened.openings().first().app)
+        assertEquals(8, reopened.active.size)
+        assertEquals(96, reopened.seen.size)
+    }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model
+
+import android.content.ComponentName
+import android.os.Process
+import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
+import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
+import org.junit.Test
+import org.junit.runner.RunWith
+import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
+import org.robolectric.annotation.Config
+
+@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
+@Config(sdk = [34], manifest = Config.NONE)
+class Bb7RecentAppsTest {
+    private fun app(
+        label: String,
+        packageName: String,
+        profile: String? = null,
+    ): AppEntry {
+        val component = ComponentName(packageName, "$packageName.Main")
+        return AppEntry(label, component, Process.myUserHandle(), profileLabel = profile)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun newestLaunchWinsWithoutAlphabeticalOrFrequencySorting() {
+        val old = app("Alpha", "fixture.old")
+        val new = app("Zulu", "fixture.new")
+        val events = listOf(ForegroundEvent("fixture.old", OLD_TIME), ForegroundEvent("fixture.new", NEW_TIME))
+        val usage = AppUsage.EMPTY.record(old.stableKey()).record(old.stableKey())
+        assertEquals(listOf(new, old), Bb7RecentApps.select(listOf(old, new), events))
+        assertEquals(listOf(old), Bb7Home.panelApps(Bb7Panel.Frequent, listOf(old, new), null, usage))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun repeatedLaunchesAndMultipleActivitiesDoNotDuplicateAnApp() {
+        val first = app("One", "fixture.one")
+        val otherActivity = first.copy(component = ComponentName("fixture.one", "fixture.one.Second"))
+        val events = listOf(ForegroundEvent("fixture.one", OLD_TIME), ForegroundEvent("fixture.one", NEW_TIME))
+        assertEquals(listOf(first), Bb7RecentApps.select(listOf(first, otherActivity), events))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun unavailableAndOtherProfileAppsAreExcluded() {
+        val personal = app("Personal", "fixture.personal")
+        val work = app("Work", "fixture.work", "work")
+        val events =
+            listOf(
+                ForegroundEvent("fixture.gone", NEW_TIME),
+                ForegroundEvent("fixture.work", NEW_TIME),
+                ForegroundEvent("fixture.personal", OLD_TIME),
+            )
+        assertEquals(listOf(personal), Bb7RecentApps.select(listOf(personal, work), events))
+        assertTrue(Bb7RecentApps.select(emptyList(), events).isEmpty())
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun noHistoryNeverFallsBackToAllOrFavorites() {
+        val entry = app("Installed", "fixture.installed")
+        assertTrue(Bb7Home.panelApps(Bb7Panel.Recent, listOf(entry), listOf(entry.stableKey())).isEmpty())
+        assertTrue(Bb7RecentApps.select(listOf(entry), listOf(ForegroundEvent("fixture.installed", 0))).isEmpty())
+    }
+
+    private companion object {
+        const val OLD_TIME = 10L
+        const val NEW_TIME = 20L
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model

+import org.junit.Test
+import java.time.LocalDate
+import java.time.YearMonth
+import java.time.ZoneId
+
+class D5PoliciesTest {
+    @Test fun monthGridMondayFirstAndFullWeeks() {
+        val cells = D5CalendarBusy.monthCells(YearMonth.of(2026, 11))
+        assertEquals(42, cells.size)
+        assertEquals(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 1), cells[6])
+        assertEquals(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 30), cells[35])
+    }
+
+    @Test fun overlapsDoNotDoubleCount() {
+        val z = ZoneId.of("UTC")
+        val d = LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 8)
+        val a =
+            d
+                .atTime(9, 0)
+                .atZone(z)
+                .toInstant()
+                .toEpochMilli()
+        val b =
+            d
+                .atTime(10, 0)
+                .atZone(z)
+                .toInstant()
+                .toEpochMilli()
+        val c =
+            d
+                .atTime(11, 0)
+                .atZone(z)
+                .toInstant()
+                .toEpochMilli()
+        assertEquals(
+            120,
+            D5CalendarBusy.bookedMinutes(
+                d,
+                listOf(
+                    D5TimeSpan(a, b, false),
+                    D5TimeSpan(
+                        a + 30 * 60_000,
+                        c,
+                        false,
+                    ),
+                ),
+                z,
+            ),
+        )
+    }
+
+    @Test fun dialInputIsBounded() {
+        assertEquals("+123", D5PhoneDialPolicy.append("+12", "3"))
+        assertEquals("12", D5PhoneDialPolicy.append("12", "x"))
+        assertEquals("+12", D5PhoneDialPolicy.append("+12", "+"))
+        assertFalse(D5PhoneDialPolicy.canDial("*#"))
+        assertTrue(D5PhoneDialPolicy.canDial("911"))
+        assertEquals(48, D5PhoneDialPolicy.normalize("1".repeat(99)).length)
+    }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model
+
+import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
+import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
+import org.junit.Test
+
+class HubPeekGestureTest {
+    @Test
+    fun inwardEdgeDragOpensAfterSlop() {
+        assertTrue(HubPeekGesture.startsAtEdge(EDGE_START, EDGE_WIDTH))
+        assertTrue(HubPeekGesture.opens(DRAG, 0f, SLOP))
+        assertFalse(HubPeekGesture.opens(SLOP, 0f, SLOP))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun nonEdgeAndOutwardDragsDoNotOpenPeek() {
+        assertFalse(HubPeekGesture.startsAtEdge(-1f, EDGE_WIDTH))
+        assertFalse(HubPeekGesture.startsAtEdge(EDGE_WIDTH + 1f, EDGE_WIDTH))
+        assertFalse(HubPeekGesture.opens(-DRAG, 0f, SLOP))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun verticalScrollingCancelsInsteadOfOpeningPeek() {
+        assertFalse(HubPeekGesture.opens(SLOP, DRAG, SLOP))
+        assertTrue(HubPeekGesture.cancels(SLOP, DRAG, SLOP))
+        assertTrue(HubPeekGesture.cancels(SLOP, -DRAG, SLOP))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun horizontalIntentDoesNotCancelThePagerProtectedDrag() {
+        assertTrue(HubPeekGesture.opens(DRAG, SLOP, SLOP))
+        assertFalse(HubPeekGesture.cancels(DRAG, SLOP, SLOP))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun unmeasuredSlopDoesNotCreateAnAccidentalPeek() {
+        assertFalse(HubPeekGesture.opens(DRAG, 0f, 0f))
+    }
+
+    private companion object {
+        const val EDGE_START = 24f
+        const val EDGE_WIDTH = 32f
+        const val DRAG = 40f
+        const val SLOP = 8f
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model
+
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.live.AppUnreadCount
+import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
+import org.junit.Test
+
+class HubUnreadCountsTest {
+    private val hub = listOf(AppUnreadCount("org.hub", 7))
+
+    @Test
+    fun waitingCountsComeFirstMostFirst() {
+        val picked =
+            HubUnreadCounts.pick(
+                mapOf("b.app" to 2, "a.app" to 2, "c.app" to WAITING, "zero.app" to 0),
+                MAX_APPS,
+            ) { hub }
+        assertEquals(listOf("c.app", "a.app", "b.app"), picked.map { it.packageName })
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun theHubCountsWhenNothingIsWaiting() {
+        assertEquals(hub, HubUnreadCounts.pick(mapOf("zero.app" to 0), MAX_APPS) { hub })
+        assertEquals(hub, HubUnreadCounts.pick(emptyMap(), MAX_APPS) { hub })
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun capsTheNumberOfApps() {
+        val many = (1..MANY_APPS).associate { "app$it" to it }
+        assertEquals(CAP, HubUnreadCounts.pick(many, CAP) { hub }.size)
+    }
+
+    private companion object {
+        const val MAX_APPS = 32
+        const val WAITING = 5
+        const val MANY_APPS = 40
+        const val CAP = 3
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.platform
+
+import android.content.Context
+import android.database.ContentObserver
+import android.net.Uri
+import android.provider.Settings
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.conversations.ConversationHub
+import org.junit.After
+import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
+import org.junit.Before
+import org.junit.Test
+import org.junit.runner.RunWith
+import org.robolectric.Robolectric
+import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
+import org.robolectric.RuntimeEnvironment
+import org.robolectric.annotation.Config
+
+@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
+@Config(sdk = [35])
+class HubCountsObserverTest {
+    private val context: Context get() = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication()
+    private lateinit var provider: HubCountsProvider
+
+    @Before
+    fun setUp() {
+        ConversationHub.clearNow()
+        LockLayerState.update(emptyMap())
+        Settings.Secure.putString(
+            context.contentResolver,
+            "enabled_notification_listeners",
+            context.packageName + "/io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.conversations.ConversationListenerService",
+        )
+        provider = Robolectric.buildContentProvider(HubCountsProvider::class.java).create().get()
+    }
+
+    @After
+    fun tearDown() {
+        provider.shutdown()
+        LockLayerState.update(emptyMap())
+        Settings.Secure.putString(context.contentResolver, "enabled_notification_listeners", "")
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun countChangesNotifyOnceAndQueriesNeverLoop() {
+        val updates = observe()
+        try {
+            LockLayerState.update(mapOf("fixture.app" to 1))
+            assertEquals(1, updates.calls)
+            LockLayerState.update(mapOf("fixture.app" to 1))
+            ConversationHub.clearNow()
+            provider.query(updates.uri, null, null, null, null)?.close()
+            assertEquals(1, updates.calls)
+            LockLayerState.update(mapOf("fixture.app" to 2))
+            assertEquals(2, updates.calls)
+            assertEquals(updates.uri, updates.lastUri)
+        } finally {
+            context.contentResolver.unregisterContentObserver(updates)
+        }
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun lossOfAccessNotifiesReadersToFallBack() {
+        val updates = observe()
+        try {
+            Settings.Secure.putString(context.contentResolver, "enabled_notification_listeners", "")
+            ConversationHub.clearNow()
+            assertEquals(1, updates.calls)
+            ConversationHub.clearNow()
+            assertEquals(1, updates.calls)
+        } finally {
+            context.contentResolver.unregisterContentObserver(updates)
+        }
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun repeatedCreationAndShutdownDoNotRetainDuplicateSubscriptions() {
+        val updates = observe()
+        try {
+            provider.onCreate()
+            LockLayerState.update(mapOf("fixture.app" to 1))
+            assertEquals(1, updates.calls)
+            provider.shutdown()
+            LockLayerState.update(mapOf("fixture.app" to 2))
+            ConversationHub.clearNow()
+            assertEquals(1, updates.calls)
+        } finally {
+            context.contentResolver.unregisterContentObserver(updates)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun observe(): Updates =
+        Updates(HubCountsProvider.appsUri(context.packageName)).also {
+            context.contentResolver.registerContentObserver(it.uri, false, it)
+        }
+
+    private class Updates(
+        val uri: Uri,
+    ) : ContentObserver(null) {
+        var calls = 0
+        var lastUri: Uri? = null
+
+        override fun onChange(
+            selfChange: Boolean,
+            uri: Uri?,
+        ) {
+            calls++
+            lastUri = uri
+        }
+    }
+}

+
+/** Schema/metadata tests do not claim that Robolectric enforces Android signatures across UIDs. */
+@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
+@Config(sdk = [35])
+class HubCountsProviderTest {
+    private val context: Context get() = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication()
+    private lateinit var provider: HubCountsProvider
+    private val uri get() = HubCountsProvider.appsUri(context.packageName)
+
+    @Before
+    fun setUp() {
+        ConversationHub.clearNow()
+        LockLayerState.update(emptyMap())
+        access(true)
+        provider = Robolectric.buildContentProvider(HubCountsProvider::class.java).create().get()
+    }
+
+    @After
+    fun tearDown() {
+        provider.shutdown()
+        ConversationHub.clearNow()
+        LockLayerState.update(emptyMap())
+        access(false)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun deniedNotificationAccessReturnsNoCursorEvenWithWaitingCounts() {
+        LockLayerState.update(mapOf("fixture.app" to COUNT))
+        access(false)
+        assertNull(provider.query(uri, null, null, null, null))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun emptyCountsReturnAnEmptyTwoColumnCursor() {
+        provider.query(uri, null, null, null, null).use { cursor ->
+            assertNotNull(cursor)
+            assertEquals(0, cursor?.count)
+            assertArrayEquals(arrayOf("package", "count"), cursor?.columnNames)
+            assertEquals(uri, cursor?.notificationUri)
+        }
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun providerReturnsCountsInHubOrderAndNeverMessageColumns() {
+        LockLayerState.update(mapOf("b.app" to COUNT, "a.app" to COUNT, "ignored.app" to 0))
+        provider.query(uri, arrayOf("body", "sender", "title"), "body", arrayOf("secret"), "title").use { cursor ->
+            val rows = requireNotNull(cursor)
+            assertArrayEquals(arrayOf("package", "count"), rows.columnNames)
+            assertEquals(2, rows.count)
+            assertEquals(-1, rows.getColumnIndex("body"))
+            assertEquals(-1, rows.getColumnIndex("sender"))
+            assertEquals(-1, rows.getColumnIndex("title"))
+            rows.moveToFirst()
+            assertEquals("a.app", rows.getString(0))
+            assertEquals(COUNT, rows.getInt(1))
+            rows.moveToNext()
+            assertEquals("b.app", rows.getString(0))
+        }
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun wrongAuthorityOrPathCannotBeQueriedDirectly() {
+        val other = HubCountsProvider.appsUri("other.application")
+        assertNull(provider.query(other, null, null, null, null))
+        assertNull(provider.query(uri.buildUpon().appendPath("messages").build(), null, null, null, null))
+        assertNull(provider.query(Uri.parse("https://example.com/apps"), null, null, null, null))
+        assertNull(provider.getType(other))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun writesAreRejectedEvenForTheOwningProcess() {
+        val values = ContentValues()
+        assertThrows(UnsupportedOperationException::class.java) { provider.insert(uri, values) }
+        assertThrows(UnsupportedOperationException::class.java) { provider.update(uri, values, null, null) }
+        assertThrows(UnsupportedOperationException::class.java) { provider.delete(uri, null, null) }
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun productionAndDebugAuthorityDerivationCannotCollide() {
+        assertEquals(
+            "content://io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.hubcounts/apps",
+            HubCountsProvider.appsUri(PRODUCTION).toString(),
+        )
+        assertEquals("content://io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.debug.l0.hubcounts/apps", uri.toString())
+        assertFalse(uri == HubCountsProvider.appsUri(PRODUCTION))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun manifestHasDistinctSignatureReadAndWritePermissions() {
+        val manager = context.packageManager
+        val info = manager.getProviderInfo(ComponentName(context, HubCountsProvider::class.java), 0)
+        assertEquals(context.packageName + ".hubcounts", info.authority)
+        assertEquals(context.packageName + ".permission.READ_HUB_COUNTS", info.readPermission)
+        assertEquals(context.packageName + ".permission.WRITE_HUB_COUNTS", info.writePermission)
+        assertFalse(info.grantUriPermissions)
+        for (permission in listOf(info.readPermission, info.writePermission)) {
+            val declaration = manager.getPermissionInfo(permission, 0)
+            assertEquals(
+                PermissionInfo.PROTECTION_SIGNATURE,
+                declaration.protectionLevel and PermissionInfo.PROTECTION_MASK_BASE,
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun homeBarAndProviderPickTheSameWaitingCounts() =
+        runBlocking {
+            LockLayerState.update(mapOf("b.app" to COUNT, "a.app" to COUNT))
+            val home = LiveSurfaceRepository(context).snapshot().hubApps
+            assertEquals(home, providerRows())
+        }
+
+    @Test
+    fun fallbackCountsStillExposeNoConversationContent() =
+        runBlocking {
+            ConversationHub.replace(
+                listOf(
+                    HubNotification(
+                        key = "n1",
+                        conversationId = "pr143-fixture-conversation",
+                        conversationName = "Private sender",
+                        packageName = "fixture.app",
+                        appName = "Private notification title",
+                        postedAt = System.currentTimeMillis(),
+                        isOngoing = false,
+                        messages =
+                            listOf(
+                                ConversationMessage(
+                                    id = "private-fixture-message",
+                                    conversationId = "pr143-fixture-conversation",
+                                    notificationKey = "n1",
+                                    packageName = "fixture.app",
+                                    appName = "Private notification title",
+                                    text = "Private message body",
+                                    timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis(),
+                                    senderName = "Private sender",
+                                    isOutgoing = false,
+                                ),
+                            ),
+                        contentIntent = null,
+                        replyAction = null,
+                    ),
+                ),
+            )
+            val expected = listOf(AppUnreadCount("fixture.app", 1))
+            assertEquals(expected, providerRows())
+            assertEquals(expected, LiveSurfaceRepository(context).snapshot().hubApps)
+        }
+
+    private fun providerRows(): List<AppUnreadCount> =
+        requireNotNull(provider.query(uri, null, null, null, null)).use { cursor ->
+            buildList {
+                while (cursor.moveToNext()) add(AppUnreadCount(cursor.getString(0), cursor.getInt(1)))
+            }
+        }
+
+    private fun access(granted: Boolean) {
+        val value =
+            if (granted) {
+                context.packageName + "/io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.conversations.ConversationListenerService"
+            } else {
+                ""
+            }
+        Settings.Secure.putString(context.contentResolver, "enabled_notification_listeners", value)
+    }
+
+    private companion object {
+        const val COUNT = 7
+        const val PRODUCTION = "io.github.aimindseye.tenseven"
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.platform
+
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.notes.core.Note
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.notes.core.NoteStore
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.extras.notes.core.NoteText
+import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
+import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
+import org.junit.Rule
+import org.junit.Test
+import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
+
+class LegacyNoteSummariesTest {
+    @get:Rule
+    val folder = TemporaryFolder()
+
+    @Test
+    fun summariesReadExistingNotesWithoutRewritingData() {
+        val note = Note(NoteStore.newId(), "# Existing title\n- [ ] Keep this task\nUnicode café", CREATED, UPDATED)
+        val store = NoteStore(folder.root)
+        store.save(note)
+        val before =
+            folder.root
+                .listFiles()
+                .orEmpty()
+                .associate { it.name to it.readBytes().toList() }
+        val summary = LegacyNoteSummaries.latest(folder.root)
+        assertEquals(NoteText.title(note.body), summary?.title)
+        assertEquals(NoteText.preview(note.body), summary?.preview)
+        assertEquals(UPDATED, summary?.updatedAt)
+        val after =
+            folder.root
+                .listFiles()
+                .orEmpty()
+                .associate { it.name to it.readBytes().toList() }
+        assertEquals(before, after)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun missingOrMalformedDataNeverCreatesOrDeletesFiles() {
+        val missing = folder.root.resolve("missing")
+        assertNull(LegacyNoteSummaries.latest(missing))
+        assertEquals(false, missing.exists())
+        folder.root.resolve("bad.note").writeText("not a note")
+        assertNull(LegacyNoteSummaries.latest(folder.root))
+        assertEquals("not a note", folder.root.resolve("bad.note").readText())
+    }
+
+    private companion object {
+        const val CREATED = 100L
+        const val UPDATED = 200L
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.platform
+
+import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
+import org.junit.Test
+
+class LockLayerChangeTest {
+    @Test
+    fun equalUpdatesAreSilentAndRemovingListenersStopsDelivery() {
+        LockLayerState.update(emptyMap())
+        var calls = 0
+        val listener = {
+            calls++
+            Unit
+        }
+        LockLayerState.addChangeListener(listener)
+        LockLayerState.addChangeListener(listener)
+        try {
+            LockLayerState.update(mapOf("one" to 1))
+            LockLayerState.update(mapOf("one" to 1))
+            assertEquals(1, calls)
+            LockLayerState.removeChangeListener(listener)
+            LockLayerState.update(mapOf("one" to 2))
+            assertEquals(1, calls)
+        } finally {
+            LockLayerState.removeChangeListener(listener)
+            LockLayerState.update(emptyMap())
+        }
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun callerMutationCannotSilentlyChangePublishedCounts() {
+        val input = mutableMapOf("one" to 1)
+        try {
+            LockLayerState.update(input)
+            input["one"] = 2
+            assertEquals(mapOf("one" to 1), LockLayerState.counts)
+            LockLayerState.update(input)
+            assertEquals(mapOf("one" to 2), LockLayerState.counts)
+        } finally {
+            LockLayerState.update(emptyMap())
+        }
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.platform

+import org.junit.Before
+import org.junit.Test
+import org.junit.runner.RunWith
+import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
+import org.robolectric.RuntimeEnvironment
+import org.robolectric.Shadows.shadowOf
+import org.robolectric.annotation.Config
+
+@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
+@Config(sdk = [34], manifest = Config.NONE)
+class SoundProfileControlTest {
+    private val context: Application get() = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication()
+    private val audio get() = context.getSystemService(AudioManager::class.java)
+    private val notifications get() = context.getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java)
+
+    @Before
+    fun isolateAndroidAudioState() {
+        shadowOf(notifications).setNotificationPolicyAccessGranted(false)
+        audio.ringerMode = AudioManager.RINGER_MODE_NORMAL
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun absentCompanionDoesNotLaunchOrChangeSound() {
+        assertFalse(SoundProfileControl.profilesEnabled(context))
+        assertFalse(SoundProfileControl.openProfiles(context))
+        assertNull(shadowOf(context).nextStartedActivity)
+        assertEquals(RingerProfile.Sound, SoundProfileControl.current(context))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun installedCompanionIgnoresObsoleteSelectionWithoutRewritingIt() {
+        registerCompanion()
+        val preferences = context.getSharedPreferences("l0_optional_app_choices", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
+        preferences.edit().putStringSet("selected", emptySet()).commit()
+        val before = preferences.all.toMap()
+        assertTrue(SoundProfileControl.profilesEnabled(context))
+        assertEquals(before, preferences.all)
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun companionLaunchIsExplicitAndDoesNotChangeTheRinger() {
+        registerCompanion()
+        assertTrue(SoundProfileControl.openProfiles(context))
+        val opened = shadowOf(context).nextStartedActivity
+        assertEquals(PROFILES, opened.component?.packageName)
+        assertEquals(RingerProfile.Sound, SoundProfileControl.current(context))
+        assertFalse(SoundProfileControl.canSilence(context))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun withoutDndAccessOnlySoundAndVibrateAreSelected() {
+        assertEquals(RingerProfile.Vibrate, SoundProfileControl.cycle(context))
+        assertEquals(RingerProfile.Sound, SoundProfileControl.cycle(context))
+        assertFalse(SoundProfileControl.canSilence(context))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun grantedDndAccessAllowsSilentAndReturnsToSound() {
+        shadowOf(notifications).setNotificationPolicyAccessGranted(true)
+        assertEquals(RingerProfile.Vibrate, SoundProfileControl.cycle(context))
+        assertEquals(RingerProfile.Silent, SoundProfileControl.cycle(context))
+        assertEquals(RingerProfile.Sound, SoundProfileControl.cycle(context))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun externalRingerChangesAreReadFromAndroid() {
+        audio.ringerMode = AudioManager.RINGER_MODE_VIBRATE
+        assertEquals(RingerProfile.Vibrate, SoundProfileControl.current(context))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun silentAccessOpensUserSettingsWithoutGrantingIt() {
+        SoundProfileControl.openSilentAccess(context)
+        assertEquals(Settings.ACTION_NOTIFICATION_POLICY_ACCESS_SETTINGS, shadowOf(context).nextStartedActivity.action)
+        assertFalse(SoundProfileControl.canSilence(context))
+    }
+
+    private fun registerCompanion() {
+        val info =
+            ResolveInfo().apply {
+                activityInfo =
+                    ActivityInfo().apply {
+                        name = "$PROFILES.MainActivity"
+                        packageName = PROFILES
+                        applicationInfo = ApplicationInfo().apply { packageName = PROFILES }
+                    }
+            }
+        val query = Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN).addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_LAUNCHER).setPackage(PROFILES)
+        shadowOf(context.packageManager).setResolveInfosForIntent(query, listOf(info))
+    }
+
+    private companion object {
+        const val PROFILES = "io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.profiles"
+    }
+}

+    fun renderCalendarSelection(body: LinearLayout) {

+                    arrayOf(Manifest.permission.READ_CALENDAR),
+                    CALENDAR_CALENDAR_SELECTION_REQUEST_221,
+                )
+            }
+            return

+        val scroll = ScrollView(activity).apply { isFillViewport = true }
+        body.addView(scroll, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1f))
+        val list = activity.views.column()
+        scroll.addView(list)
+        val picked = activity.selectedIds().toMutableSet()

+        if (activity.calendars.isEmpty()) {
+            activity.views.label(
+                list,
+                "No calendars available. Check account sync.",
+                CALENDAR_CALENDAR_SELECTION_SP_14_F,
+                color = activity.views.muted,

+        }
+        val manage =

+                list,
+                "Manage synced accounts  ›",
+                CALENDAR_CALENDAR_SELECTION_SP_15_F,
+                color = activity.views.accent,
+            )

+        )
+        val source = activity.calendars.firstOrNull { it.id in activity.selectedIds() }
+        activity.views.label(form, "Calendar: ${source?.name ?: "Choose in Android Calendar"}", CALENDAR_EDITOR_SP_15_F)
+        val (location, notes) = createEventAdditionalFields(form)
+        // The Save handoff is a fixed action, never below a long event form.
+        val controls = activity.views.row()
+        body.addView(controls, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_FORM_ACTION_HEIGHT_DP)))
+        activity.views.button(controls, "Continue to Android Calendar") {
+            val intent =
+                Intent(Intent.ACTION_INSERT)
+                    .setData(CalendarContract.Events.CONTENT_URI)
+                    .putExtra(CalendarContract.Events.TITLE, title.text.toString().trim())
+                    .putExtra(CalendarContract.Events.EVENT_LOCATION, location.text.toString().trim())
+                    .putExtra(CalendarContract.Events.DESCRIPTION, notes.text.toString().trim())
+                    .putExtra(
+                        CalendarContract.EXTRA_EVENT_BEGIN_TIME,
+                        activity.dateMs(activity.selected) + CALENDAR_EDITOR_VALUE_10 * CALENDAR_EDITOR_TIME_3600_000_L,
+                    )
+            source?.let { intent.putExtra(CalendarContract.Events.CALENDAR_ID, it.id) }
+            try {
+                activity.startActivity(intent)
+            } catch (
+                _: Exception,
+            ) {
+                D5BbDialogs.message(
+                    activity,
+                    "Calendar editor",
+                    "No Android Calendar editor is available to save this event",
+                )
+            }
+        }
+        activity.views.label(
+            form,
+            "Android Calendar confirms and saves the event; TenSeven currently has read-only calendar access.",
+            CALENDAR_EDITOR_RATIO_12_F,
+            color = activity.views.muted,
+        )
+    }
+
+    private fun createEventTitleField(form: LinearLayout): EditText {
+        val title =
+            EditText(activity).apply {
+                hint = "Event title"
+                setSingleLine(true)
+                textSize = CALENDAR_EDITOR_SP_17_F
+                setTextColor(activity.views.fg)
+                setHintTextColor(activity.views.muted)
+                setPadding(
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_FORM_AND_LABEL_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_FORM_AND_LABEL_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_FORM_AND_LABEL_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_FORM_AND_LABEL_INSET_DP),
+                )
+            }
+        form.addView(title, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_FORM_SINGLE_LINE_HEIGHT_DP)))
+        return title
+    }
+
+    private fun createEventAdditionalFields(form: LinearLayout): Pair<EditText, EditText> {
+        val location =
+            EditText(activity).apply {
+                hint = "Location"
+                setSingleLine(true)
+                setTextColor(activity.views.fg)
+                setHintTextColor(activity.views.muted)
+                setPadding(
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_FORM_AND_LABEL_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_FORM_AND_LABEL_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_FORM_AND_LABEL_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_FORM_AND_LABEL_INSET_DP),
+                )
+            }
+        form.addView(location, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_FORM_SINGLE_LINE_HEIGHT_DP)))
+        val notes =
+            EditText(activity).apply {
+                hint = "Notes (optional)"
+                setTextColor(activity.views.fg)
+                setHintTextColor(activity.views.muted)
+                minLines = 2
+                maxLines = CALENDAR_EDITOR_VALUE_3
+                setPadding(
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_FORM_AND_LABEL_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_FORM_AND_LABEL_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_FORM_AND_LABEL_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_FORM_AND_LABEL_INSET_DP),
+                )
+            }
+        form.addView(notes, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_FORM_NOTES_HEIGHT_DP)))
+        return location to notes
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.calendar
+
+import android.app.Activity
+import android.graphics.Color
+import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
+import android.view.Gravity
+import android.view.View

+import android.widget.ScrollView

+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.D5BbDialogs
+import java.time.Instant
+import java.time.LocalDate
+import java.time.ZoneId
+import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
+import java.util.Locale
+
+/** Activity-bound CalendarScheduleContent renderer; lifecycle and mutable state remain with the activity. */
+internal class CalendarScheduleContent(
+    private val activity: TenSevenCalendarActivity,
+    private val actions: CalendarContentActions,
+) {
+    private fun weekBar(body: LinearLayout) {
+        val start = activity.weekStart()
+        val week =
+            activity.views.row().apply {
+                setPadding(
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_HAIRLINE_DP),
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_MICRO_GUTTER_DP),
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_HAIRLINE_DP),
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_MICRO_GUTTER_DP),
+                )
+            }
+        body.addView(week, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.dp(activity.views.fit().weekStripDp)))
+        repeat(CALENDAR_WEEK_BAR_COUNT_7) { i ->
+            val day = start.plusDays(i.toLong())
+            renderWeekDayTile(week, day, i)
+        }
+        activity.views.divider(body)
+    }
+
+    private fun renderWeekDayTile(
+        week: LinearLayout,
+        day: LocalDate,
+        i: Int,
+    ) {
+        val active = day == activity.selected
+        val tile =
+            LinearLayout(activity).apply {
+                orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
+                gravity = Gravity.CENTER
+                background =
+                    if (active) {
+                        GradientDrawable().apply {
+                            cornerRadius = activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_WEEK_PILL_RADIUS_DP).toFloat()
+                            setColor(activity.views.accent)
+                        }
+                    } else {
+                        null
+                    }
+                isFocusable = true
+                contentDescription = "Select ${day.dayOfWeek} ${day.dayOfMonth}"
+                setOnClickListener { actions.setDay(day) }
+            }
+        val letters = listOf("S", "M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S")
+        val position = if (activity.mondayStart()) (i + 1) % CALENDAR_WEEK_BAR_VALUE_7 else i
+        tile.addView(
+            TextView(activity).apply {
+                text = letters[position]
+                textSize = CALENDAR_WEEK_BAR_SP_10_F
+                setTextColor(if (active) Color.WHITE else activity.views.muted)
+                gravity = Gravity.CENTER
+            },
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1f),
+        )
+        tile.addView(
+            TextView(activity).apply {
+                text = String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%d", day.dayOfMonth)
+                textSize = CALENDAR_WEEK_BAR_SP_15_F
+                setTextColor(activity.views.fg)
+                gravity = Gravity.CENTER
+            },
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 2f),
+        )
+        renderWeekActivityDots(tile, day)
+        week.addView(tile, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -1, 1f))
+    }
+
+    private fun renderWeekActivityDots(
+        tile: LinearLayout,
+        day: LocalDate,
+    ) {
+        val colors =
+            activity
+                .eventsOn(day)
+                .mapNotNull { event ->
+                    activity.calendars.firstOrNull { it.id == event.calendarId }?.color
+                }.distinct()
+                .take(CALENDAR_WEEK_BAR_MAX_3)
+        val dots = activity.views.row().apply { gravity = Gravity.CENTER }
+        colors.forEach { color ->
+            dots.addView(
+                View(activity).apply {
+                    background =
+                        GradientDrawable().apply {
+                            shape = GradientDrawable.OVAL
+                            setColor(color)
+                        }
+                },
+                LinearLayout
+                    .LayoutParams(
+                        activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_SMALL_GUTTER_DP),
+                        activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_SMALL_GUTTER_DP),
+                    ).apply {
+                        setMargins(
+                            activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_HAIRLINE_DP),
+                            0,
+                            activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_HAIRLINE_DP),
+                            0,
+                        )
+                    },
+            )
+        }
+        tile.addView(dots, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_LABEL_VERTICAL_INSET_DP)))
+    }
+
+    private fun agendaContainer(body: LinearLayout) {
+        val scroll = ScrollView(activity).apply { isFillViewport = true }
+        body.addView(scroll, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1f))
+        val agenda = activity.views.column()
+        scroll.addView(agenda)
+        renderAgenda(agenda)
+    }
+
+    fun renderTodayPage(body: LinearLayout) {
+        weekBar(body)
+        agendaContainer(body)
+    }
+
+    fun renderMonthPage(body: LinearLayout) {
+        val weeks =
+            (
+                (
+                    if (activity.mondayStart()) {
+                        activity.month
+                            .atDay(1)
+                            .dayOfWeek.value - 1
+                    } else {
+                        activity.month
+                            .atDay(1)
+                            .dayOfWeek.value % CALENDAR_MONTH_DATE_7
+                    }
+                ) + activity.month.lengthOfMonth() + CALENDAR_MONTH_DATE_6
+            ) / CALENDAR_MONTH_VALUE_7
+        val height = CALENDAR_MONTH_VALUE_27 + activity.views.fit().monthCellDp * weeks
+        val grid =
+            BusyMonthView(
+                activity,
+                MonthRenderModel(
+                    month = activity.month,
+                    selected = activity.selected,
+                    paint =
+                        CalendarEventPaint(
+                            activity.visibleEvents(),
+                            activity.calendars.associate {
+                                it.id to
+                                    it.color
+                            },
+                            activity.zone,
+                        ),
+                    mondayStart = activity.mondayStart(),
+                    onSelected = { actions.setDay(it) },
+                    onMonthSwipe = { direction -> actions.moveDate(direction) },
+                ),
+            )
+        body.addView(grid, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.dp(height)))
+        activity.views.divider(body)
+        // Compact week selector is kept small enough for today's events below the month.
+        if (!activity.views.fit().compact) weekBar(body)
+        agendaContainer(body)
+    }
+
+    fun renderWeekPage(body: LinearLayout) {
+        weekBar(body)
+        val scroll = ScrollView(activity).apply { isFillViewport = true }
+        body.addView(scroll, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1f))
+        val list = activity.views.column()
+        scroll.addView(list)
+        val start = activity.weekStart()
+        repeat(CALENDAR_WEEK_COUNT_7) { i ->
+            val day = start.plusDays(i.toLong())
+            val daily = activity.eventsOn(day)
+            val heading =
+                activity.views.label(
+                    list,
+                    "${day.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("EEE, MMM d"))}   ·   ${daily.size} events",
+                    CALENDAR_WEEK_RATIO_15_F,
+                    day == activity.selected,
+                    if (day == activity.selected) activity.views.accent else activity.views.fg,
+                )
+            heading.setOnClickListener { actions.setDay(day) }
+            daily.take(CALENDAR_WEEK_MAX_5).forEach { event -> renderEventRow(list, event) }
+            activity.views.divider(list)
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun renderDayPage(body: LinearLayout) {
+        weekBar(body)
+        val allDay = activity.eventsOn(activity.selected).filter { it.allDay }
+        if (allDay.isNotEmpty()) {
+            activity.views.label(
+                body,
+                "ALL DAY  ${allDay.take(2).joinToString(" · ") { it.title }}",
+                CALENDAR_DAY_SP_12_F,
+                color = activity.views.muted,
+            )
+        }
+        val timelineScroll = ScrollView(activity)
+        body.addView(timelineScroll, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1f))
+        val eventList = activity.eventsOn(activity.selected).filterNot { it.allDay }
+        timelineScroll.addView(
+            D5DayTimelineView(
+                activity,
+                DayRenderModel(
+                    day = activity.selected,
+                    paint =
+                        CalendarEventPaint(
+                            eventList,
+                            activity.calendars.associate { it.id to it.color },
+                            activity.zone,
+                        ),
+                    onEvent = { event ->
+                        showEvent(
+                            event,
+                            "Schedule",

+                                .firstOrNull { it.id == event.calendarId }

+
+    private fun scrollToDayHour(
+        timelineScroll: ScrollView,
+        eventList: List<D5R2Event>,
+    ) {
+        val hour =
+            if (activity.selected == LocalDate.now(activity.zone)) {
+                java.time.LocalTime
+                    .now(activity.zone)
+                    .hour
+            } else {
+                eventList.minOfOrNull { Instant.ofEpochMilli(it.start).atZone(activity.zone).hour }
+                    ?: CALENDAR_DAY_VALUE_8
+            }
+        timelineScroll.post {
+            timelineScroll.scrollTo(
+                0,
+                activity.views.dp(
+                    (hour - 1).coerceIn(
+                        0,
+                        CALENDAR_DAY_DP_22,
+                    ) * CALENDAR_DAY_DP_50,
+                ),
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun renderEventRow(
+        body: LinearLayout,
+        event: D5R2Event,
+    ) {
+        val source = activity.calendars.firstOrNull { it.id == event.calendarId }
+        val whenText =
+            if (event.allDay) {
+                "All day"
+            } else {
+                Instant
+                    .ofEpochMilli(event.start)
+                    .atZone(activity.zone)
+                    .format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("h:mm a"))
+            }
+        val r =
+            activity.views.row().apply {
+                setPadding(
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_COMPACT_GUTTER_DP),
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_SMALL_GUTTER_DP),
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_COMPACT_GUTTER_DP),
+                    activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_SMALL_GUTTER_DP),
+                )
+            }
+        body.addView(
+            r,
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
+                -CALENDAR_EVENT_ROW_DP_1,
+                activity.views.dp(
+                    if (activity.views.fit().compact) CALENDAR_EVENT_ROW_DP_43 else CALENDAR_EVENT_ROW_DP_51,
+                ),
+            ),
+        )
+        r.addView(
+            View(activity).apply { setBackgroundColor(source?.color ?: activity.views.accent) },
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_SMALL_GUTTER_DP), -1),
+        )
+        val titles = activity.views.column()
+        r.addView(titles, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -1, 1f))
+        activity.views
+            .label(
+                titles,
+                "$whenText   ${event.title}",
+                CALENDAR_EVENT_ROW_SP_14_F,
+                true,
+            ).setPadding(activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_LIST_ITEM_GUTTER_DP), 0, 0, 0)
+        if (!activity.views.fit().compact) {
+            activity.views
+                .label(titles, source?.name.orEmpty(), CALENDAR_EVENT_ROW_SP_11_F, color = activity.views.muted)
+                .setPadding(activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_LIST_ITEM_GUTTER_DP), 0, 0, 0)
+        }
+        r.addView(
+            TextView(activity).apply {
+                text = "›"
+                textSize = CALENDAR_EVENT_ROW_SP_23_F
+                setTextColor(activity.views.muted)
+                gravity = Gravity.CENTER
+            },
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(activity.views.dp(CALENDAR_EVENT_DISCLOSURE_WIDTH_DP), -1),
+        )
+        r.setOnClickListener { showEvent(event, whenText, source?.name.orEmpty()) }
+        activity.views.divider(body)
+    }
+
+    private fun renderAgenda(body: LinearLayout) {
+        activity.views.label(
+            body,
+            activity.selected.format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("EEEE, MMMM d", Locale.getDefault())),
+            CALENDAR_AGENDA_SP_15_F,
+            true,
+        )
+        val items = activity.eventsOn(activity.selected)
+        if (items.isEmpty()) {
+            activity.views.label(
+                body,
+                "No events today in the selected calendars",
+                CALENDAR_AGENDA_SP_13_F,
+                color = activity.views.muted,
+            )
+        }
+        items.forEach { renderEventRow(body, it) }
+    }
+
+    private fun showEvent(
+        event: D5R2Event,
+        time: String,
+        source: String,
+    ) {
+        D5BbDialogs.message(activity, event.title, "$time\nCalendar: $source")
+    }
+}
+
+/** Preserves the provider instance overlap rule and stable start ordering used by every schedule view. */
+internal fun calendarEventsOn(
+    visibleEvents: List<D5R2Event>,
+    day: LocalDate,
+    zone: ZoneId,
+): List<D5R2Event> {
+    val start = day.atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()
+    val end =
+        day
+            .plusDays(1)
+            .atStartOfDay(zone)
+            .toInstant()
+            .toEpochMilli()
+    return visibleEvents.filter { it.start < end && it.end > start }.sortedBy { it.start }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.calendar
+
+import android.Manifest
+import android.app.Activity

+
+/** Shared Calendar view primitives; retains the approved Activity context and geometry. */
+internal class CalendarViews(
+    private val activity: TenSevenCalendarActivity,
+) {
+    val bg get() = Color.rgb(3, 5, 8)
+    val fg get() = Color.rgb(243, 247, 250)
+    val muted get() = Color.rgb(160, 173, 186)
+    val accent get() = Color.rgb(0, 151, 235)
+    private val panel get() = Color.rgb(18, 22, 29)
+    private val border get() = Color.rgb(49, 56, 64)
+
+    fun permission() =
+        activity.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.READ_CALENDAR) ==
+            PackageManager
+                .PERMISSION_GRANTED
+
+    fun dp(n: Int) = (n * activity.resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
+
+    fun column() =
+        LinearLayout(activity).apply {
+            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
+            setBackgroundColor(bg)
+        }
+
+    fun row() =
+        LinearLayout(activity).apply {
+            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
+            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
+        }
+
+    fun label(
+        parent: LinearLayout,
+        value: String,
+        size: Float = 16f,
+        bold: Boolean = false,
+        color: Int = fg,
+    ): TextView {
+        val text =
+            TextView(activity).apply {
+                this.text = value
+                textSize = size
+                setTextColor(color)
+                if (bold) setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD)
+                setPadding(
+                    dp(CALENDAR_FORM_AND_LABEL_INSET_DP),
+                    dp(CALENDAR_LABEL_VERTICAL_INSET_DP),
+                    dp(CALENDAR_LABEL_END_INSET_DP),
+                    dp(CALENDAR_LABEL_VERTICAL_INSET_DP),
+                )
+            }
+        parent.addView(text)
+        return text
+    }
+
+    fun pill(
+        value: String,
+        active: Boolean = false,
+        size: Float = 14f,
+        onClick: () -> Unit,
+    ): TextView =
+        TextView(activity).apply {
+            text = value
+            textSize = size
+            setTextColor(if (active) Color.WHITE else fg)
+            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
+            setTypeface(null, if (active) Typeface.BOLD else Typeface.NORMAL)
+            background =
+                GradientDrawable().apply {
+                    cornerRadius = dp(CALENDAR_PILL_RADIUS_DP).toFloat()
+                    setColor(if (active) accent else panel)
+                    setStroke(dp(CALENDAR_HAIRLINE_DP), if (active) accent else border)
+                }
+            setOnClickListener { onClick() }
+            isClickable = true
+            isFocusable = true
+        }
+
+    fun button(
+        parent: LinearLayout,
+        name: String,
+        action: () -> Unit,
+    ) {
+        val view = pill(name, onClick = action)
+        parent.addView(
+            view,
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, dp(CALENDAR_CONTROL_HEIGHT_DP), 1f).apply {
+                setMargins(
+                    dp(CALENDAR_CONTROL_GAP_DP),
+                    dp(CALENDAR_CONTROL_GAP_DP),
+                    dp(CALENDAR_CONTROL_GAP_DP),
+                    dp(CALENDAR_CONTROL_GAP_DP),
+                )
+            },
+        )
+    }
+
+    fun divider(parent: LinearLayout) {
+        parent.addView(
+            View(activity).apply { setBackgroundColor(border) },
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
+                -1,
+                dp(CALENDAR_HAIRLINE_DP),
+            ),
+        )
+    }
+
+    fun fit() = TenSevenSafeViewport.fit(activity)
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.calendar
+
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model.D5TimeSpan
+import java.time.Instant
+import java.time.LocalDate
+import java.time.ZoneId
+import java.time.ZoneOffset
+
+data class D5CalendarSource(
+    val id: Long,
+    val name: String,
+    val account: String,
+)
+
+data class D5CalendarEvent(
+    val id: Long,
+    val title: String,
+    val startMillis: Long,
+    val endMillis: Long,
+    val allDay: Boolean,
+    val calendarId: Long,
+    val calendarName: String,
+) {
+    fun timeSpan() = D5TimeSpan(startMillis, endMillis, allDay)
+
+    fun overlaps(
+        day: LocalDate,
+        zone: ZoneId,
+    ): Boolean {
+        // Android's all-day instances use UTC date boundaries, not local wall-clock midnight.
+        if (allDay) {
+            val first = Instant.ofEpochMilli(startMillis).atZone(ZoneOffset.UTC).toLocalDate()
+            val end = Instant.ofEpochMilli(endMillis).atZone(ZoneOffset.UTC).toLocalDate()
+            return !day.isBefore(first) && day.isBefore(end)
+        }
+        val from = day.atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()
+        val to =
+            day
+                .plusDays(1)
+                .atStartOfDay(zone)
+                .toInstant()
+                .toEpochMilli()
+        return startMillis < to && endMillis > from
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.calendar
+
+import android.Manifest
+import android.content.ContentUris
+import android.content.Context
+import android.content.pm.PackageManager
+import android.database.Cursor
+import android.provider.CalendarContract
+import java.time.YearMonth
+import java.time.ZoneId
+
+/** Named presentation/protocol values; numeric values unchanged from the reviewed source. */
+private const val CALENDAR_REPO_EVENTS_COL_3 = 3
+private const val CALENDAR_REPO_EVENTS_COL_4 = 4
+private const val CALENDAR_REPO_EVENTS_COL_5 = 5
+private const val CALENDAR_REPO_EVENTS_MAX_1500 = 1500
+private const val CALENDAR_REPO_EVENTS_VALUE_6 = 6
+
+/** Android CalendarProvider: account-agnostic, no syncing, no copy of user events to disk. */
+class D5CalendarRepository(
+    private val context: Context,
+) {
+    fun permitted() =
+        context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.READ_CALENDAR) ==
+            PackageManager
+                .PERMISSION_GRANTED
+
+    fun sources(): List<D5CalendarSource> {
+        if (!permitted()) return emptyList()
+        return runCatching {
+            val results = mutableListOf<D5CalendarSource>()
+            context.contentResolver
+                .query(
+                    CalendarContract.Calendars.CONTENT_URI,
+                    arrayOf(
+                        CalendarContract.Calendars._ID,
+                        CalendarContract.Calendars.CALENDAR_DISPLAY_NAME,
+                        CalendarContract.Calendars.ACCOUNT_NAME,
+                    ),
+                    "${CalendarContract.Calendars.VISIBLE}=1",
+                    null,
+                    CalendarContract.Calendars.CALENDAR_DISPLAY_NAME + " ASC",
+                )?.use { c ->
+                    while (c.moveToNext()) {
+                        results +=
+                            D5CalendarSource(
+                                c.getLong(0),
+                                c.getString(1).orEmpty().ifBlank { "Calendar" },
+                                c.getString(2).orEmpty(),
+                            )
+                    }
+                }
+            results
+        }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
+    }
+
+    private fun visibleEvent(
+        cursor: Cursor,
+        selected: Set<Long>?,
+        visibleSources: Set<Long>,
+    ): D5CalendarEvent? {
+        val calendarId = cursor.getLong(CALENDAR_REPO_EVENTS_COL_5)
+        val visible = calendarId in visibleSources && (selected == null || calendarId in selected)
+        val start = cursor.getLong(2)
+        val end = cursor.getLong(CALENDAR_REPO_EVENTS_COL_3)
+        return if (visible && end > start) {
+            D5CalendarEvent(
+                cursor.getLong(0),
+                cursor.getString(1).orEmpty().ifBlank { "Untitled event" },
+                start,
+                end,
+                cursor.getInt(CALENDAR_REPO_EVENTS_COL_4) != 0,
+                calendarId,
+                cursor.getString(CALENDAR_REPO_EVENTS_VALUE_6).orEmpty().ifBlank { "Calendar" },
+            )
+        } else {
+            null
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun events(
+        month: YearMonth,
+        selected: Set<Long>?,
+        visibleSources: Set<Long>,
+    ): List<D5CalendarEvent> {
+        if (!permitted() || visibleSources.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
+        val z = ZoneId.systemDefault()
+        val from =
+            month
+                .atDay(1)
+                .atStartOfDay(z)
+                .toInstant()
+                .toEpochMilli()
+        val to =
+            month
+                .plusMonths(1)
+                .atDay(1)
+                .atStartOfDay(z)
+                .toInstant()
+                .toEpochMilli()
+        val builder = CalendarContract.Instances.CONTENT_URI.buildUpon()
+        ContentUris.appendId(builder, from)
+        ContentUris.appendId(builder, to)
+        return runCatching {
+            val events = mutableListOf<D5CalendarEvent>()
+            context.contentResolver
+                .query(
+                    builder.build(),
+                    arrayOf(
+                        CalendarContract.Instances.EVENT_ID,
+                        CalendarContract.Instances.TITLE,
+                        CalendarContract.Instances.BEGIN,
+                        CalendarContract.Instances.END,
+                        CalendarContract.Instances.ALL_DAY,
+                        CalendarContract.Instances.CALENDAR_ID,
+                        CalendarContract.Instances.CALENDAR_DISPLAY_NAME,
+                    ),
+                    null,
+                    null,
+                    CalendarContract.Instances.BEGIN + " ASC",
+                )?.use { c ->
+                    while (c.moveToNext() && events.size < CALENDAR_REPO_EVENTS_MAX_1500) {
+                        visibleEvent(c, selected, visibleSources)?.let(events::add)
+                    }
+                }
+            events
+        }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.calendar
+
+import java.time.LocalDate
+import java.time.YearMonth
+
+/** Today always means the device-local current date, never the previously selected day. */
+internal object D6TodayNavigationPolicy {
+    data class Target(
+        val day: LocalDate,
+        val month: YearMonth,
+        val reloadEvents: Boolean,
+    )
+
+    fun reset(
+        now: LocalDate,
+        previouslyDisplayedMonth: YearMonth,
+    ): Target =
+        Target(
+            day = now,
+            month = YearMonth.from(now),
+            reloadEvents = previouslyDisplayedMonth != YearMonth.from(now),
+        )
+}

+
+    internal fun mondayStart() =

+            .getBoolean("monday_start", false)
+
+    internal fun weekStart(day: LocalDate = selected): LocalDate =
+        day.minusDays(
+            if (mondayStart()) {
+                (day.dayOfWeek.value - 1).toLong()
+            } else {
+                (day.dayOfWeek.value % CALENDAR_DAYS_PER_WEEK).toLong()
+            },

+    internal fun selectedIds(): Set<Long> {

+        val saved = prefs.getStringSet("selected_ids", null)
+        return if (saved == null) calendars.map { it.id }.toSet() else saved.mapNotNull { it.toLongOrNull() }.toSet()

+        }

+    private fun load() {
+        val generation = ++loadGeneration
+        if (!views.permission()) {
+            calendars = emptyList()
+            events = emptyList()
+            loading = false
+            return
+        }
+        val targetMonth = month
+        loading = true
+        // CalendarContract.Instances.query expands recurrence and can block; never run it on the UI thread.
+        Thread {
+            val found = queryCalendarSources()
+            val loaded = queryCalendarEvents(targetMonth)
+            runOnUiThread {
+                if (isFinishing || isDestroyed || generation != loadGeneration) return@runOnUiThread
+                calendars = found
+                events = loaded
+                loading = false
+                render()
+            }
+        }.start()

+    private fun queryCalendarSources(): List<D5R2Calendar> {

+    private fun queryCalendarEvents(targetMonth: YearMonth): List<D5R2Event> {

+        val to = targetMonth.atEndOfMonth().plusWeeks(2)
+        val loaded = mutableListOf<D5R2Event>()
+        try {
+            val columns =
+                arrayOf(
+                    CalendarContract.Instances.EVENT_ID,
+                    CalendarContract.Instances.CALENDAR_ID,
+                    CalendarContract.Instances.TITLE,
+                    CalendarContract.Instances.BEGIN,
+                    CalendarContract.Instances.END,
+                    CalendarContract.Instances.ALL_DAY,
+                )
+            CalendarContract.Instances
+                .query(

+                    columns,
+                    dateMs(from),
+                    dateMs(
+                        to
+                            .plusDays(1),
+                    ),

+                    while (cursor.moveToNext() && loaded.size < CALENDAR_LOAD_MAX_3000) {

+        } catch (_: Exception) {

+            selected = nextMonth.atDay(selected.dayOfMonth.coerceAtMost(nextMonth.lengthOfMonth()))
+        } else {
+            selected =
+                selected.plusDays(
+                    if (mode == "Week") CALENDAR_MOVE_DATE_TIME_7_L * direction else direction.toLong(),

+            val target = D6TodayNavigationPolicy.reset(LocalDate.now(zone), month)

+            month = target.month
+            mode = "Today"
+            if (target.reloadEvents) load()
+            render()
+            return
+        }
+        if (mode in listOf("Today", "Week", "Month", "Day") &&
+            next in listOf("Calendars", "Settings", "New")
+        ) {
+            previousMode = mode
+        }
+        mode = next

+        mode = "New"

+    }

+    private fun datePicker() {

+            DatePickerDialog(

+                { _, year, monthIndex, date -> setDay(LocalDate.of(year, monthIndex + 1, date)) },

+
+    private fun settingsMenu() {
+        D5BbDialogs.choices(
+            this,
+            "Calendar",
+            listOf("Today", "Month", "Week", "Day", "Calendars", "Calendar settings", "Hub"),
+        ) { index ->
+            when (index) {
+                0 -> selectMode("Today")
+                1 -> selectMode("Month")
+                2 -> selectMode("Week")
+                CALENDAR_SETTINGS_MENU_VALUE_3 -> selectMode("Day")
+                CALENDAR_SETTINGS_MENU_VALUE_4 -> selectMode("Calendars")
+                CALENDAR_SETTINGS_MENU_VALUE_5 -> selectMode("Settings")
+                CALENDAR_SETTINGS_MENU_VALUE_6 -> openHub()
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun openHub() {
+        try {
+            val action = "org.sableos.start.action.SHOW_HUB"
+            val target =
+                listOf("io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.debug.l0", "io.github.aimindseye.tenseven")
+                    .map { Intent(action).setPackage(it) }
+                    .firstOrNull { it.resolveActivity(packageManager) != null }
+            if (target == null) {
+                D5BbDialogs.message(this, "Hub", "Install TenSeven Launcher to open Hub")

+/** Calendar rendering geometry is intentionally fixed to the approved BB10 design. */
+private object CalendarDrawingSpecs {
+    const val DAYS_PER_WEEK = 7
+    const val LAST_DAY_INDEX = DAYS_PER_WEEK - 1
+    const val CELL_CENTER = 0.5f
+    const val HEADER_BASELINE = 0.7f
+    const val MONTH_HEADER_DP = 32f
+    const val WEEKDAY_TEXT_SP = 12f
+    const val MONTH_DAY_TEXT_SP = 14f
+    const val MONTH_RING_WIDTH = 0.36f
+    const val MONTH_RING_HEIGHT = 0.38f
+    const val MONTH_RING_STROKE_DP = 1.1f
+    const val SELECTED_DAY_RADIUS = 0.8f
+    const val DAY_NUMBER_BASELINE_DP = 5f
+    const val ARC_EVENT_LIMIT = 24
+    const val ARC_FULL_DEGREES = 360f
+    const val ARC_START_DEGREES = -90f
+    const val ARC_MIN_DEGREES = 3f
+    const val ARC_LAYER_COUNT = 3
+    const val ARC_STROKE_DP = 2.7f
+    const val MONTH_SWIPE_DP = 65f
+    const val TIMELINE_HOURS = 24
+    const val TIMELINE_HOUR_MINUTES = 60f
+    const val TIMELINE_GUTTER_DP = 54f
+    const val TIMELINE_EVENT_LIMIT = 100
+    const val TIMELINE_MAX_LANES = 3
+}

+/** Occupied-time arcs, one color per calendar, a real month grid with stable hit testing. */
+internal class BusyMonthView private constructor(
+    context: Context,
+    attrs: AttributeSet?,
+    private val model: MonthRenderModel,
+) : View(context, attrs) {
+    private val month get() = model.month
+    private val selected get() = model.selected
+    private val events get() = model.paint.events
+    private val colors get() = model.paint.colors
+    private val zone get() = model.paint.zone
+    private val mondayStart get() = model.mondayStart
+    private val onSelected get() = model.onSelected
+    private val onMonthSwipe get() = model.onMonthSwipe
+
+    // Android Layout Editor and inflation: no Activity cast and no external data access.
+    @JvmOverloads
+    constructor(context: Context, attrs: AttributeSet? = null) : this(
+        context,
+        attrs,
+        MonthRenderModel(
+            YearMonth.now(),
+            LocalDate.now(),
+            CalendarEventPaint(emptyList(), emptyMap(), ZoneId.systemDefault()),
+            false,
+            {},
+            {},
+        ),
+    )
+
+    // Runtime uses the same immutable render state and callbacks as before.
+    constructor(activity: TenSevenCalendarActivity, model: MonthRenderModel) : this(activity, null, model)
+
+    private val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG)
+    private val density = resources.displayMetrics.density
+    private val fg = Color.rgb(245, 248, 250)
+    private val selectedColor = Color.rgb(0, 150, 232)
+    private val outline = Color.rgb(67, 77, 88)
+    private val offset =
+        if (mondayStart) {
+            month.atDay(1).dayOfWeek.value - 1
+        } else {
+            month.atDay(1).dayOfWeek.value %
+                CalendarDrawingSpecs.DAYS_PER_WEEK
+        }
+    private val start = month.atDay(1).minusDays(offset.toLong())
+    private val rows =
+        (offset + month.lengthOfMonth() + CalendarDrawingSpecs.LAST_DAY_INDEX) /
+            CalendarDrawingSpecs
+                .DAYS_PER_WEEK
+    private var touchX = 0f
+    private val arcBounds = RectF()
+
+    override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
+        super.onDraw(canvas)
+        val cellWidth = width.toFloat() / CalendarDrawingSpecs.DAYS_PER_WEEK
+        val titleHeight = CalendarDrawingSpecs.MONTH_HEADER_DP * density
+        val cellHeight = (height.toFloat() - titleHeight) / rows
+        paint.textAlign = Paint.Align.CENTER
+        paint.typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD
+        paint.style = Paint.Style.FILL
+        paint.textSize = CalendarDrawingSpecs.WEEKDAY_TEXT_SP * density
+        paint.color = fg
+        (
+            if (mondayStart) {
+                listOf("M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S", "S")
+            } else {
+                listOf("S", "M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S")
+            }
+        ).forEachIndexed { i, label ->
+            canvas.drawText(
+                label,
+                cellWidth * (i + CalendarDrawingSpecs.CELL_CENTER),
+                titleHeight * CalendarDrawingSpecs.HEADER_BASELINE,
+                paint,
+            )
+        }
+        for (index in 0 until rows * CalendarDrawingSpecs.DAYS_PER_WEEK) {
+            drawMonthCell(canvas, index, cellWidth, titleHeight, cellHeight)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun drawMonthCell(
+        canvas: Canvas,
+        index: Int,
+        cellWidth: Float,
+        titleHeight: Float,
+        cellHeight: Float,
+    ) {
+        val day = start.plusDays(index.toLong())
+        if (day.month != month.month) return
+        val x = cellWidth * (index % CalendarDrawingSpecs.DAYS_PER_WEEK + CalendarDrawingSpecs.CELL_CENTER)
+        val y =
+            titleHeight + cellHeight *
+                (index / CalendarDrawingSpecs.DAYS_PER_WEEK + CalendarDrawingSpecs.CELL_CENTER)
+        val radius =
+            minOf(
+                cellWidth * CalendarDrawingSpecs.MONTH_RING_WIDTH,
+                cellHeight * CalendarDrawingSpecs.MONTH_RING_HEIGHT,
+            )
+        paint.style = Paint.Style.STROKE
+        paint.strokeWidth = CalendarDrawingSpecs.MONTH_RING_STROKE_DP * density
+        paint.color = outline
+        canvas.drawCircle(x, y, radius, paint)
+        drawMonthArcs(canvas, day, x, y, radius)
+        drawMonthLabel(canvas, day, x, y, radius)
+    }
+
+    private fun drawMonthArcs(
+        canvas: Canvas,
+        day: LocalDate,
+        x: Float,
+        y: Float,
+        radius: Float,
+    ) {
+        val dayStart = day.atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()
+        val dayEnd =
+            day
+                .plusDays(1)
+                .atStartOfDay(zone)
+                .toInstant()
+                .toEpochMilli()
+        val period = (dayEnd - dayStart).coerceAtLeast(1L).toFloat()
+        val matched = events.filter { it.start < dayEnd && it.end > dayStart }
+        matched.take(CalendarDrawingSpecs.ARC_EVENT_LIMIT).forEachIndexed { order, event ->
+            val first = ((maxOf(event.start, dayStart) - dayStart) / period).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
+            val last = ((minOf(event.end, dayEnd) - dayStart) / period).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
+            val sweep =
+                maxOf(
+                    CalendarDrawingSpecs.ARC_MIN_DEGREES,
+                    (last - first) * CalendarDrawingSpecs.ARC_FULL_DEGREES,
+                )
+            val radiusLayer =
+                radius - (order % CalendarDrawingSpecs.ARC_LAYER_COUNT) * CalendarDrawingSpecs.ARC_STROKE_DP * density
+            paint.color = colors[event.calendarId] ?: selectedColor
+            paint.strokeWidth = CalendarDrawingSpecs.ARC_STROKE_DP * density
+            arcBounds.set(x - radiusLayer, y - radiusLayer, x + radiusLayer, y + radiusLayer)
+            canvas.drawArc(
+                arcBounds,
+                CalendarDrawingSpecs.ARC_START_DEGREES + first * CalendarDrawingSpecs.ARC_FULL_DEGREES,
+                sweep,
+                false,
+                paint,
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun drawMonthLabel(
+        canvas: Canvas,
+        day: LocalDate,
+        x: Float,
+        y: Float,
+        radius: Float,
+    ) {
+        if (day == selected) {
+            paint.style = Paint.Style.FILL
+            paint.color = selectedColor
+            canvas.drawCircle(x, y, radius * CalendarDrawingSpecs.SELECTED_DAY_RADIUS, paint)
+        }
+        paint.style = Paint.Style.FILL
+        paint.typeface = if (day == selected) Typeface.DEFAULT_BOLD else Typeface.DEFAULT
+        paint.textSize = CalendarDrawingSpecs.MONTH_DAY_TEXT_SP * density
+        paint.color = if (day == selected) Color.WHITE else fg
+        canvas.drawText(
+            day.dayOfMonth.toString(),
+            x,
+            y + CalendarDrawingSpecs.DAY_NUMBER_BASELINE_DP * density,
+            paint,
+        )
+    }
+
+    override fun onTouchEvent(event: MotionEvent): Boolean =
+        when (event.action) {
+            MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
+                touchX = event.x
+                true
+            }
+
+            MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
+                val handled = handleMonthTouchUp(event)
+                if (handled) performClick()
+                handled
+            }
+
+            else -> {
+                super.onTouchEvent(event)
+            }
+        }
+
+    private fun handleMonthTouchUp(event: MotionEvent): Boolean {
+        val swipe = event.x - touchX
+        if (kotlin.math.abs(swipe) > CalendarDrawingSpecs.MONTH_SWIPE_DP * density) {
+            onMonthSwipe(if (swipe < 0) 1 else -1)
+            return true
+        }
+        val titleHeight = CalendarDrawingSpecs.MONTH_HEADER_DP * density
+        if (event.y >= titleHeight) {
+            selectMonthCell(event, titleHeight)
+        }
+        return true
+    }
+
+    private fun selectMonthCell(
+        event: MotionEvent,
+        titleHeight: Float,
+    ) {
+        val cellHeight = (height.toFloat() - titleHeight) / rows
+        val col =
+            (event.x / (width.toFloat() / CalendarDrawingSpecs.DAYS_PER_WEEK)).toInt().coerceIn(
+                0,
+                CalendarDrawingSpecs.LAST_DAY_INDEX,
+            )
+        val row = ((event.y - titleHeight) / cellHeight).toInt().coerceIn(0, rows - 1)
+        val day = start.plusDays((row * CalendarDrawingSpecs.DAYS_PER_WEEK + col).toLong())
+        if (day.month == month.month) onSelected(day)
+    }
+
+    override fun performClick(): Boolean {
+        super.performClick()
+        return true
+    }
+}
