+/** Single-day full timeline. Scrolls inside Day view; primary Calendar navigation remains fixed. */
+internal class D5DayTimelineView private constructor(
+    context: Context,
+    attrs: AttributeSet?,
+    private val model: DayRenderModel,
+) : View(context, attrs) {
+    private val day get() = model.day
+    private val events get() = model.paint.events
+    private val colors get() = model.paint.colors
+    private val zone get() = model.paint.zone
+    private val onEvent get() = model.onEvent
+
+    // Android Layout Editor: a valid empty day view, without Activity assumptions.
+    @JvmOverloads
+    constructor(context: Context, attrs: AttributeSet? = null) : this(
+        context,
+        attrs,
+        DayRenderModel(LocalDate.now(), CalendarEventPaint(emptyList(), emptyMap(), ZoneId.systemDefault()), {}),
+    )
+
+    constructor(activity: TenSevenCalendarActivity, model: DayRenderModel) : this(activity, null, model)
+
+    private val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG)
+    private val density = resources.displayMetrics.density
+    private val targets = mutableListOf<Pair<RectF, D5R2Event>>()
+    private val targetBounds = Array(CalendarDrawingSpecs.TIMELINE_EVENT_LIMIT) { RectF() }
+    private val laneBuffers = Array(CalendarDrawingSpecs.TIMELINE_MAX_LANES) { LongArray(it + 1) }
+    private val gutter = CalendarDrawingSpecs.TIMELINE_GUTTER_DP * density
+
+    override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
+        super.onDraw(canvas)
+        targets.clear()
+        val hourHeight = height / CalendarDrawingSpecs.TIMELINE_HOURS.toFloat()
+        drawTimelineRuler(canvas, hourHeight)
+        val beginning = day.atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()
+        val ending =
+            day
+                .plusDays(1)
+                .atStartOfDay(zone)
+                .toInstant()
+                .toEpochMilli()
+        val ordered = events.filter { it.start < ending && it.end > beginning }.sortedBy { it.start }
+        val peak =
+            (
+                ordered.maxOfOrNull { first ->
+                    ordered.count { other -> other.start < first.end && other.end > first.start }
+                } ?: 1
+            ).coerceIn(1, CalendarDrawingSpecs.TIMELINE_MAX_LANES)
+        val laneEnd = laneBuffers[peak - 1].apply { fill(Long.MIN_VALUE) }
+        ordered.take(CalendarDrawingSpecs.TIMELINE_EVENT_LIMIT).forEach { event ->
+            val first = maxOf(event.start, beginning)
+            val last = minOf(event.end, ending)
+            if (last <= first) return@forEach
+            val free = laneEnd.indexOfFirst { it <= first }
+            val lane = if (free >= 0) free else laneEnd.indices.minByOrNull { laneEnd[it] } ?: 0
+            laneEnd[lane] = last
+            val y =
+                (
+                    (first - beginning).toFloat() / (ending - beginning) *
+                        CalendarDrawingSpecs
+                            .TIMELINE_HOURS
+                ) * hourHeight
+            val bottom =
+                (
+                    (last - beginning).toFloat() / (ending - beginning) *
+                        CalendarDrawingSpecs
+                            .TIMELINE_HOURS
+                ) * hourHeight
+            val fullWidth = (width - gutter - CALENDAR_DRAW_VALUE_7 * density).coerceAtLeast(CALENDAR_DRAW_RATIO_30_F)
+            val laneWidth = fullWidth / peak.toFloat()
+            val x = gutter + CALENDAR_DRAW_RATIO_4_F * density + lane * laneWidth
+            val rect =
+                targetBounds[targets.size].apply {
+                    set(
+                        x,
+                        y + density,
+                        x + laneWidth - 2f * density,
+                        maxOf(y + CALENDAR_DRAW_RATIO_26_F * density, bottom - density),
+                    )
+                }
+            drawTimelineEventBox(canvas, rect, event)
+            targets.add(rect to event)
+        }
+        drawNowIndicator(canvas, hourHeight)
+    }
+
+    private fun drawNowIndicator(
+        canvas: Canvas,
+        hourHeight: Float,
+    ) {
+        if (day == LocalDate.now(zone)) {
+            val now = java.time.LocalTime.now(zone)
+            val y = (now.hour + now.minute / CalendarDrawingSpecs.TIMELINE_HOUR_MINUTES) * hourHeight
+            paint.color = Color.rgb(0, CALENDAR_DRAW_RGB_169, CALENDAR_DRAW_RGB_238)
+            paint.strokeWidth = 2f * density
+            canvas.drawLine(gutter, y, width.toFloat(), y, paint)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun drawTimelineRuler(
+        canvas: Canvas,
+        hourHeight: Float,
+    ) {
+        paint.style = Paint.Style.FILL
+        paint.typeface = Typeface.DEFAULT
+        paint.textAlign = Paint.Align.RIGHT
+        paint.textSize = CALENDAR_DRAW_SP_11_F * density
+        for (hour in 0..CalendarDrawingSpecs.TIMELINE_HOURS) {
+            val y = hour * hourHeight
+            paint.color = Color.rgb(CALENDAR_DRAW_RGB_50, CALENDAR_DRAW_RGB_57, CALENDAR_DRAW_RGB_66)
+            paint.strokeWidth = density
+            canvas.drawLine(gutter, y, width.toFloat(), y, paint)
+            if (hour < CalendarDrawingSpecs.TIMELINE_HOURS) {
+                paint.color = Color.rgb(CALENDAR_DRAW_RGB_180, CALENDAR_DRAW_RGB_192, CALENDAR_DRAW_RGB_205)
+                canvas.drawText(
+                    String.format(Locale.US, "%02d:00", hour),
+                    gutter - CALENDAR_DRAW_RATIO_8_F * density,
+                    y + CALENDAR_DRAW_RATIO_12_F * density,
+                    paint,
+                )
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun drawTimelineEventBox(
+        canvas: Canvas,
+        rect: RectF,
+        event: D5R2Event,
+    ) {
+        paint.style = Paint.Style.FILL
+        paint.color = Color.rgb(CALENDAR_DRAW_RGB_24, CALENDAR_DRAW_RGB_31, CALENDAR_DRAW_RGB_40)
+        canvas.drawRoundRect(rect, CALENDAR_DRAW_RATIO_4_F * density, CALENDAR_DRAW_RATIO_4_F * density, paint)
+        paint.color = colors[event.calendarId] ?: Color.rgb(0, CALENDAR_DRAW_RGB_151, CALENDAR_DRAW_RGB_235)
+        canvas.drawRect(rect.left, rect.top, rect.left + CALENDAR_DRAW_RATIO_3_F * density, rect.bottom, paint)
+        paint.color = Color.WHITE
+        paint.textAlign = Paint.Align.LEFT
+        paint.textSize = CALENDAR_DRAW_SP_11_F * density
+        canvas.drawText(
+            event.title.take(CALENDAR_DRAW_MAX_14),
+            rect.left + CALENDAR_DRAW_RATIO_6_F * density,
+            minOf(rect.bottom - CALENDAR_DRAW_RATIO_4_F * density, rect.top + CALENDAR_DRAW_RATIO_14_F * density),
+            paint,
+        )
+    }
+
+    override fun onTouchEvent(event: MotionEvent): Boolean =
+        when (event.action) {
+            MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
+                true
+            }
+
+            MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
+                targets.firstOrNull { it.first.contains(event.x, event.y) }?.second?.let(onEvent)
+                performClick()
+                true
+            }
+
+            else -> {
+                super.onTouchEvent(event)
+            }
+        }
+
+    override fun performClick(): Boolean {
+        super.performClick()
+        return true
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features
+
+import android.content.ContentProvider
+import android.content.ContentValues
+import android.database.Cursor
+import android.database.MatrixCursor
+import android.net.Uri
+import android.view.View
+import android.view.ViewGroup
+import android.widget.EditText
+import android.widget.TextView
+import org.robolectric.RuntimeEnvironment
+import org.robolectric.Shadows.shadowOf
+import org.robolectric.shadows.ShadowContentResolver
+
+internal object AndroidViewFixtures {
+    fun descendants(root: View): List<View> =
+        listOf(root) +
+            if (root is ViewGroup) {
+                (0 until root.childCount).flatMap { descendants(root.getChildAt(it)) }
+            } else {
+                emptyList()
+            }
+
+    fun text(
+        root: View,
+        value: String,
+    ): TextView = descendants(root).filterIsInstance<TextView>().first { it.text.toString() == value }
+
+    fun described(
+        root: View,
+        value: String,
+    ): View = descendants(root).first { it.contentDescription?.toString() == value }
+
+    fun input(
+        root: View,
+        hint: String,
+    ): EditText = descendants(root).filterIsInstance<EditText>().first { it.hint?.toString() == hint }
+
+    fun permission(
+        name: String,
+        granted: Boolean,
+    ) {
+        val application = shadowOf(RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication())
+        if (granted) application.grantPermissions(name) else application.denyPermissions(name)
+    }
+
+    fun provider(authority: String): FixtureProvider =
+        FixtureProvider().also { ShadowContentResolver.registerProviderInternal(authority, it) }
+}
+
+/** Synthetic records only. No provider writes, real contacts, network or device calls. */
+internal class FixtureProvider : ContentProvider() {
+    val records = mutableMapOf<String, List<Map<String, Any>>>()
+    val queries = mutableListOf<Uri>()
+
+    override fun onCreate() = true
+
+    override fun query(
+        uri: Uri,
+        projection: Array<out String>?,
+        selection: String?,
+        selectionArgs: Array<out String>?,
+        sortOrder: String?,
+    ): Cursor {
+        synchronized(queries) { queries.add(uri) }
+        val columns = projection?.toList().orEmpty()
+        val rows =
+            records.entries
+                .firstOrNull { uri.path.orEmpty().startsWith(it.key) }
+                ?.value
+                .orEmpty()
+        return MatrixCursor(columns.toTypedArray()).apply {
+            rows.forEach { row -> addRow(columns.map { row[it] }.toTypedArray()) }
+        }
+    }
+
+    override fun getType(uri: Uri): String? = null
+
+    override fun insert(
+        uri: Uri,
+        values: ContentValues?,
+    ): Uri = error("Unexpected provider write")
+
+    override fun delete(
+        uri: Uri,
+        selection: String?,
+        selectionArgs: Array<out String>?,
+    ): Int = error("Unexpected provider delete")
+
+    override fun update(
+        uri: Uri,
+        values: ContentValues?,
+        selection: String?,
+        selectionArgs: Array<out String>?,
+    ): Int = error("Unexpected provider update")
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,283 @@
+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven
+
+import android.app.Activity
+import android.app.Dialog
+import android.content.res.ColorStateList
+import android.graphics.Color
+import android.graphics.Typeface
+import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
+import android.view.Gravity
+import android.view.View
+import android.view.WindowManager
+import android.widget.CheckBox
+import android.widget.EditText
+import android.widget.LinearLayout
+import android.widget.TextView
+import androidx.core.graphics.drawable.toDrawable
+import androidx.core.graphics.toColorInt
+
+/** Named presentation/protocol values; numeric values unchanged from the reviewed source. */
+private const val BB_DIALOGS_CHOICES_DP_1 = 1
+private const val BB_DIALOGS_CHOICES_DP_2 = 2
+private const val BB_DIALOGS_MULTI_CHOICE_DP_1 = 1
+private const val BB_DIALOGS_MULTI_CHOICE_DP_2 = 2
+
+/** BB10-inspired local dialogs: no platform-white alert sheets on light-mode devices. */
+object D5BbDialogs {
+    // Approved BB10 dialog spacing, font sizes and sizing semantics.
+    private const val DIVIDER_THICKNESS_DP = 1
+    private const val CHECKBOX_PADDING_VERTICAL_DP = 6
+    private const val COMPACT_PADDING_DP = 8
+    private const val STANDARD_PADDING_VERTICAL_DP = 9
+    private const val INPUT_PADDING_HORIZONTAL_DP = 12
+    private const val LABEL_PADDING_HORIZONTAL_DP = 13
+    private const val CORNER_RADIUS_DP = 14
+    private const val CHOICE_ROW_MIN_HEIGHT_DP = 46
+    private const val ACTION_ROW_HEIGHT_DP = 48
+    private const val REPLY_INPUT_HEIGHT_DP = 85
+    private const val MULTICHOICE_LIST_HEIGHT_DP = 270
+    private const val TITLE_TEXT_SIZE_SP = 19f
+    private const val BODY_TEXT_SIZE_SP = 15f
+    private const val REPLY_TEXT_SIZE_SP = 16f
+    private const val CHOICE_TEXT_SIZE_SP = 14f
+    private const val REPLY_MAX_LINES = 3
+    private const val DIALOG_WIDTH_FRACTION = 0.92f
+    private const val ALTERNATING_ROW_PERIOD = 2
+    private val background = "#070C13".toColorInt()
+    private val panel = "#131E2B".toColorInt()
+    private val textColor = Color.WHITE
+    private val secondary = "#B8C9D7".toColorInt()
+    private val accent = "#00A6ED".toColorInt()
+    private val edge = "#354B5C".toColorInt()
+
+    private fun dp(
+        activity: Activity,
+        n: Int,
+    ) = (activity.resources.displayMetrics.density * n).toInt()
+
+    private fun shape(activity: Activity) =
+        GradientDrawable().apply {
+            setColor(background)
+            cornerRadius = dp(activity, CORNER_RADIUS_DP).toFloat()
+            setStroke(dp(activity, DIVIDER_THICKNESS_DP), edge)
+        }
+
+    private fun label(
+        activity: Activity,
+        text: String,
+        title: Boolean = false,
+    ): TextView =
+        TextView(activity).apply {
+            this.text = text
+            textSize = if (title) TITLE_TEXT_SIZE_SP else BODY_TEXT_SIZE_SP
+            setTextColor(if (title) textColor else secondary)
+            if (title) setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD)
+            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
+            setPadding(
+                dp(activity, LABEL_PADDING_HORIZONTAL_DP),
+                dp(activity, STANDARD_PADDING_VERTICAL_DP),
+                dp(activity, LABEL_PADDING_HORIZONTAL_DP),
+                dp(activity, STANDARD_PADDING_VERTICAL_DP),
+            )
+        }
+
+    private fun divider(
+        activity: Activity,
+        root: LinearLayout,
+    ) {
+        root.addView(
+            View(activity).apply { setBackgroundColor(edge) },
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
+                -1,
+                dp(
+                    activity,
+                    DIVIDER_THICKNESS_DP,
+                ),
+            ),
+        )
+    }
+
+    fun custom(
+        activity: Activity,
+        title: String,
+        contents: (LinearLayout, Dialog) -> Unit,
+    ): Dialog {
+        val dialog = Dialog(activity)
+        val shell =
+            LinearLayout(activity).apply {
+                orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
+                background = shape(activity)
+                setPadding(
+                    dp(activity, COMPACT_PADDING_DP),
+                    dp(activity, COMPACT_PADDING_DP),
+                    dp(activity, COMPACT_PADDING_DP),
+                    dp(activity, STANDARD_PADDING_VERTICAL_DP),
+                )
+            }
+        shell.addView(label(activity, title, true))
+        divider(activity, shell)
+        contents(shell, dialog)
+        dialog.setContentView(shell)
+        dialog.window?.setBackgroundDrawable(Color.TRANSPARENT.toDrawable())
+        dialog.window?.addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_DIM_BEHIND)
+        dialog.show()
+        val width = (activity.resources.displayMetrics.widthPixels * DIALOG_WIDTH_FRACTION).toInt()
+        dialog.window?.setLayout(width, WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
+        return dialog
+    }
+
+    fun choices(
+        activity: Activity,
+        title: String,
+        choices: List<String>,
+        onChoice: (Int) -> Unit,
+    ) {
+        custom(activity, title) { body, dialog ->
+            choices.forEachIndexed { index, name ->
+                val choice =
+                    label(activity, name).apply {
+                        setTextColor(textColor)
+                        minHeight = dp(activity, CHOICE_ROW_MIN_HEIGHT_DP)
+                        setBackgroundColor(if (index % ALTERNATING_ROW_PERIOD == 0) panel else D5BbDialogs.background)
+                        isClickable = true
+                        isFocusable = true
+                        setOnClickListener {
+                            dialog.dismiss()
+                            onChoice(index)
+                        }
+                    }
+                body.addView(choice, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-BB_DIALOGS_CHOICES_DP_1, -BB_DIALOGS_CHOICES_DP_2))
+                divider(activity, body)
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun confirm(
+        activity: Activity,
+        title: String,
+        message: String,
+        confirmText: String,
+        onConfirm: () -> Unit,
+    ) {
+        custom(activity, title) { body, dialog ->
+            body.addView(label(activity, message))
+            val row = LinearLayout(activity).apply { gravity = Gravity.END }
+            body.addView(row)
+            listOf("Cancel", confirmText).forEachIndexed { index, text ->
+                val b =
+                    label(activity, text).apply {
+                        setTextColor(if (index == 1) accent else secondary)
+                        gravity = Gravity.CENTER
+                        isClickable = true
+                        setOnClickListener {
+                            dialog.dismiss()
+                            if (index == 1) onConfirm()
+                        }
+                    }
+                row.addView(b, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, dp(activity, ACTION_ROW_HEIGHT_DP), 1f))
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun message(
+        activity: Activity,
+        title: String,
+        message: String,
+    ) {
+        confirm(activity, title, message, "OK") { }
+    }
+
+    fun prompt(
+        activity: Activity,
+        title: String,
+        positive: String,
+        onSubmit: (String) -> Unit,
+    ) {
+        custom(activity, title) { body, dialog ->
+            val input =
+                EditText(activity).apply {
+                    hint = "Type a reply"
+                    textSize = REPLY_TEXT_SIZE_SP
+                    setTextColor(textColor)
+                    setHintTextColor(secondary)
+                    setSingleLine(false)
+                    maxLines = REPLY_MAX_LINES
+                    background = shape(activity)
+                    setPadding(
+                        dp(activity, INPUT_PADDING_HORIZONTAL_DP),
+                        dp(activity, STANDARD_PADDING_VERTICAL_DP),
+                        dp(activity, INPUT_PADDING_HORIZONTAL_DP),
+                        dp(activity, STANDARD_PADDING_VERTICAL_DP),
+                    )
+                }
+            body.addView(input, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, dp(activity, REPLY_INPUT_HEIGHT_DP)))
+            val action =
+                label(activity, positive).apply {
+                    gravity = Gravity.CENTER
+                    setTextColor(accent)
+                    setOnClickListener {
+                        val value = input.text.toString().trim()
+                        if (value.isNotEmpty()) {
+                            dialog.dismiss()
+                            onSubmit(value)
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            body.addView(action, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, dp(activity, ACTION_ROW_HEIGHT_DP)))
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun multiChoice(
+        activity: Activity,
+        title: String,
+        labels: List<String>,
+        checked: BooleanArray,
+        onSave: () -> Unit,
+    ) {
+        custom(activity, title) { body, dialog ->
+            val choices = android.widget.ScrollView(activity)
+            val rows = LinearLayout(activity).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL }
+            choices.addView(rows)
+            body.addView(choices, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, dp(activity, MULTICHOICE_LIST_HEIGHT_DP)))
+            labels.forEachIndexed { index, value ->
+                val checkbox =
+                    CheckBox(activity).apply {
+                        text = value
+                        textSize = CHOICE_TEXT_SIZE_SP
+                        setTextColor(textColor)
+                        buttonTintList = ColorStateList.valueOf(accent)
+                        isChecked = checked[index]
+                        setPadding(
+                            dp(activity, COMPACT_PADDING_DP),
+                            dp(activity, CHECKBOX_PADDING_VERTICAL_DP),
+                            dp(activity, COMPACT_PADDING_DP),
+                            dp(activity, CHECKBOX_PADDING_VERTICAL_DP),
+                        )
+                        setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, state -> checked[index] = state }
+                    }
+                rows.addView(
+                    checkbox,
+                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
+                        -BB_DIALOGS_MULTI_CHOICE_DP_1,
+                        -BB_DIALOGS_MULTI_CHOICE_DP_2,
+                    ),
+                )
+            }
+            val actions = LinearLayout(activity)
+            body.addView(actions)
+            listOf("Cancel", "Save").forEachIndexed { index, name ->
+                actions.addView(
+                    label(activity, name).apply {
+                        gravity = Gravity.CENTER
+                        setTextColor(if (index == 1) accent else secondary)
+                        setOnClickListener {
+                            dialog.dismiss()
+                            if (index == 1) onSave()
+                        }
+                    },
+                    LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, dp(activity, ACTION_ROW_HEIGHT_DP), 1f),
+                )
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model
+
+import java.time.LocalDate
+import java.time.YearMonth
+import java.time.ZoneId
+
+/** Independent, JVM-testable busy-day policy. Calendar stays read-only until Android takes over event editing. */
+data class D5TimeSpan(
+    val startMillis: Long,
+    val endMillis: Long,
+    val allDay: Boolean,
+)
+
+object D5CalendarBusy {
+    private const val DAYS_PER_WEEK = 7
+    private const val WINDOW_START_HOUR = 8
+    private const val WINDOW_END_HOUR = 20
+    private const val MINUTES_PER_HOUR = 60
+    private const val MILLIS_PER_MINUTE = 60_000L
+    private const val MIN_SWEEP_DEGREES = 24f
+    private const val FULL_SWEEP_DEGREES = 360f
+    private const val MINUTES_PER_DAY = (WINDOW_END_HOUR - WINDOW_START_HOUR) * MINUTES_PER_HOUR
+
+    fun monthCells(month: YearMonth): List<LocalDate?> {
+        val before = month.atDay(1).dayOfWeek.value - 1 // Monday first
+        val days = (1..month.lengthOfMonth()).map(month::atDay)
+        val cells = List<LocalDate?>(before) { null } + days
+        return cells + List((DAYS_PER_WEEK - cells.size % DAYS_PER_WEEK) % DAYS_PER_WEEK) { null }
+    }
+
+    /** Merged booked minutes 08:00–20:00, including overlaps only once. */
+    fun bookedMinutes(
+        date: LocalDate,
+        spans: List<D5TimeSpan>,
+        zone: ZoneId,
+    ): Int {
+        val from =
+            date
+                .atTime(WINDOW_START_HOUR, 0)
+                .atZone(zone)
+                .toInstant()
+                .toEpochMilli()
+        val until =
+            date
+                .atTime(WINDOW_END_HOUR, 0)
+                .atZone(zone)
+                .toInstant()
+                .toEpochMilli()
+        val intervals =
+            spans
+                .asSequence()
+                .filterNot { it.allDay }
+                .map { maxOf(from, it.startMillis) to minOf(until, it.endMillis) }
+                .filter { it.second > it.first }
+                .sortedBy { it.first }
+                .toList()
+        var stop = from
+        var millis = 0L
+        for ((start, end) in intervals) {
+            if (end <= stop) continue
+            millis += end - maxOf(start, stop)
+            stop = end
+        }
+        return (millis / MILLIS_PER_MINUTE).toInt().coerceIn(0, MINUTES_PER_DAY)
+    }
+
+    fun sweep(
+        date: LocalDate,
+        spans: List<D5TimeSpan>,
+        zone: ZoneId,
+    ): Float {
+        val minutes = bookedMinutes(date, spans, zone)
+        return if (minutes == 0) 0f else maxOf(MIN_SWEEP_DEGREES, FULL_SWEEP_DEGREES * minutes / MINUTES_PER_DAY)
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model
+
+private object FitLimits {
+    const val COMPACT_HEIGHT_DP = 500f
+    const val COMPACT_WIDTH_DP = 420f
+    const val MATCH_ROWS_COMPACT = 1
+    const val MATCH_ROWS_REGULAR = 2
+    const val MONTH_CELL_COMPACT_DP = 28
+    const val MONTH_CELL_REGULAR_DP = 34
+    const val CALENDAR_NAV_COMPACT_DP = 44
+    const val CALENDAR_NAV_REGULAR_DP = 49
+    const val CALL_COMPACT_DP = 48
+    const val CALL_REGULAR_DP = 54
+    const val WEEK_STRIP_COMPACT_DP = 46
+    const val WEEK_STRIP_REGULAR_DP = 57
+}
+
+/** Screen profile is measured in available display dp, not a guessed device model or scan code. */
+object D5ScreenFitPolicy {
+    data class Fit(
+        val compact: Boolean,
+        val dialMatchRows: Int,
+        val monthCellDp: Int,
+        val calendarNavDp: Int,
+        val dialCallDp: Int,
+        val weekStripDp: Int,
+    )
+
+    fun forViewport(
+        widthDp: Float,
+        heightDp: Float,
+    ): Fit {
+        require(widthDp > 0f && heightDp > 0f)
+        val compact = heightDp < FitLimits.COMPACT_HEIGHT_DP || widthDp < FitLimits.COMPACT_WIDTH_DP
+        return Fit(
+            compact,
+            if (compact) FitLimits.MATCH_ROWS_COMPACT else FitLimits.MATCH_ROWS_REGULAR,
+            if (compact) FitLimits.MONTH_CELL_COMPACT_DP else FitLimits.MONTH_CELL_REGULAR_DP,
+            if (compact) FitLimits.CALENDAR_NAV_COMPACT_DP else FitLimits.CALENDAR_NAV_REGULAR_DP,
+            if (compact) FitLimits.CALL_COMPACT_DP else FitLimits.CALL_REGULAR_DP,
+            if (compact) FitLimits.WEEK_STRIP_COMPACT_DP else FitLimits.WEEK_STRIP_REGULAR_DP,
+        )
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.platform
+
+import android.app.Activity
+import android.graphics.Color
+import android.util.Log
+import android.view.View
+import android.view.WindowInsets
+import androidx.core.view.ViewCompat
+import androidx.core.view.WindowCompat
+import androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.model.D5ScreenFitPolicy
+
+/**
+ * Explicit safe-viewport boundary for TenSeven's View-based activities.
+ *
+ * Do NOT apply this blindly to Compose roots (which may already use safeDrawingPadding),
+ * wallpaper-backed Home, lock-screen covers or deliberately immersive screens.
+ * These need individual inset ownership checks to avoid double padding.
+ *
+ * Invariant: the root's content begins below system bars and display cutouts,
+ * and fixed bottom controls sit above Android gesture/three-button navigation.
+ * Root background still paints behind transparent bars for BB10 dark appearance.
+ */
+object TenSevenSafeViewport {
+    fun darkSystemBars(activity: Activity) {
+        activity.window.decorView.setBackgroundColor(Color.BLACK)
+        WindowCompat.getInsetsController(activity.window, activity.window.decorView).apply {
+            isAppearanceLightStatusBars = false
+            isAppearanceLightNavigationBars = false
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun show(
+        activity: Activity,
+        root: View,
+    ) {
+        // Required for targetSdk 35+: edge-to-edge is enforced by Android.
+        WindowCompat.setDecorFitsSystemWindows(activity.window, false)
+        darkSystemBars(activity)
+        val left = root.paddingLeft
+        val top = root.paddingTop
+        val right = root.paddingRight
+        val bottom = root.paddingBottom
+        ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(root) { view, insets ->
+            val safe =
+                insets.getInsets(
+                    WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars() or WindowInsetsCompat.Type.displayCutout(),
+                )
+            val targetLeft = left + safe.left
+            val targetTop = top + safe.top
+            val targetRight = right + safe.right
+            val targetBottom = bottom + safe.bottom
+            val horizontalChanged = view.paddingLeft != targetLeft || view.paddingRight != targetRight
+            val verticalChanged = view.paddingTop != targetTop || view.paddingBottom != targetBottom
+            if (horizontalChanged || verticalChanged) {
+                view.setPadding(targetLeft, targetTop, targetRight, targetBottom)
+            }
+            // Do not consume: child controls and IME handlers may also need insets.
+            insets
+        }
+        activity.setContentView(root)
+        Log.i("TenSevenD5R8", "${activity.javaClass.simpleName}: safe viewport enabled")
+        ViewCompat.requestApplyInsets(root)
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Select Titan 2 / Q25 sizing from current window bounds *minus* system bars,
+     * rather than DisplayMetrics height (which includes system bars on Android 15+).
+     */
+    fun fit(activity: Activity): D5ScreenFitPolicy.Fit {
+        val metrics = activity.windowManager.currentWindowMetrics
+        val safe =
+            metrics.windowInsets.getInsets(
+                WindowInsets.Type.systemBars() or WindowInsets.Type.displayCutout(),
+            )
+        val density = activity.resources.displayMetrics.density
+        val width = (metrics.bounds.width() - safe.left - safe.right).coerceAtLeast(1)
+        val height = (metrics.bounds.height() - safe.top - safe.bottom).coerceAtLeast(1)
+        return D5ScreenFitPolicy.forViewport(width / density, height / density)
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven
+
+import android.app.Activity
+import android.app.role.RoleManager
+import android.content.ComponentName
+import android.content.Intent
+import android.content.pm.PackageManager
+import android.graphics.Color
+import android.os.Bundle
+import android.provider.Settings
+import android.view.Gravity
+import android.widget.LinearLayout
+import android.widget.TextView
+import androidx.core.graphics.toColorInt
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.platform.TenSevenSafeViewport
+
+/** Explicit, user-initiated system Phone-role request, separate from Setup's Compose navigation. */
+class D5PhoneRoleRequestActivity : Activity() {
+    // Stable system role request code and approved default-Phone setup metrics.
+    private companion object {
+        const val PHONE_ROLE_REQUEST_CODE = 451
+        const val TEXT_VERTICAL_PADDING_DP = 8
+        const val ACTION_VERTICAL_PADDING_DP = 14
+        const val CONTENT_BOTTOM_PADDING_DP = 18
+        const val CONTENT_HORIZONTAL_PADDING_DP = 20
+        const val CONTENT_TOP_PADDING_DP = 22
+        const val ACTION_ROW_HEIGHT_DP = 57
+        const val ACTION_TEXT_SIZE_SP = 16f
+        const val TITLE_TEXT_SIZE_SP = 22f
+        const val BODY_TEXT_SIZE_SP = 16f
+    }
+
+    private var requestStarted = false
+    private val roleRequest = PHONE_ROLE_REQUEST_CODE
+
+    private fun dp(value: Int) = (value * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
+
+    private fun roleManager() = getSystemService(RoleManager::class.java)
+
+    private fun holdsRole() = roleManager()?.isRoleHeld(RoleManager.ROLE_DIALER) == true
+
+    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
+        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
+        requestStarted = savedInstanceState?.getBoolean("requested") ?: false
+        render()
+        if (!requestStarted && !holdsRole()) {
+            window.decorView.post { requestPhoneRole() }
+        }
+    }
+
+    override fun onSaveInstanceState(outState: Bundle) {
+        outState.putBoolean("requested", requestStarted)
+        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState)
+    }
+
+    override fun onResume() {
+        super.onResume()
+        render()
+    }
+
+    @Deprecated("Legacy Activity result used for system ROLE_DIALER confirmation")
+    override fun onActivityResult(
+        requestCode: Int,
+        resultCode: Int,
+        data: Intent?,
+    ) {
+        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data)
+        if (requestCode == roleRequest) render()
+    }
+
+    private fun requestPhoneRole() {
+        val roles = roleManager()
+        val component =
+            ComponentName(
+                packageName,
+                "io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.phone.TenSevenPhoneActivity",
+            )
+        val enabled =
+            packageManager.getComponentEnabledSetting(component) in
+                setOf(PackageManager.COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE_DEFAULT, PackageManager.COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE_ENABLED)
+        if (!enabled || roles?.isRoleAvailable(RoleManager.ROLE_DIALER) != true) {
+            render()
+            return
+        }
+        if (holdsRole()) {
+            render()
+            return
+        }
+        requestStarted = true
+        try {
+            startActivityForResult(roles.createRequestRoleIntent(RoleManager.ROLE_DIALER), roleRequest)
+        } catch (_: Exception) {
+            render() // Fall back to Android Default Apps rather than silently closing Setup.
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun createPhoneRoleRoot(background: Int): LinearLayout =
+        LinearLayout(this).apply {
+            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
+            setBackgroundColor(background)
+            setPadding(
+                dp(CONTENT_HORIZONTAL_PADDING_DP),
+                dp(CONTENT_TOP_PADDING_DP),
+                dp(CONTENT_HORIZONTAL_PADDING_DP),
+                dp(CONTENT_BOTTOM_PADDING_DP),
+            )
+        }
+
+    private fun render() {
+        val bg = "#070C13".toColorInt()
+        val fg = Color.WHITE
+        val muted = "#B2C4D2".toColorInt()
+        val blue = "#00A7F0".toColorInt()
+        val root = createPhoneRoleRoot(bg)
+
+        fun text(
+            value: String,
+            size: Float,
+            color: Int,
+            bold: Boolean = false,
+        ) {
+            root.addView(
+                TextView(this).apply {
+                    this.text = value
+                    textSize = size
+                    setTextColor(color)
+                    if (bold) setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD)
+                    setPadding(0, dp(TEXT_VERTICAL_PADDING_DP), 0, dp(TEXT_VERTICAL_PADDING_DP))
+                },
+            )
+        }
+
+        fun action(
+            value: String,
+            onClick: () -> Unit,
+        ) {
+            root.addView(
+                TextView(this).apply {
+                    text = value
+                    textSize = ACTION_TEXT_SIZE_SP
+                    setTextColor(blue)
+                    gravity = Gravity.CENTER
+                    setPadding(
+                        dp(TEXT_VERTICAL_PADDING_DP),
+                        dp(ACTION_VERTICAL_PADDING_DP),
+                        dp(TEXT_VERTICAL_PADDING_DP),
+                        dp(ACTION_VERTICAL_PADDING_DP),
+                    )
+                    setOnClickListener { onClick() }
+                },
+                LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, dp(ACTION_ROW_HEIGHT_DP)),
+            )
+        }
+        text("Default Phone app", TITLE_TEXT_SIZE_SP, fg, true)
+        val component =
+            ComponentName(
+                packageName,
+                "io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.phone.TenSevenPhoneActivity",
+            )
+        val enabled =
+            packageManager.getComponentEnabledSetting(component) in
+                setOf(PackageManager.COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE_DEFAULT, PackageManager.COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE_ENABLED)
+        when {
+            holdsRole() -> {
+                text("TenSeven Phone is the current default Phone app.", BODY_TEXT_SIZE_SP, fg)
+            }
+
+            !enabled -> {
+                text(
+                    "TenSeven Phone is unavailable on this device.",
+                    BODY_TEXT_SIZE_SP,
+                    muted,
+                )
+            }
+
+            else -> {
+                text(
+                    "Android lists this separate application as 'TenSeven Phone'. Selecting that " +
+                        "package lets TenSeven Phone handle calls.",
+                    BODY_TEXT_SIZE_SP,
+                    muted,
+                )
+            }
+        }
+        if (enabled && !holdsRole()) {
+            action("Choose TenSeven as default Phone") { requestPhoneRole() }
+            action("Open Android Default Apps") {
+                try {
+                    startActivity(Intent(Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_DEFAULT_APPS_SETTINGS))
+                } catch (
+                    _: Exception,
+                ) {
+                    D5BbDialogs.message(this, "Default apps", "Open Android Settings > Apps > Default apps > Phone app")
+                }
+            }
+        }
+        action("Back to Phone") { finish() }
+        TenSevenSafeViewport.show(this, root)
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.phone
+
+/** Last-call identity is retained only in process memory for the Call ended screen. */
+internal object D6CallIdentityPolicy {
+    const val PRIVATE_LABEL = "Private caller"
+
+    data class Snapshot(
+        val number: String?,
+        val networkName: String?,
+    )
+
+    fun reconcile(
+        previous: Snapshot,
+        rawNumber: String?,
+        rawName: String?,
+        newCall: Boolean,
+    ): Snapshot {
+        val number = publicNumber(rawNumber)
+        val networkName = rawName?.trim()?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
+        // A genuinely new private call must not inherit the previous caller's identity.
+        return if (newCall) {
+            Snapshot(number, networkName)
+        } else {
+            Snapshot(number ?: previous.number, networkName ?: previous.networkName)
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun publicNumber(raw: String?): String? =
+        raw?.trim()?.takeIf {
+            it.isNotEmpty() &&
+                it.lowercase() !in setOf("private number", "unknown", "restricted", "anonymous")
+        }
+
+    fun displayNumber(number: String?): String = number ?: "Private number"
+
+    fun callerName(
+        contact: String?,
+        network: String?,
+        number: String,
+    ): String =
+        contact?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
+            ?: network?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
+            ?: number
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.phone
+
+import android.Manifest
+import android.app.role.RoleManager
+import android.provider.CallLog
+import android.text.InputType
+import android.view.View
+import android.widget.EditText
+import android.widget.FrameLayout
+import android.widget.LinearLayout
+import android.widget.ScrollView
+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.D5BbDialogs
+
+/** Activity-bound PhoneBlocklistContent renderer; lifecycle and mutable state remain with the activity. */
+internal class PhoneBlocklistContent(
+    private val activity: TenSevenPhoneActivity,
+) {
+    fun blocklist(frame: FrameLayout) {
+        val scroll = ScrollView(activity)
+        frame.addView(scroll, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
+        val body =
+            activity.views.column().apply {
+                setPadding(
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_LIST_CONTENT_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_SECTION_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_LIST_CONTENT_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_CALLOUT_CONTENT_INSET_DP),
+                )
+            }
+        scroll.addView(body)
+        activity.views.notice(
+            body,
+            "Numbers you explicitly block are screened when TenSeven holds " +
+                "the optional Android screening role.",
+        )
+        blockNumberEntry(body)
+        renderBlockedNumberRows(body)
+        renderCallScreeningSetting(body)
+        allowNumberEntry(body)
+        renderAllowedNumberRows(body)
+        renderUnknownCallerSilencer(body)
+        renderBlockedCallHistory(body)
+        activity.views.notice(
+            body,
+            "Unknown calls are only silenced when screening is enabled and Contacts access is allowed.",
+        )
+    }
+
+    private fun blockNumberEntry(body: LinearLayout) {
+        val input =
+            EditText(activity).apply {
+                hint = "Number with country code"
+                inputType = InputType.TYPE_CLASS_PHONE
+                setTextColor(activity.views.colors.fg)
+                setHintTextColor(activity.views.colors.muted)
+            }
+        body.addView(input)
+        body.addView(
+            activity.views
+                .clickLabel("Block number", "Block number") {
+                    val value = PhoneBlocklist.normalize(input.text.toString())
+                    if (value.length < PHONE_BLOCKLIST_VALUE_7) {
+                        activity.toast("Enter a full number")
+                    } else {
+                        PhoneBlocklist.block(activity, value)
+                        activity.draw()
+                    }
+                }.apply { setTextColor(activity.views.colors.accent) },
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.px(PHONE_MENU_ROW_HEIGHT_DP)),
+        )
+    }
+
+    private fun renderBlockedNumberRows(body: LinearLayout) {
+        PhoneBlocklist.blocked(activity).sorted().forEach { number ->
+            body.addView(
+                activity.views.clickLabel("$number     Unblock", "Unblock $number") {
+                    D5BbDialogs.confirm(activity, "Unblock number", "Allow calls from $number?", "Unblock") {
+                        PhoneBlocklist.unblock(activity, number)
+                        activity.draw()
+                    }
+                },
+                LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.px(PHONE_COMPACT_NAVIGATION_HEIGHT_DP)),
+            )
+            activity.views.rule(body)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun renderCallScreeningSetting(body: LinearLayout) {
+        body.addView(
+            activity.views
+                .clickLabel("Allowed numbers / screening settings", "Screening settings") {
+                    val roles = activity.getSystemService(RoleManager::class.java)
+                    if (roles?.isRoleAvailable(RoleManager.ROLE_CALL_SCREENING) == true &&
+                        !roles.isRoleHeld(RoleManager.ROLE_CALL_SCREENING)
+                    ) {
+                        activity.safeStart(roles.createRequestRoleIntent(RoleManager.ROLE_CALL_SCREENING))
+                    } else {
+                        D5BbDialogs.message(
+                            activity,
+                            "Call screening",
+                            "Review Android Default Apps to change call screening.",
+                        )
+                    }
+                }.apply { setTextColor(activity.views.colors.accent) },
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.px(PHONE_CONTACT_OR_MENU_ROW_DP)),
+        )
+    }
+
+    private fun allowNumberEntry(body: LinearLayout) {
+        // Preserve existing explicit allowlist without auto-blocking unknown callers.
+        val allow =
+            EditText(activity).apply {
+                hint = "Number to allow"
+                inputType = InputType.TYPE_CLASS_PHONE
+                setTextColor(activity.views.colors.fg)
+                setHintTextColor(activity.views.colors.muted)
+            }
+        body.addView(allow)
+        body.addView(
+            activity.views.clickLabel("Allow number", "Allow number") {
+                val number = PhoneBlocklist.normalize(allow.text.toString())
+                if (number.length < PHONE_BLOCKLIST_VALUE_7) {
+                    activity.toast("Enter a full number")
+                } else {
+                    PhoneBlocklist.allow(activity, number)
+                    activity.draw()
+                }
+            },
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.px(PHONE_MENU_ACTION_HEIGHT_DP)),
+        )
+    }
+
+    private fun renderAllowedNumberRows(body: LinearLayout) {
+        PhoneBlocklist.allowed(activity).sorted().forEach { number ->
+            body.addView(
+                activity.views.clickLabel("$number     Remove", "Remove allowed $number") {
+                    D5BbDialogs.confirm(activity, "Remove exception", "Remove allowed number $number?", "Remove") {
+                        PhoneBlocklist.unallow(activity, number)
+                        activity.draw()
+                    }
+                },
+                LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.px(PHONE_COMPACT_NAVIGATION_HEIGHT_DP)),
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun renderUnknownCallerSilencer(body: LinearLayout) {
+        body.addView(
+            activity.views.clickLabel(
+                "Silence unknown: ${if (PhoneBlocklist.silenceUnknown(activity)) "ON" else "OFF"}",
+            ) {
+                PhoneBlocklist.setSilenceUnknown(activity, !PhoneBlocklist.silenceUnknown(activity))
+                activity.draw()
+            },
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.px(PHONE_STANDARD_NAVIGATION_HEIGHT_DP)),
+        )
+    }
+
+    private fun renderBlockedCallHistory(body: LinearLayout) {
+        body.addView(
+            activity.views.clickLabel("Blocked call history", "View blocked calls") {
+                if (!activity.isGranted(Manifest.permission.READ_CALL_LOG)) {
+                    activity.requestPermissions(arrayOf(Manifest.permission.READ_CALL_LOG), PHONE_REQUEST_CALL_LOG)
+                } else {
+                    val recent =
+                        activity.data
+                            .calls()
+                            .filter { it.kind == CallLog.Calls.BLOCKED_TYPE }
+                            .take(PHONE_BLOCKLIST_MAX_25)
+                    D5BbDialogs.message(
+                        activity,
+                        "Blocked calls",
+                        if (recent.isEmpty()) {
+                            "No blocked calls in Android call history"
+                        } else {
+                            recent.joinToString("\n") { "${it.number} · ${it.whenText}" }
+                        },
+                    )
+                }
+            },
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.px(PHONE_STANDARD_NAVIGATION_HEIGHT_DP)),
+        )
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.phone
+
+import android.Manifest
+import android.text.Editable
+import android.text.TextWatcher
+import android.view.Gravity
+import android.view.View
+import android.widget.EditText
+import android.widget.FrameLayout
+import android.widget.LinearLayout
+import android.widget.ScrollView
+
+/** Activity-bound PhoneContactsContent renderer; lifecycle and mutable state remain with the activity. */
+internal class PhoneContactsContent(
+    private val activity: TenSevenPhoneActivity,
+    private val onOpenContact: (Long) -> Unit,
+    private val onAddContact: () -> Unit,
+) {
+    private fun appendPhoneContactRow(
+        list: LinearLayout,
+        person: TenSevenPhoneData.Person,
+    ) {
+        val entry =
+            activity.views.row().apply {
+                setPadding(
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_PAGE_CONTENT_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_TIGHT_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_STANDARD_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_TIGHT_INSET_DP),
+                )
+                isClickable = true
+                isFocusable = true
+                contentDescription = "Open ${person.name}"
+                setOnClickListener { onOpenContact(person.id) }
+            }
+        list.addView(entry, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.px(PHONE_CONTACT_OR_MENU_ROW_DP)))
+        entry.addView(
+            TenSevenContactPhotos.avatar(
+                activity,
+                person.id,
+                person.name,
+                PHONE_POPULATE_VALUE_36,
+                activity.views.colors,
+            ),
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
+                activity.views.px(PHONE_CONTACT_AVATAR_EDGE_DP),
+                activity.views.px(PHONE_CONTACT_AVATAR_EDGE_DP),
+            ),
+        )
+        entry.addView(
+            activity.views.label(person.name, PHONE_BODY_TEXT_SP).apply {
+                setPadding(
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_PAGE_CONTENT_INSET_DP),
+                    0,
+                    0,
+                    0,
+                )
+            },
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -1, 1f),
+        )
+        activity.views.rule(list)
+    }
+
+    fun contacts(frame: FrameLayout) {
+        val container = activity.views.column()
+        frame.addView(container, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
+        if (!activity.isGranted(Manifest.permission.READ_CONTACTS)) {
+            activity.views.notice(
+                container,
+                "Allow Contacts to show people stored on this device. No contact information is uploaded.",
+                "Allow Contacts",
+            ) { activity.requestPermissions(arrayOf(Manifest.permission.READ_CONTACTS), PHONE_REQUEST_CONTACTS) }
+            return
+        }
+        val people = activity.data.people().distinctBy { it.id }
+        val search = phoneContactsSearch(container)
+        val area = FrameLayout(activity)
+        container.addView(area, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1f))
+        val scroll =
+            ScrollView(activity).apply {
+                isFillViewport = true
+                isVerticalScrollBarEnabled = false
+            }
+        area.addView(scroll, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
+        val list =
+            activity.views.column().apply {
+                setPadding(
+                    0,
+                    0,
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_LIST_FOOTER_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_CONTACT_LIST_BOTTOM_INSET_DP),
+                )
+            }
+        scroll.addView(list)
+        val sections = mutableMapOf<String, View>()
+
+        attachPhoneContactSearch(search, people, list, sections)
+        populatePhoneContacts(activity.contactSearch, people, list, sections)
+        installPhoneAlphabet(area, scroll, sections)
+        activity.views.floating(
+            area,
+            "+",
+            "Add contact",
+            FloatingPosition(Gravity.END or Gravity.BOTTOM, PHONE_KEYPAD_VALUE_15, PHONE_KEYPAD_VALUE_16),
+        ) { onAddContact() }
+    }
+
+    private fun attachPhoneContactSearch(
+        search: EditText,
+        people: List<TenSevenPhoneData.Person>,
+        list: LinearLayout,
+        sections: MutableMap<String, View>,
+    ) {
+        search.addTextChangedListener(
+            object : TextWatcher {
+                override fun beforeTextChanged(
+                    s: CharSequence?,
+                    start: Int,
+                    count: Int,
+                    after: Int,
+                ) = Unit
+
+                override fun onTextChanged(
+                    s: CharSequence?,
+                    start: Int,
+                    before: Int,
+                    count: Int,
+                ) {
+                    populatePhoneContacts(s?.toString().orEmpty(), people, list, sections)
+                }
+
+                override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) = Unit
+            },
+        )
+    }
+
+    private fun populatePhoneContacts(
+        query: String,
+        people: List<TenSevenPhoneData.Person>,
+        list: LinearLayout,
+        sections: MutableMap<String, View>,
+    ) {
+        activity.contactSearch = query
+        list.removeAllViews()
+        sections.clear()
+        val filtered = matchingPhoneContacts(query, people)
+        if (filtered.isEmpty()) {
+            activity.views.notice(list, "No matching contacts")
+            return
+        }
+        var previous = ""
+        filtered.forEach { person ->
+            val letter = PhoneUiRules.firstLetter(person.name)
+            if (letter != previous) {
+                val heading =
+                    activity.views.label(letter, PHONE_COMPACT_TEXT_SP, bold = true).apply {
+                        setPadding(
+                            activity.views.px(PHONE_LIST_CONTENT_INSET_DP),
+                            activity.views.px(PHONE_EXTRA_TIGHT_INSET_DP),
+                            activity.views.px(PHONE_ROW_CONTENT_GUTTER_DP),
+                            activity.views.px(PHONE_EXTRA_TIGHT_INSET_DP),
+                        )
+                        setBackgroundColor(activity.views.colors.panel)
+                    }
+                list.addView(heading, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.px(PHONE_CONTACT_LETTER_HEADING_DP)))
+                sections[letter] = heading
+                previous = letter
+            }
+            appendPhoneContactRow(list, person)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun phoneContactsSearch(container: LinearLayout): EditText {
+        val search =
+            EditText(activity).apply {
+                setSingleLine(true)
+                textSize = PHONE_BODY_TEXT_SP
+                hint = "⌕  Search contacts"
+                setTextColor(activity.views.colors.fg)
+                setHintTextColor(activity.views.colors.muted)
+                background = activity.views.round(activity.views.colors.panel, PHONE_CONTACTS_VALUE_14, true)
+                setPadding(
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_LIST_CONTENT_INSET_DP),
+                    0,
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_LIST_CONTENT_INSET_DP),
+                    0,
+                )
+                setText(activity.contactSearch)
+            }
+        val searchBand =
+            activity.views.row().apply {
+                setPadding(
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_PAGE_CONTENT_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_COMPACT_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_PAGE_CONTENT_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_SMALL_INSET_DP),
+                )
+            }
+        container.addView(searchBand, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.px(PHONE_SEARCH_BAND_HEIGHT_DP)))
+        searchBand.addView(search, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.px(PHONE_SEARCH_AND_ACTION_HEIGHT_DP)))
+        return search
+    }
+
+    private fun installPhoneAlphabet(
+        area: FrameLayout,
+        scroll: ScrollView,
+        sections: Map<String, View>,
+    ) {
+        val alphabet =
+            LinearLayout(activity).apply {
+                orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
+                gravity = Gravity.CENTER
+            }
+        area.addView(
+            alphabet,
+            FrameLayout.LayoutParams(activity.views.px(PHONE_MINI_ICON_EDGE_DP), -1, Gravity.END).apply {
+                bottomMargin = activity.views.px(PHONE_ALPHABET_SCROLL_MARGIN_DP)
+            },
+        )
+        "#ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".forEach { c ->
+            val item =
+                activity.views.clickLabel(c.toString(), "Jump to $c", PHONE_KEYPAD_RATIO_9_F) {
+                    val anchor = sections[c.toString()]
+                    if (anchor != null) scroll.post { scroll.smoothScrollTo(0, anchor.top) }
+                }
+            item.setTextColor(activity.views.colors.muted)
+            alphabet.addView(item, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1f))
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/** Name and digit-substring matching, preserving order and duplicate provider entries. */
+internal fun matchingPhoneContacts(
+    query: String,
+    people: List<TenSevenPhoneData.Person>,
+): List<TenSevenPhoneData.Person> {
+    val normalized = query.filter(Char::isDigit)
+    return people.filter {
+        it.name.contains(query, ignoreCase = true) ||
+            (normalized.isNotEmpty() && it.number.filter(Char::isDigit).contains(normalized))
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.phone
+
+import android.Manifest
+import android.graphics.Color
+import android.text.Editable
+import android.text.InputType
+import android.text.TextWatcher
+import android.view.Gravity
+import android.view.View
+import android.view.WindowInsets
+import android.widget.EditText
+import android.widget.FrameLayout
+import android.widget.LinearLayout
+
+/** Activity-bound PhoneDialContent renderer; lifecycle and mutable state remain with the activity. */
+internal class PhoneDialContent(
+    private val activity: TenSevenPhoneActivity,
+) {
+    /** Dial content has no ScrollView; the keypad stretches only inside the inset-safe window. */
+    fun dial(frame: FrameLayout) {
+        val metrics = activity.windowManager.currentWindowMetrics
+        val safe =
+            metrics.windowInsets.getInsets(WindowInsets.Type.systemBars() or WindowInsets.Type.displayCutout())
+        val density = activity.resources.displayMetrics.density
+        val widthDp = (metrics.bounds.width() - safe.left - safe.right) / density
+        val heightDp = (metrics.bounds.height() - safe.top - safe.bottom) / density
+        val size = PhoneUiRules.bounds(widthDp, heightDp)
+        val panel =
+            activity.views.column().apply {
+                setPadding(
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_SECTION_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_EXTRA_TIGHT_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_SECTION_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_COMPACT_INSET_DP),
+                )
+            }
+        frame.addView(panel, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
+
+        val input = renderDialInput(panel, size)
+        val matches = activity.views.column()
+        panel.addView(matches, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0))
+        val people = if (activity.isGranted(Manifest.permission.READ_CONTACTS)) activity.data.people() else emptyList()
+
+        input.addTextChangedListener(
+            object : TextWatcher {
+                override fun beforeTextChanged(
+                    s: CharSequence?,
+                    start: Int,
+                    count: Int,
+                    after: Int,
+                ) = Unit
+
+                override fun onTextChanged(
+                    s: CharSequence?,
+                    start: Int,
+                    before: Int,
+                    count: Int,
+                ) {
+                    updateDialMatches(s?.toString().orEmpty(), people, size, matches, input)
+                }
+
+                override fun afterTextChanged(s: Editable?) = Unit
+            },
+        )
+        updateDialMatches(activity.dialNumber, people, size, matches, input)
+
+        val keypad = activity.views.column()
+        panel.addView(keypad, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1f))
+        renderDialKeypad(keypad, input, size)
+        renderDialCallAction(panel, input, size)
+    }
+
+    private fun renderDialInput(
+        panel: LinearLayout,
+        size: PhoneUiRules.Bounds,
+    ): EditText {
+        val numberRow = activity.views.row()
+        panel.addView(
+            numberRow,
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
+                -PHONE_DIAL_DP_1,
+                activity.views.px(
+                    if (size
+                            .compact
+                    ) {
+                        PHONE_DIAL_DP_43
+                    } else {
+                        PHONE_DIAL_DP_52
+                    },
+                ),
+            ),
+        )
+        val input =
+            EditText(activity).apply {
+                setSingleLine(true)
+                inputType = InputType.TYPE_CLASS_PHONE
+                showSoftInputOnFocus = false // Hardware QWERTY and touch keys both remain available.
+                textSize = if (size.compact) PHONE_DIAL_SP_24_F else PHONE_DIAL_SP_28_F
+                gravity = Gravity.CENTER
+                setTextColor(activity.views.colors.fg)
+                setHintTextColor(activity.views.colors.muted)
+                hint = "Enter number"
+                background = null
+                setText(activity.dialNumber)
+                setSelection(text.length)
+            }
+        numberRow.addView(input, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -1, 1f))
+        numberRow.addView(
+            activity.views
+                .clickLabel("⌫", "Delete last digit", PHONE_DIAL_RATIO_25_F) {
+                    if (input.text.isNotEmpty()) input.text.delete(input.length() - 1, input.length())
+                }.apply {
+                    setOnLongClickListener {
+                        input.text.clear()
+                        true
+                    }
+                },
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(activity.views.px(PHONE_STANDARD_NAVIGATION_HEIGHT_DP), -1),
+        )
+        activity.views.rule(panel)
+
+        return input
+    }
+
+    private fun updateDialMatches(
+        text: String,
+        people: List<TenSevenPhoneData.Person>,
+        size: PhoneUiRules.Bounds,
+        matches: LinearLayout,
+        input: EditText,
+    ) {
+        activity.dialNumber = text
+        matches.removeAllViews()
+        val results =
+            PhoneUiRules.dialMatches(
+                text,
+                people.map {
+                    PhoneUiRules.Match(it.id, it.name, it.number)
+                },
+                size.maxMatches,
+            )
+        // No blank reserved match panel when the number matches nobody.
+        matches.layoutParams =
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
+                -PHONE_MATCHES_DP_1,
+                activity.views.px(results.size * (if (size.compact) PHONE_MATCHES_DP_37 else PHONE_MATCHES_DP_44)),
+            )
+        results.forEach { match ->
+            addDialMatchRow(matches, input, size, match)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun addDialMatchRow(
+        matches: LinearLayout,
+        input: EditText,
+        size: PhoneUiRules.Bounds,
+        match: PhoneUiRules.Match,
+    ) {
+        val cell =
+            activity.views.row().apply {
+                setPadding(
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_SMALL_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_MICRO_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_NARROW_GUTTER_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_MICRO_INSET_DP),
+                )
+                isClickable = true
+                isFocusable = true
+                contentDescription = "Dial ${match.name} ${match.number}"
+                setOnClickListener {
+                    input.setText(match.number)
+                    input.setSelection(input.length())
+                }
+            }
+        matches.addView(
+            cell,
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
+                -PHONE_MATCHES_DP_1,
+                activity.views.px(if (size.compact) PHONE_MATCHES_DP_36 else PHONE_MATCHES_DP_43),
+            ),
+        )
+        cell.addView(
+            TenSevenContactPhotos.avatar(
+                activity,
+                match.contactId,
+                match.name,
+                PHONE_MATCHES_VALUE_32,
+                activity.views.colors,
+            ),
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
+                activity.views.px(PHONE_COMPACT_AVATAR_EDGE_DP),
+                activity.views.px(PHONE_COMPACT_AVATAR_EDGE_DP),
+            ),
+        )
+        val names =
+            LinearLayout(activity).apply {
+                orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
+                setPadding(activity.views.px(PHONE_ROW_CONTENT_GUTTER_DP), 0, 0, 0)
+            }
+        cell.addView(names, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -PHONE_MATCHES_DP_2, 1f))
+        names.addView(activity.views.label(match.name, PHONE_COMPACT_TEXT_SP, bold = true))
+        names.addView(activity.views.label(match.number, PHONE_MATCHES_SP_11_F, activity.views.colors.muted))
+        cell.addView(activity.views.label("›", PHONE_SYMBOL_TEXT_SP, activity.views.colors.muted))
+        activity.views.rule(matches)
+    }
+
+    private fun renderDialKeypad(
+        keypad: LinearLayout,
+        input: EditText,
+        size: PhoneUiRules.Bounds,
+    ) {
+        val digits =
+            listOf(
+                "1" to "",
+                "2" to "ABC",
+                "3" to "DEF",
+                "4" to "GHI",
+                "5" to "JKL",
+                "6" to "MNO",
+                "7" to "PQRS",
+                "8" to "TUV",
+                "9" to "WXYZ",
+                "*" to "",
+                "0" to "+",
+                "#" to "",
+            )
+        val keyVisual = DialKeyVisual(input, size)
+        digits.chunked(PHONE_KEYPAD_VALUE_3).forEach { trio ->
+            val keyRow = activity.views.row()
+            keypad.addView(keyRow, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1f))
+            trio.forEachIndexed { index, (digit, letters) ->
+                addDialKey(keyRow, digit, letters, index, keyVisual)
+            }
+            activity.views.rule(keypad)
+        }
+    }
+
+    private data class DialKeyVisual(
+        val input: EditText,
+        val size: PhoneUiRules.Bounds,
+    )
+
+    private fun addDialKey(
+        keyRow: LinearLayout,
+        digit: String,
+        letters: String,
+        index: Int,
+        visual: DialKeyVisual,
+    ) {
+        val input = visual.input
+        val size = visual.size
+        val key =
+            LinearLayout(activity).apply {
+                orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
+                gravity = Gravity.CENTER
+                isClickable = true
+                isFocusable = true
+                contentDescription = "$digit ${letters.ifEmpty { "key" }}"
+                setOnClickListener { input.append(digit) }
+                if (digit == "0") {
+                    setOnLongClickListener {
+                        input.append("+")
+                        true
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        keyRow.addView(key, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -1, 1f))
+        key.addView(
+            activity.views
+                .label(digit, if (size.compact) PHONE_KEYPAD_SP_23_F else PHONE_LARGE_SYMBOL_TEXT_SP)
+                .apply { gravity = Gravity.CENTER },
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 2f),
+        )
+        key.addView(
+            activity.views
+                .label(
+                    letters,
+                    if (size.compact) PHONE_KEYPAD_SP_9_F else PHONE_KEYPAD_SP_10_F,
+                    activity.views.colors.muted,
+                ).apply {
+                    gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
+                },
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1f),
+        )
+        if (index < 2) {
+            keyRow.addView(
+                View(activity).apply { setBackgroundColor(activity.views.colors.line) },
+                LinearLayout.LayoutParams(activity.views.px(PHONE_HAIRLINE_DP), -1),
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun renderDialCallAction(
+        panel: LinearLayout,
+        input: EditText,
+        size: PhoneUiRules.Bounds,
+    ) {
+        val callRow = activity.views.row().apply { gravity = Gravity.CENTER }
+        panel.addView(callRow, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.px(size.primaryCallHeightDp)))
+        val call =
+            activity.views
+                .clickLabel("✆", "Place call", PHONE_LARGE_SYMBOL_TEXT_SP) {
+                    activity.dialNumber = input.text.toString()
+                    activity.placeCall(activity.dialNumber)
+                }.apply {
+                    background = activity.views.round(activity.views.colors.success, PHONE_KEYPAD_VALUE_24)
+                    setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
+                }
+        callRow.addView(
+            call,
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
+                activity.views.px(if (size.compact) PHONE_KEYPAD_DP_126 else PHONE_KEYPAD_DP_145),
+                activity.views.px(size.primaryCallHeightDp - PHONE_KEYPAD_DP_8),
+            ),
+        )
+    }
+}

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.phone
+

+import android.widget.ScrollView

+import io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.phone.TenSevenPhoneActivity.Screen
+
+/** Activity-bound PhoneRecentsContent renderer; lifecycle and mutable state remain with the activity. */
+internal class PhoneRecentsContent(
+    private val activity: TenSevenPhoneActivity,
+    private val onOpenContact: (Long) -> Unit,
+    private val onVoicemail: () -> Unit,
+    private val onDefaultPhoneSetup: () -> Unit,
+) {
+    fun recents(frame: FrameLayout) {
+        val root = activity.views.column()
+        frame.addView(root, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
+        renderRecentFilters(root)
+        val listArea = FrameLayout(activity)
+        root.addView(listArea, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1f))
+        val scroll = ScrollView(activity).apply { isFillViewport = true }
+        listArea.addView(scroll, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
+        val list =
+            activity.views.column().apply {
+                setPadding(
+                    0,
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_EXTRA_TIGHT_INSET_DP),
+                    0,
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_RECENTS_BOTTOM_INSET_DP),
+                )
+            }
+        scroll.addView(list)
+        renderRecentHistory(list)
+        renderVoicemailRow(list)
+        activity.views.floating(
+            listArea,
+            "⠿",
+            "Open dialpad",
+            FloatingPosition(Gravity.END or Gravity.BOTTOM, PHONE_RECENTS_VALUE_15, PHONE_RECENTS_VALUE_16),
+        ) {
+            activity.screen = Screen.DIAL
+            activity.draw()
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun renderRecentFilters(root: LinearLayout) {
+        val filters = activity.views.row()
+        root.addView(filters, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.px(PHONE_STANDARD_NAVIGATION_HEIGHT_DP)))
+        listOf("All", "Missed", "Incoming", "Outgoing").forEach { name ->
+            val selected = activity.callFilter == name
+            val control =
+                activity.views
+                    .clickLabel(name, "Show $name calls", PHONE_CAPTION_TEXT_SP) {
+                        activity.callFilter = name
+                        activity.draw()
+                    }.apply { setTextColor(if (selected) Color.WHITE else activity.views.colors.muted) }
+            val group = LinearLayout(activity).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL }
+            group.addView(control, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1f))
+            group.addView(
+                View(activity).apply {

+    private fun renderRecentHistory(list: LinearLayout) {
+        if (!activity.isGranted(Manifest.permission.READ_CALL_LOG)) {
+            activity.views.notice(
+                list,
+                "Call history needs Android call-log access. Selecting TenSeven as default Phone may be required.",
+                "Open default Phone setup",
+            ) { onDefaultPhoneSetup() }
+            activity.views.notice(list, "Allow call history", "Request call-log permission") {
+                activity.requestPermissions(arrayOf(Manifest.permission.READ_CALL_LOG), PHONE_REQUEST_CALL_LOG)
+            }
+        } else {
+            val people =
+                if (activity.isGranted(
+                        Manifest.permission.READ_CONTACTS,
+                    )
+                ) {
+                    activity.data.people()
+                } else {
+                    emptyList()
+                }
+            val byNumber = people.associateBy { PhoneBlocklist.normalize(it.number) }
+            val favorites = people.filter { it.favorite }.map { PhoneBlocklist.normalize(it.number) }.toSet()
+            val entries =
+                activity.data.calls().filter {
+                    when (activity.callFilter) {
+                        "Missed" -> it.kind == CallLog.Calls.MISSED_TYPE
+                        "Incoming" -> it.kind == CallLog.Calls.INCOMING_TYPE
+                        "Outgoing" -> it.kind == CallLog.Calls.OUTGOING_TYPE
+                        "Favorites" -> PhoneBlocklist.normalize(it.number) in favorites
+                        else -> true
+                    }
+                }
+            if (entries.isEmpty()) activity.views.notice(list, "No ${activity.callFilter.lowercase()} calls")
+            entries.forEach { entry ->
+                val person = byNumber[PhoneBlocklist.normalize(entry.number)]
+                renderRecentCallRow(list, entry, person)
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun renderRecentCallRow(
+        list: LinearLayout,
+        entry: TenSevenPhoneData.Call,
+        person: TenSevenPhoneData.Person?,
+    ) {
+        val kind = recentCallKind(entry.kind)
+        val item =
+            activity.views.row().apply {
+                setPadding(
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_LIST_CONTROL_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_SMALL_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_SECTION_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_SMALL_INSET_DP),
+                )
+                isClickable = true
+                isFocusable = true
+                contentDescription = "${person?.name ?: entry.number}, $kind, ${entry.whenText}"
+                setOnClickListener {
+                    if (person != null) {
+                        onOpenContact(person.id)
+                    } else {
+                        activity.dialNumber = entry.number
+                        activity.screen = Screen.DIAL
+                        activity.draw()
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        list.addView(item, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.px(PHONE_RECENT_CALL_ROW_HEIGHT_DP)))
+        val glyph = recentCallKindGlyph(kind)
+        item.addView(glyph, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(activity.views.px(PHONE_CALL_TYPE_ICON_WIDTH_DP), -1))
+        val summary = LinearLayout(activity).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL }
+        item.addView(summary, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -PHONE_RECENTS_DP_2, 1f))
+        summary.addView(
+            activity.views.label(
+                person?.name ?: entry.number.ifBlank { "Private number" },
+                PHONE_BODY_TEXT_SP,
+                if (kind == "Missed") activity.views.colors.danger else activity.views.colors.fg,
+                bold = true,
+            ),
+        )
+        summary.addView(activity.views.label(kind, PHONE_CAPTION_TEXT_SP, activity.views.colors.muted))
+        item.addView(
+            activity.views.label(entry.whenText, PHONE_RECENTS_SP_11_F, activity.views.colors.muted).apply {
+                gravity =
+                    Gravity.CENTER
+            },
+        )
+        item.addView(
+            activity.views.label("›", PHONE_RECENTS_SP_21_F, activity.views.colors.muted).apply {
+                gravity =
+                    Gravity.CENTER
+            },
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(activity.views.px(PHONE_CALLOUT_TOP_INSET_DP), -1),
+        )
+        activity.views.rule(list)
+    }
+
+    private fun recentCallKind(kind: Int): String =
+        when (kind) {
+            CallLog.Calls.MISSED_TYPE -> "Missed"
+            CallLog.Calls.OUTGOING_TYPE -> "Outgoing"
+            CallLog.Calls.INCOMING_TYPE -> "Incoming"
+            CallLog.Calls.BLOCKED_TYPE -> "Blocked"
+            else -> "Call"
+        }
+
+    private fun recentCallKindGlyph(kind: String): TextView {
+        val glyph =
+            activity.views
+                .label(
+                    when (kind) {
+                        "Missed" -> "✕"
+                        "Outgoing" -> "↗"
+                        "Blocked" -> "⊘"
+                        else -> "↙"
+                    },
+                    PHONE_RECENTS_RATIO_25_F,
+                    if (kind == "Missed") activity.views.colors.danger else activity.views.colors.accent,
+                ).apply { gravity = Gravity.CENTER }
+        return glyph
+    }
+
+    private fun renderVoicemailRow(list: LinearLayout) {
+        // Voicemail must be visible in Recents even if call history is empty.
+        val vm =
+            activity.views.row().apply {
+                setPadding(
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_DETAIL_CONTENT_INSET_DP),
+                    activity.views.px(PHONE_LIST_CONTROL_INSET_DP),

+                isFocusable = true

+                setOnClickListener { onVoicemail() }
+            }
+        list.addView(vm, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, activity.views.px(PHONE_VOICEMAIL_ACTION_HEIGHT_DP)))
+        vm.addView(
+            activity.views.label("☏", PHONE_RECENTS_SP_24_F).apply { gravity = Gravity.CENTER },
+            LinearLayout
+                .LayoutParams(activity.views.px(PHONE_CONTACT_AVATAR_EDGE_DP), -PHONE_RECENTS_DP_1),

+        vm.addView(vtext, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, -PHONE_RECENTS_DP_2, 1f))

+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.phone
+
+/** Named presentation/protocol values; numeric values unchanged from the reviewed source. */
+private const val PHONE_UI_RULES_BOUNDS_VALUE_2 = 2
+private const val PHONE_UI_RULES_BOUNDS_VALUE_420 = 420
+private const val PHONE_UI_RULES_BOUNDS_VALUE_46 = 46
+private const val PHONE_UI_RULES_BOUNDS_VALUE_500 = 500
+private const val PHONE_UI_RULES_BOUNDS_VALUE_52 = 52
+
+/** No Android dependencies: this contract is shared by the activity and local JVM tests. */
+internal object PhoneUiRules {
+    data class Match(
+        val contactId: Long,
+        val name: String,
+        val number: String,
+    )
+
+    data class Bounds(
+        val compact: Boolean,
+        val maxMatches: Int,
+        val primaryCallHeightDp: Int,
+    )
+
+    fun bounds(
+        availableWidthDp: Float,
+        availableHeightDp: Float,
+    ): Bounds {
+        require(availableWidthDp > 0 && availableHeightDp > 0)
+        val compact =
+            availableWidthDp < PHONE_UI_RULES_BOUNDS_VALUE_420 ||
+                availableHeightDp < PHONE_UI_RULES_BOUNDS_VALUE_500
+        return Bounds(
+            compact,
+            if (compact) 1 else PHONE_UI_RULES_BOUNDS_VALUE_2,
+            if (compact) PHONE_UI_RULES_BOUNDS_VALUE_46 else PHONE_UI_RULES_BOUNDS_VALUE_52,
+        )
+    }
+
+    fun dialMatches(
+        typed: String,
+        contacts: List<Match>,
+        limit: Int,
+    ): List<Match> {
+        val digits = typed.filter(Char::isDigit)
+        if (digits.length < 2 || limit < 1) return emptyList()
+        return contacts
+            .asSequence()
+            .filter { it.number.filter(Char::isDigit).contains(digits) }
+            .distinctBy { it.contactId }
+            .take(limit)
+            .toList()
+    }
+
+    fun initials(displayName: String): String =
+        displayName
+            .trim()
+            .split(Regex("\\s+"))
+            .filter { it.isNotBlank() }
+            .take(2)
+            .mapNotNull { it.firstOrNull()?.uppercaseChar() }
+            .joinToString("")
+            .ifEmpty { "?" }
+
+    fun firstLetter(name: String): String =
+        name.firstOrNull()?.uppercaseChar()?.let {
+            if (it in 'A'..'Z') it.toString() else "#"
+        } ?: "#"
+}
