+package io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.features.phone
+
+import android.graphics.Color
+import android.graphics.Typeface
+import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
+import android.view.Gravity
+import android.view.View
+import android.widget.FrameLayout
+import android.widget.LinearLayout
+import android.widget.TextView
+
+internal data class FloatingPosition(
+    val alignment: Int,
+    val right: Int,
+    val bottom: Int,
+)
+
+/** Shared Phone view construction with the original Activity context and palette. */
+internal class PhoneViews(
+    private val activity: TenSevenPhoneActivity,
+) {
+    val colors by lazy { PhonePalette() }
+
+    fun px(dp: Int) = (dp * activity.resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
+
+    fun column() =
+        LinearLayout(activity).apply {
+            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
+            setBackgroundColor(colors.bg)
+        }
+
+    fun row() =
+        LinearLayout(activity).apply {
+            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
+            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
+        }
+
+    fun label(
+        value: String,
+        size: Float = PHONE_BODY_TEXT_SP,
+        color: Int = colors.fg,
+        bold: Boolean = false,
+    ): TextView =
+        TextView(activity).apply {
+            text = value
+            textSize = size
+            setTextColor(color)
+            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
+            if (bold) setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD)
+            maxLines = 2
+        }
+
+    fun rule(parent: LinearLayout) =
+        parent.addView(
+            View(activity).apply { setBackgroundColor(colors.line) },
+            LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
+                -1,
+                px(PHONE_HAIRLINE_DP),
+            ),
+        )
+
+    fun round(
+        color: Int,
+        radius: Int = 12,
+        stroke: Boolean = false,
+    ) = GradientDrawable().apply {
+        cornerRadius = px(radius).toFloat()
+        setColor(color)
+        if (stroke) setStroke(px(PHONE_HAIRLINE_DP), this@PhoneViews.colors.line)
+    }
+
+    fun circular(color: Int) =
+        GradientDrawable().apply {
+            shape = GradientDrawable.OVAL
+            setColor(color)
+        }
+
+    fun clickLabel(
+        text: String,
+        description: String = text,
+        size: Float = PHONE_BODY_TEXT_SP,
+        action: () -> Unit,
+    ): TextView =
+        label(text, size).apply {
+            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
+            contentDescription = description
+            isClickable = true
+            isFocusable = true
+            setOnClickListener { action() }
+        }
+
+    fun notice(
+        body: LinearLayout,
+        message: String,
+        action: String? = null,
+        onClick: (() -> Unit)? = null,
+    ) {
+        val note = label(message, PHONE_SECONDARY_TEXT_SP, colors.muted)
+        note.setPadding(
+            px(PHONE_CALLOUT_CONTENT_INSET_DP),
+            px(PHONE_CALLOUT_TOP_INSET_DP),
+            px(PHONE_CALLOUT_CONTENT_INSET_DP),
+            px(PHONE_DETAIL_CONTENT_INSET_DP),
+        )
+        body.addView(note)
+        if (action != null && onClick != null) {
+            val go =
+                clickLabel(action, action, PHONE_BODY_TEXT_SP, onClick).apply {
+                    setTextColor(colors.accent)
+                    gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
+                    setPadding(
+                        px(PHONE_CALLOUT_CONTENT_INSET_DP),
+                        px(PHONE_SMALL_INSET_DP),
+                        px(PHONE_CALLOUT_CONTENT_INSET_DP),
+                        px(PHONE_PAGE_CONTENT_INSET_DP),
+                    )
+                }
+            body.addView(go)
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun floating(
+        parent: FrameLayout,
+        glyph: String,
+        description: String,
+        position: FloatingPosition,
+        action: () -> Unit,
+    ) {
+        val control =
+            clickLabel(glyph, description, PHONE_FLOATING_RATIO_28_F, action).apply {
+                background = circular(colors.accent)
+                setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
+                elevation = px(PHONE_TIGHT_INSET_DP).toFloat()
+            }
+        parent.addView(
+            control,
+            FrameLayout
+                .LayoutParams(
+                    px(PHONE_FLOATING_ACTION_EDGE_DP),
+                    px(PHONE_FLOATING_ACTION_EDGE_DP),
+                    position.alignment,
+                ).apply {
+                    rightMargin = px(position.right)
+                    bottomMargin = px(position.bottom)
+                },
+        )
+    }
+}

+private object DialpadMetrics {
+    const val SIDE_DP = 18
+    const val TOP_DP = 9
+    const val BOTTOM_DP = 11
+    const val NUMBER_HEIGHT_DP = 48
+    const val KEY_TEXT_SP = 25f
+    const val KEY_HEIGHT_DP = 47
+    const val ACTION_TEXT_SP = 17f
+    const val ACTION_HEIGHT_DP = 46
+}
+
+/** An opt-in dialog-sized floating keypad; no SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW privilege or system overlay claimed. */
+class TenSevenFloatingDialpadActivity : Activity() {
+    private fun dp(n: Int) = (n * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
+
+    /** Reuse the same dialpad key layout without inflating Activity.onCreate. */
+    private fun addDigitKeys(
+        root: LinearLayout,
+        number: EditText,
+    ) {
+        listOf("123", "456", "789", "*0#").forEach { symbols ->
+            val line = LinearLayout(this)
+            root.addView(line)
+            symbols.forEach { digit ->
+                val key =
+                    TextView(this).apply {
+                        text = digit.toString()
+                        textSize = DialpadMetrics.KEY_TEXT_SP
+                        setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
+                        gravity = Gravity.CENTER
+                        setOnClickListener { number.append(digit.toString()) }
+                    }
+                line.addView(key, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, dp(DialpadMetrics.KEY_HEIGHT_DP), 1f))
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
+        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
+        window.setLayout(WindowManager.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
+        window.setGravity(Gravity.BOTTOM)
+        val root =
+            LinearLayout(this).apply {
+                orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
+                setPadding(
+                    dp(DialpadMetrics.SIDE_DP),
+                    dp(DialpadMetrics.TOP_DP),
+                    dp(DialpadMetrics.SIDE_DP),
+                    dp(DialpadMetrics.BOTTOM_DP),
+                )
+                setBackgroundColor(
+                    Color.rgb(
+                        DIALPAD_ON_CREATE_RGB_18,
+                        DIALPAD_ON_CREATE_RGB_31,
+                        DIALPAD_ON_CREATE_RGB_45,
+                    ),
+                )
+            }
+        val number =
+            EditText(this).apply {
+                hint = "Dial number"
+                inputType = android.text.InputType.TYPE_CLASS_PHONE
+                setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
+                setHintTextColor(Color.LTGRAY)
+            }
+        number.showSoftInputOnFocus = false
+        root.addView(number, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, dp(DialpadMetrics.NUMBER_HEIGHT_DP)))
+        addDigitKeys(root, number)
+        val place =
+            TextView(this).apply {
+                text =
+                    this@TenSevenFloatingDialpadActivity.getString(
+                        io.github.aimindseye.tenseven.phone.R.string.tenseven_float_open_dialer,
+                    )
+                textSize = DialpadMetrics.ACTION_TEXT_SP
+                setTextColor(Color.rgb(0, DIALPAD_ON_CREATE_RGB_173, DIALPAD_ON_CREATE_RGB_239))
+                gravity = Gravity.CENTER
+                setOnClickListener {
+                    val target =
+                        Intent(Intent.ACTION_DIAL, Uri.fromParts("tel", number.text.toString(), null))
+                            .setClass(this@TenSevenFloatingDialpadActivity, TenSevenPhoneActivity::class.java)
+                    startActivity(target)
+                    finish()
+                }
+            }
+        root.addView(place, LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, dp(DialpadMetrics.ACTION_HEIGHT_DP)))
+        setContentView(root)
+    }
+}

+        if (sensitive && intent.component == null && intent.`package`.isNullOrBlank()) {
+            toast("No trusted application was selected for this action")
+            return
+        }
+        try {

+            // Do not silently claim dialer role. Hand off only to the chosen default Phone app.
+            openTrustedDialer(Uri.fromParts("tel", number, null))
+        } else if (checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.CALL_PHONE) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
+            queuedNumber = number
+            requestPermissions(arrayOf(Manifest.permission.CALL_PHONE), PHONE_REQUEST_CALL)
+        } else {
+            try {
+                getSystemService(TelecomManager::class.java)?.placeCall(Uri.fromParts("tel", number, null), Bundle())
+                    ?: toast("Telecom is unavailable")
+            } catch (_: Exception) {
+                toast("Call could not start; check SIM and Phone access")
+            }
+        }
+    }

+            }
+        }

+    }

+    internal fun toast(value: String) = Toast.makeText(this, value, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()

+/** Contacts photos remain on device. Decoded off UI thread with a bounded image cache. */
+internal object TenSevenContactPhotos {
+    private val cache = LruCache<String, Bitmap>(PhoneDataLimits.PHOTO_CACHE_ENTRIES)
+    private val executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(PhoneDataLimits.PHOTO_WORKERS)
+    private val mainThread = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())

+    fun lookupContactId(
+        context: Context,
+        number: String,
+    ): Long? {
+        if (context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.READ_CONTACTS) !=
+            PackageManager
+                .PERMISSION_GRANTED
+        ) {
+            return null
+        }
+        return try {
+            val uri = Uri.withAppendedPath(ContactsContract.PhoneLookup.CONTENT_FILTER_URI, Uri.encode(number))
+            context.contentResolver.query(uri, arrayOf(ContactsContract.PhoneLookup._ID), null, null, null)?.use { c ->
+                if (c.moveToFirst()) c.getLong(0) else null
+            }
+        } catch (_: Exception) {
+            null
+        }
+    }
+
+    private data class AvatarTarget(
+        val key: String,
+        val sizeDp: Int,
+        val image: ImageView,
+        val fallback: TextView,
+    )
+
+    private fun showAvatarBitmap(
+        target: AvatarTarget,
+        bitmap: Bitmap,
+    ) {
+        if (target.image.tag == target.key) {
+            target.image.setImageBitmap(bitmap)
+            target.image.visibility = View.VISIBLE
+            target.fallback.visibility = View.GONE
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun showPhotoIfCurrent(
+        imageRef: WeakReference<ImageView>,
+        fallbackRef: WeakReference<TextView>,
+        key: String,
+        bitmap: Bitmap,
+    ) {
+        imageRef.get()?.let { current ->
+            if (current.tag == key) {
+                current.setImageBitmap(bitmap)
+                current.visibility = View.VISIBLE
+                fallbackRef.get()?.visibility = View.GONE
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun decodeContactPhoto(
+        resolver: android.content.ContentResolver,
+        id: Long,
+        large: Boolean,
+    ): Bitmap? =
+        try {
+            val uri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(ContactsContract.Contacts.CONTENT_URI, id)
+            ContactsContract.Contacts.openContactPhotoInputStream(resolver, uri, large)?.use { stream ->
+                BitmapFactory.decodeStream(stream)
+            }
+        } catch (_: Exception) {
+            null
+        }
+
+    private fun enqueueAvatarPhoto(
+        context: Context,
+        id: Long,
+        target: AvatarTarget,
+    ) {
+        // Keep view references weak: a photo request must not retain a dismissed Phone screen.
+        val key = target.key
+        val large = target.sizeDp >= PhoneDataLimits.LARGE_AVATAR_MIN_DP
+        val imageRef = WeakReference(target.image)
+        val fallbackRef = WeakReference(target.fallback)
+        val resolver = context.applicationContext.contentResolver
+        executor.execute {
+            val bmp = decodeContactPhoto(resolver, id, large)
+            if (bmp != null) {
+                synchronized(cache) { cache.put(key, bmp) }
+                mainThread.post { showPhotoIfCurrent(imageRef, fallbackRef, key, bmp) }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun avatar(
+        context: Context,
+        id: Long?,
+        displayName: String,
+        sizeDp: Int,
+        palette: PhonePalette,
+    ): FrameLayout {
+        val frame =
+            FrameLayout(context).apply {
+                background =
+                    GradientDrawable().apply {
+                        shape = GradientDrawable.OVAL
+                        setColor(palette.panel)
+                        setStroke((context.resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1), palette.line)
+                    }
+                clipToOutline = true
+                contentDescription = displayName
+            }
+        val fallback =
+            TextView(context).apply {
+                text = PhoneUiRules.initials(displayName)
+                textSize =
+                    if (sizeDp >= PhoneDataLimits.LARGE_AVATAR_MIN_DP) {
+                        PhoneDataLimits.LARGE_AVATAR_TEXT_SP
+                    } else {
+                        PhoneDataLimits.SMALL_AVATAR_TEXT_SP
+                    }
+                setTextColor(palette.fg)
+                gravity = Gravity.CENTER
+            }
+        frame.addView(fallback, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
+        if (id != null && id >= 1L &&
+            context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.READ_CONTACTS) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
+        ) {
+            val key = "$id:${sizeDp >= PhoneDataLimits.LARGE_AVATAR_MIN_DP}"
+            val image =
+                ImageView(context).apply {
+                    scaleType = ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP
+                    tag = key
+                    visibility = View.GONE
+                }
+            frame.addView(image, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
+            val target = AvatarTarget(key, sizeDp, image, fallback)
+            val cached = synchronized(cache) { cache.get(key) }
+            if (cached != null) {
+                showAvatarBitmap(target, cached)
+            } else {
+                enqueueAvatarPhoto(context, id, target)
+            }
+        }
+        return frame
+    }
+}

+    private fun callTimeLabel(timestamp: Long): String {

+        return when {
+            day.get(Calendar.YEAR) == today.get(Calendar.YEAR) &&
+                day.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR) == today.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR) -> {

+/** Local-only explicit number matching. Never infer that an unknown number is spam. */
+object PhoneBlocklist {
+    private const val PREFS = "tenseven_phone_blocklist"
+    private const val KEY = "blocked_numbers"
+    private const val ALLOW = "allowed_numbers"
+    private const val SILENCE_UNKNOWN = "silence_unknown"
+
+    fun allowed(context: Context): Set<String> =
+        context
+            .getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
+            .getStringSet(ALLOW, emptySet())
+            ?.toSet()
+            .orEmpty()
+
+    fun allow(
+        context: Context,
+        value: String,
+    ) {
+        val number = normalize(value)
+        if (number.isNotEmpty()) {
+            context
+                .getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
+                .edit {
+                    putStringSet(
+                        ALLOW,
+                        allowed(context) + number,
+                    )
+                }
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun unallow(
+        context: Context,
+        value: String,
+    ) {
+        context
+            .getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
+            .edit {
+                putStringSet(ALLOW, allowed(context) - normalize(value))
+            }
+    }
+
+    fun silenceUnknown(context: Context): Boolean =
+        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE).getBoolean(SILENCE_UNKNOWN, false)
+
+    fun setSilenceUnknown(
+        context: Context,
+        enabled: Boolean,
+    ) {
+        context
+            .getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
+            .edit {
+                putBoolean(SILENCE_UNKNOWN, enabled)
+            }
+    }
+
+    fun normalize(value: String): String {
+        val text = PhoneNumberUtils.normalizeNumber(value.trim())
+        return if (text.length >= TELECOM_NORMALIZE_VALUE_7) text else ""
+    }
+
+    fun blocked(context: Context): Set<String> =
+        context
+            .getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
+            .getStringSet(KEY, emptySet())
+            ?.toSet()
+            .orEmpty()
+
+    fun contains(
+        context: Context,
+        value: String,
+    ): Boolean = normalize(value).let { it.isNotEmpty() && it in blocked(context) }
+
+    fun block(
+        context: Context,
+        value: String,
+    ) {
+        val number = normalize(value)
+        if (number.isEmpty()) return
+        context
+            .getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
+            .edit {
+                putStringSet(KEY, blocked(context) + number)
+            }
+    }
+
+    fun unblock(
+        context: Context,
+        value: String,
+    ) {
+        context
+            .getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
+            .edit {
+                putStringSet(KEY, blocked(context) - normalize(value))
+            }
+    }
+}

+/** Applied only after Android grants ROLE_CALL_SCREENING. Always answers promptly. */
+class TenSevenCallScreeningService : CallScreeningService() {
+    override fun onScreenCall(callDetails: Call.Details) {
+        if (callDetails.callDirection != Call.Details.DIRECTION_INCOMING) return
+        val number = callDetails.handle?.schemeSpecificPart.orEmpty()
+        val normalized = PhoneBlocklist.normalize(number)
+        val explicitlyAllowed = normalized in PhoneBlocklist.allowed(this)
+        val shouldBlock = !explicitlyAllowed && PhoneBlocklist.contains(this, number)
+        // Unknown-number filtering is explicit opt-in, never a default or a speculative spam verdict.
+        val silenceUnknown =
+            !shouldBlock && !explicitlyAllowed && PhoneBlocklist.silenceUnknown(this) &&
+                checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.READ_CONTACTS) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED &&
+                !isInContacts(number)
+        val result =
+            CallResponse
+                .Builder()
+                .setSilenceCall(silenceUnknown)
+                .setDisallowCall(shouldBlock)
+                .setRejectCall(shouldBlock)
+                .setSkipCallLog(false)
+                .setSkipNotification(false)
+                .build()
+        respondToCall(callDetails, result)
+    }
+
+    private fun isInContacts(number: String): Boolean {
+        return try {
+            val uri =
+                Uri.withAppendedPath(
+                    android.provider.ContactsContract.PhoneLookup.CONTENT_FILTER_URI,
+                    Uri.encode(number),
+                )
+            contentResolver
+                .query(
+                    uri,
+                    arrayOf(android.provider.ContactsContract.PhoneLookup._ID),
+                    null,
+                    null,
+                    null,
+                )?.use { it.moveToFirst() } ==
+                true
+        } catch (_: Exception) {
+            true
+        } // Fail open if the provider is inaccessible.
+    }
+}

+/** The system gives call objects only to the current default Phone role holder. */
+internal object PhoneCallState {
+    @Volatile var call: Call? = null
+
+    @Volatile var service: TenSevenInCallService? = null
+
+    // In-memory only: retain identity for the brief Call ended screen after Telecom removes its Call.
+    // Reset for every new Call, including one with a restricted/empty handle, to avoid stale identity.
+    @Volatile private var lastNumber: String? = null
+
+    @Volatile private var lastNetworkName: String? = null
+
+    fun remember(
+        call: Call,
+        newCall: Boolean = false,
+    ) {
+        val snapshot =
+            D6CallIdentityPolicy.reconcile(
+                D6CallIdentityPolicy.Snapshot(lastNumber, lastNetworkName),
+                call.details.handle?.schemeSpecificPart,
+                call.details.callerDisplayName,
+                newCall = newCall,
+            )
+        lastNumber = snapshot.number
+        lastNetworkName = snapshot.networkName
+    }
+
+    fun number(): String =
+        D6CallIdentityPolicy.displayNumber(
+            D6CallIdentityPolicy
+                .publicNumber(call?.details?.handle?.schemeSpecificPart) ?: lastNumber,
+        )
+
+    fun isPrivateCaller(): Boolean =
+        D6CallIdentityPolicy.publicNumber(call?.details?.handle?.schemeSpecificPart) == null && lastNumber == null
+
+    private fun lookupContactName(
+        context: Context,
+        number: String,
+    ): String? =
+        runCatching {
+            val uri =
+                Uri.withAppendedPath(
+                    android.provider.ContactsContract.PhoneLookup.CONTENT_FILTER_URI,
+                    Uri.encode(number),
+                )
+            context.contentResolver
+                .query(
+                    uri,
+                    arrayOf(android.provider.ContactsContract.PhoneLookup.DISPLAY_NAME),
+                    null,
+                    null,
+                    null,
+                )?.use { cursor -> cursor.takeIf { it.moveToFirst() }?.getString(0) }
+        }.getOrNull()
+
+    fun caller(context: Context): String {
+        val number = D6CallIdentityPolicy.publicNumber(call?.details?.handle?.schemeSpecificPart) ?: lastNumber
+        val contactName =
+            number
+                ?.takeIf {
+                    context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.READ_CONTACTS) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
+                }?.let { lookupContactName(context, it) }
+        return if (number == null) {
+            D6CallIdentityPolicy.PRIVATE_LABEL
+        } else {
+            D6CallIdentityPolicy.callerName(contactName, lastNetworkName, number)
+        }
+    }
+}

+        } catch (
+            _: SecurityException,
+        ) {
+            // User may have disabled notifications; role fallback remains Android-managed.
+        }
+    }

+internal object AndroidViewFixtures {
+    fun descendants(root: View): List<View> =
+        listOf(root) +
+            if (root is ViewGroup) {
+                (0 until root.childCount).flatMap { descendants(root.getChildAt(it)) }
+            } else {
+                emptyList()
+            }

+    fun text(
+        root: View,
+        value: String,
+    ): TextView = descendants(root).filterIsInstance<TextView>().first { it.text.toString() == value }

+    fun input(

+        hint: String,
+    ): EditText = descendants(root).filterIsInstance<EditText>().first { it.hint?.toString() == hint }
+
+    fun permission(
+        name: String,
+        granted: Boolean,
+    ) {
+        val application = shadowOf(RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication())
+        if (granted) application.grantPermissions(name) else application.denyPermissions(name)
+    }

+        FixtureProvider().also { ShadowContentResolver.registerProviderInternal(authority, it) }

+/** Synthetic records only. No provider writes, real contacts, network or device calls. */
+internal class FixtureProvider : ContentProvider() {
+    val records = mutableMapOf<String, List<Map<String, Any>>>()
+    val queries = mutableListOf<Uri>()
+
+    override fun onCreate() = true
+
+    override fun query(
+        uri: Uri,
+        projection: Array<out String>?,
+        selection: String?,
+        selectionArgs: Array<out String>?,
+        sortOrder: String?,
+    ): Cursor {
+        synchronized(queries) { queries.add(uri) }
+        val columns = projection?.toList().orEmpty()
+        val rows =
+            records.entries
+                .firstOrNull { uri.path.orEmpty().startsWith(it.key) }
+                ?.value
+                .orEmpty()
+        return MatrixCursor(columns.toTypedArray()).apply {
+            rows.forEach { row -> addRow(columns.map { row[it] }.toTypedArray()) }
+        }
+    }
+
+    override fun getType(uri: Uri): String? = null
+
+    override fun insert(
+        uri: Uri,
+        values: ContentValues?,
+    ): Uri = error("Unexpected provider write")
+
+    override fun delete(
+        uri: Uri,
+        selection: String?,
+        selectionArgs: Array<out String>?,
+    ): Int = error("Unexpected provider delete")
+
+    override fun update(
+        uri: Uri,
+        values: ContentValues?,
+        selection: String?,
+        selectionArgs: Array<out String>?,
+    ): Int = error("Unexpected provider update")
+}
